<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-Hant">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=VT323&display=swap">
<title>三國英雄傳說</title>
<style>
:root{
--grass:#8fbc6a; --grass2:#82b25e; --wood:#5c3a21; --wood-dark:#3f2814;
--parchment:#f6ecd2; --parchment2:#ecdcb4; --gold:#e0a72e; --hp:#d9534f;
--exp:#4a90d9; --ink:#3a2a18; --danger:#c0392b; --ok:#4a8f4a;
box-sizing:border-box;
padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html,body{height:100%;margin:0;overflow:hidden;font-family:'Baloo 2',-apple-system,'PingFang TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif;background:var(--wood-dark);}
body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
#hud{position:relative;z-index:3;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--wood),var(--wood-dark));color:var(--parchment);padding:8px 12px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;row-gap:6px;font-size:13px;border-bottom:3px solid var(--gold);flex-shrink:0;}
#turnBar{position:relative;z-index:3;background:var(--wood-dark);color:var(--parchment);padding:6px 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:13px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--gold);gap:10px;flex-shrink:0;}
.moveWrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex:1;}
.moveBarWrap{flex:1;height:8px;background:#00000055;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #00000066;max-width:120px;}
#moveBarFill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4a90d9,#7fc4ff);width:100%;transition:width .15s;}
#endTurnBtn{background:var(--gold);color:var(--wood-dark);border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 12px;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;}
#endTurnBtn:disabled{opacity:.5;}
#hud .lv{font-weight:700;font-size:16px;color:var(--gold);white-space:nowrap;}
.bar{flex:1;height:12px;background:#00000055;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #00000066;min-width:40px;}
.bar>div{height:100%;transition:width .3s;}
#expbar>div{background:var(--exp);} #hpbar>div{background:var(--hp);}
.stat{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;flex:1;}
.stat span{font-size:10px;opacity:.8;}
#gold{color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;}
#statusBtn,#invBtn{background:var(--parchment);border:2px solid var(--gold);color:var(--wood-dark);border-radius:8px;padding:5px 8px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;}
#saveWarn{color:#ffb4a8;font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap;}
#saveIcon{font-size:15px;opacity:.35;transition:opacity .2s,transform .2s;}
#saveIcon.flash{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.3);}
#bootScreen{position:fixed;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#6b8f4e,var(--wood-dark));z-index:20;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
#bootScreen.hidden{display:none !important;}
#bootBox{text-align:center;color:var(--parchment);}
#bootBox h1{margin:6px 0 22px;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gold);text-shadow:0 2px 4px #0008;}
#bootButtons{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;width:280px;}
#bootButtons button{padding:12px;border-radius:10px;border:2px solid var(--gold);font-weight:700;font-size:15px;background:var(--parchment);color:var(--wood-dark);}
#bootButtons button.secondary{background:transparent;color:var(--parchment);border-color:var(--parchment);font-size:13px;padding:8px;}
.srow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:6px 2px;border-bottom:1px solid #00000015;font-size:14px;}
.srow b{color:var(--wood-dark);}
#map{display:block;width:100%;touch-action:none;background:var(--grass);}
#wrap{position:relative;flex:1;min-height:0;}
#townPrompt{position:absolute;top:12px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--gold);color:var(--wood-dark);padding:8px 16px;border-radius:20px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 3px 8px #0006;display:none;z-index:2;border:none;font-size:14px;}
#incomeToast{position:absolute;top:54px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#8a5a2b;color:var(--parchment);padding:7px 14px;border-radius:20px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 3px 8px #0006;z-index:2;font-size:13px;}
#joyPad{position:absolute;right:20px;bottom:20px;width:100px;height:100px;border-radius:50%;background:#00000030;border:2px solid #ffffff55;touch-action:none;z-index:2;}
#recenterBtn{position:absolute;left:16px;bottom:56px;z-index:3;background:#b45309;color:#fff;border:2px solid #fde68a;border-radius:16px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 2px 6px #0006;}
#terrainLabel{position:absolute;left:16px;bottom:20px;background:#00000055;color:#fff;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:14px;font-size:12px;z-index:2;}
#checkpointPrompt{position:absolute;top:96px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#b8860b;color:#fff;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:20px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 3px 8px #0006;display:none;z-index:2;border:none;font-size:13px;}
#joyKnob{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:44px;height:44px;margin-left:-22px;margin-top:-22px;border-radius:50%;background:#ffffff70;border:2px solid #ffffffaa;}
#minimap{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;width:112px;height:112px;background:#00000066;border:2px solid #ffffff55;border-radius:8px;z-index:2;pointer-events:auto;touch-action:none;}
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#000000aa;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:10;}
.hidden{display:none !important;}
.card{background:var(--parchment);color:var(--ink);border-radius:14px;border:4px solid var(--wood);width:min(420px,92vw);max-height:85vh;overflow-y:auto;padding:16px;}
.card h2{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:20px;color:var(--wood-dark);}
.tabs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:10px;}
.tab{flex:1 1 22%;padding:8px 4px;white-space:nowrap;text-align:center;background:var(--parchment2);border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid transparent;}
.tab.active{border-color:var(--gold);background:#fff8e6;}
.item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px;border-bottom:1px solid #00000022;}
.item .info{flex:1;}
.item .info b{display:block;font-size:14px;}
.item .info span{font-size:12px;opacity:.7;}
button.buy{background:var(--gold);border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--wood-dark);}
button.buy:disabled{background:#ccc;color:#888;}
button.close{margin-top:10px;width:100%;padding:10px;background:var(--wood);color:var(--parchment);border:none;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;}
#battleModal{background:#000;}
#battleCard{background:#000;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:0;width:100vw;max-width:100vw;height:100%;max-height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:20px 18px;font-family:'VT323',monospace,'Baloo 2';text-align:center;}
#battleName{font-weight:700;margin-bottom:14px;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:1px;color:#fff;}
#battleVs{text-align:left;display:flex;gap:24px;justify-content:center;}
#clashIntro{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;height:70px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.clashIcon{font-size:44px;position:relative;}
#clashLeft{animation:clashInLeft .45s ease-out forwards;}
#clashRight{animation:clashInRight .45s ease-out forwards;}
.clashBolt{font-size:30px;position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(0);animation:clashBolt .3s ease-out .4s forwards;}
@keyframes clashInLeft{from{transform:translateX(-140px);opacity:0;}to{transform:translateX(-18px);opacity:1;}}
@keyframes clashInRight{from{transform:translateX(140px);opacity:0;}to{transform:translateX(18px);opacity:1;}}
@keyframes clashBolt{0%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(0);opacity:0;}60%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.4);opacity:1;}100%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1);opacity:1;}}
.side{margin-bottom:8px;width:150px;}
.sideLabel{font-weight:700;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px;color:#facc15;font-family:'Baloo 2';}
.urow{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:2px;margin-bottom:10px;font-size:14px;}
.urow.dead{opacity:.3;}
.urow .uiconname{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;}
.uicon{width:20px;text-align:center;flex-shrink:0;font-size:17px;}
.uname{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;color:#fff;font-size:15px;}
.ubarWrap{width:100%;height:9px;background:#111;border:1px solid #666;border-radius:0;overflow:hidden;margin-top:2px;}
.ubarWrap .ufill{height:100%;transition:width .3s;background:#ec2f8e;}
.enemyRow .ufill{background:#ec2f8e;}
.uhp{width:100%;text-align:right;font-size:15px;flex-shrink:0;color:#fff;font-family:'VT323',monospace;}
@keyframes bumpRight{0%{transform:translateX(0);}40%{transform:translateX(16px);}100%{transform:translateX(0);}}
@keyframes bumpLeft{0%{transform:translateX(0);}40%{transform:translateX(-16px);}100%{transform:translateX(0);}}
@keyframes shakeHit{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0);}20%{transform:translateX(-5px);}40%{transform:translateX(5px);}60%{transform:translateX(-4px);}80%{transform:translateX(3px);}}
.urow.bumping-right{animation:bumpRight .3s ease-out;}
.urow.bumping-left{animation:bumpLeft .3s ease-out;}
.urow.shaking{animation:shakeHit .3s ease-out;}
#battleResult{font-size:20px;font-weight:700;margin:10px 0 4px;color:#fff;}
.reward{font-size:14px;margin-top:6px;color:#facc15;}
#battleCard button.close{background:#facc15;color:#000;border-radius:4px;font-family:'Baloo 2';}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="hud">
<div id="heroNameBox" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;">
<span id="heroNameTxt" style="font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;">英雄</span>
<button id="heroRenameBtn" title="改名" style="background:none;border:none;padding:1px 2px;cursor:pointer;line-height:0;">
<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><g>
<rect x="14.2" y="1" width="2.6" height="10" rx="1.1" transform="rotate(38 15.5 6)" fill="#d8b978" stroke="#7a5a28" stroke-width="0.6"/>
<line x1="12.6" y1="8.6" x2="13.4" y2="9.4" stroke="#7a5a28" stroke-width="0.7"/>
<line x1="11.2" y1="10.0" x2="12.0" y2="10.8" stroke="#7a5a28" stroke-width="0.7"/>
<path d="M11.5 10.3 C9.5 11.5 7 15 4.5 21.5 C9 18 12 15.5 13 13.5 Z" fill="#1b1b1b"/>
<path d="M11.5 10.3 C9.5 12 7 15.5 5.3 20" fill="none" stroke="#3a3a3a" stroke-width="0.4"/>
</g></svg>
</button>
<span id="heroFlagWrap" style="display:inline-block;line-height:0;"></span>
</div>
<div class="lv" id="lvTxt">Lv.1</div>
<div class="stat"><span>經驗</span><div class="bar" id="expbar"><div style="width:0%"></div></div></div>
<div class="stat"><span>生命</span><div class="bar" id="hpbar"><div style="width:100%"></div></div></div>
<div id="gold">💰 50</div>
<div id="foodTxt" style="font-size:12px;">🌾 100</div>
<div id="dateTxt" style="font-size:11px;opacity:.85;">公元前184年1月</div>
<span id="saveIcon" title="存檔狀態">💾</span>
<button id="manualSaveBtn" title="手動存檔" style="background:none;border:none;font-size:16px;padding:2px 4px;">📥</button>
<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-left:auto;">
<button id="statusBtn">📋 狀態</button>
<button id="invBtn">🎒 物品</button>
</div>
<div id="saveWarn" class="hidden">⚠️ 此模式無法存檔</div>
</div>
<div id="turnBar">
<div class="moveWrap">
<span id="movesLeftTxt">步數 6/6</span>
<div class="moveBarWrap"><div id="moveBarFill"></div></div>
</div>
<button id="endTurnBtn">🔚 結束回合</button>
</div>
<div id="wrap">
<canvas id="map"></canvas>
<button id="townPrompt">🏰 進入城鎮</button>
<div id="incomeToast" class="hidden"></div>
<div id="joyPad"><div id="joyKnob"></div></div>
<div id="terrainLabel"></div>
<button id="checkpointPrompt"></button>
<canvas id="minimap" width="112" height="112"></canvas>
<button id="recenterBtn" class="hidden">🎯 回到英雄</button>
</div>

<div class="modal hidden" id="battleModal">
<div class="card" id="battleCard">
<div id="clashIntro" class="hidden">
<div class="clashIcon" id="clashLeft">🧙</div>
<div class="clashBolt">💥</div>
<div class="clashIcon" id="clashRight">👹</div>
</div>
<div id="battleName"></div>
<div id="battleVs">
<div class="side"><div class="sideLabel">🧙 我方</div><div id="teamList"></div></div>
<div class="side"><div class="sideLabel">⚔️ 敵方</div><div id="enemyList"></div></div>
</div>
<div id="battleResult"></div>
<div class="reward" id="battleReward"></div>
<button class="close hidden" id="battleClose">確定</button>
</div>
</div>

<div class="modal hidden" id="statusModal">
<div class="card">
<h2>📋 英雄狀態</h2>
<div id="statusBody"></div>
<div id="statusGarrison"></div>
<button class="close" id="statusClose">關閉</button>
</div>
</div>

<div class="modal hidden" id="invModal">
<div class="card">
<h2>🎒 物品欄</h2>
<div id="invBody"></div>
<button class="close" id="invClose">關閉</button>
</div>
</div>

<div class="modal hidden" id="townModal">
<div class="card">
<h2 id="townTitle">🏯 王城</h2>
<div class="tabs">
<div class="tab active" data-tab="shop">⚔️ 裝備店</div>
<div class="tab" data-tab="pharmacy">🧪 藥鋪</div>
<div class="tab" data-tab="food">🌾 糧食店</div>
<div class="tab" data-tab="merc">🐺 傭兵團</div>
<div class="tab" data-tab="zhaoxian">🏛️ 招賢閣</div>
<div class="tab" data-tab="fengyi">🌸 鳳儀亭</div>
<div class="tab" data-tab="inn">🛏️ 旅館</div>
<div class="tab" data-tab="conquer">🚩 佔領</div>
<div class="tab" data-tab="garrison">🛡️ 駐軍</div>
</div>
<div id="shopPane"></div>
<div id="pharmacyPane" class="hidden"></div>
<div id="foodPane" class="hidden"></div>
<div id="mercPane" class="hidden"></div>
<div id="zhaoxianPane" class="hidden"></div>
<div id="fengyiPane" class="hidden"></div>
<div id="innPane" class="hidden"></div>
<div id="conquerPane" class="hidden"></div>
<div id="garrisonPane" class="hidden"></div>
<button class="close" id="townClose">離開</button>
</div>
</div>

<div class="modal hidden" id="entityModal">
<div class="card">
<h2 id="entityTitle"></h2>
<div id="entityBody"></div>
<button class="close" id="entityClose">關閉</button>
</div>
</div>

<div class="modal hidden" id="eventModal">
<div class="card" style="text-align:center;">
<div id="eventIcon" style="font-size:42px;"></div>
<h2 id="eventTitle"></h2>
<p style="font-size:14px;" id="eventText"></p>
<div id="eventChoices" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;"></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="modal hidden" id="gameOverModal">
<div class="card" style="text-align:center;">
<h2 id="gameOverTitle">💀 遊戲結束</h2>
<p style="font-size:14px;" id="gameOverText">NPC 領主已經佔領了天下所有城池,你的王朝就此終結…</p>
<button class="close" id="gameOverRestart">重新開始</button>
</div>
</div>

<div id="bootScreen">
<div id="bootBox">
<img id="bootAvatar" style="width:64px;height:64px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:10px;">
<h1>三國英雄傳說</h1>
<div style="color:#f9ca24;font-size:15px;margin-top:-8px;margin-bottom:8px;">序章:黃巾之亂</div>
<div id="bootButtons"></div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="modal hidden" id="charModal" style="z-index:22;">
<div class="card" style="max-height:88vh;overflow-y:auto;">
<h2>🎭 選擇你的身分</h2>
<div class="tabs" id="charTabs">
<div class="tab active" data-ctab="fixed">🏯 固定勢力</div>
<div class="tab" data-ctab="roam">🐎 流動勢力</div>
<div class="tab" data-ctab="custom">✍️ 自創角色</div>
</div>
<div id="charBody"></div>
<button class="close" id="charCancel" style="margin-top:8px;opacity:.8;">返回</button>
</div>
</div>

<div class="modal hidden" id="manualSaveModal">
<div class="card" style="text-align:center;">
<h2>📥 手動存檔</h2>
<p style="font-size:14px;">選擇要存到第幾個檔案（會覆蓋該檔案原本的內容）</p>
<div id="manualSaveSlots" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin:10px 0;"></div>
<button class="close" id="manualSaveClose">取消</button>
</div>
</div>

<div class="modal hidden" id="renameModal" style="z-index:23;">
<div class="card" style="text-align:center;">
<h2>🖌️ 重新命名</h2>
<p style="font-size:14px;">為你的英雄取一個新名字</p>
<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin:10px 0;">
<input id="renameSur" maxlength="4" placeholder="姓" style="width:60px;text-align:center;padding:6px;border-radius:8px;border:2px solid var(--gold);">
<input id="renameGiven" maxlength="6" placeholder="名" style="width:90px;text-align:center;padding:6px;border-radius:8px;border:2px solid var(--gold);">
</div>
<div id="renameErr" style="color:#c0392b;font-size:12px;min-height:16px;"></div>
<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;">
<button class="buy" id="renameConfirm">確定</button>
<button class="close" id="renameCancel">取消</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="modal hidden" id="settingsModal" style="z-index:21;">
<div class="card" style="text-align:center;">
<h2>⚙️ 系統設定</h2>
<p style="font-size:14px;">自動存檔間隔</p>
<div id="autoSaveOptions" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin:10px 0;"></div>
<button class="close" id="settingsClose">關閉</button>
</div>
</div>

const CAPITAL_ART_IMG={};
function drawSurnameFlag(x,y,txt,color){
if(!txt)return;
ctx.save();
ctx.strokeStyle='#3b2412';ctx.lineWidth=1.6;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,y+14);ctx.lineTo(x,y-16);ctx.stroke();
const fw=txt.length>1?13:14,fh=txt.length>1?24:17,fx=x+1,fy=y-16;
ctx.fillStyle=color||'#c0392b';ctx.beginPath();
ctx.moveTo(fx,fy);ctx.lineTo(fx+fw,fy);ctx.lineTo(fx+fw,fy+fh);ctx.lineTo(fx+fw/2,fy+fh-4);ctx.lineTo(fx,fy+fh);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(40,20,5,0.8)';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke();
ctx.fillStyle='#1b1208';ctx.font='bold '+(txt.length>1?9:11)+'px serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
if(txt.length>1){ctx.fillText(txt[0],fx+fw/2,fy+6);ctx.fillText(txt[1],fx+fw/2,fy+15);}else ctx.fillText(txt,fx+fw/2,fy+fh/2-1);
ctx.restore();
}
function capitalArtFor(id){
if(typeof Image==='undefined'||!CAPITAL_ART_SRC[id])return null;
if(!CAPITAL_ART_IMG[id]){const im=new Image();im.src=CAPITAL_ART_SRC[id];CAPITAL_ART_IMG[id]=im;}
return CAPITAL_ART_IMG[id];
}

function shopRarityRange(){
if(!currentSettlement)return[0,3];
if(currentSettlement.type==='village')return[0,0];
if(currentSettlement.type==='capital')return currentSettlement.obj.isCenter?[2,3]:[1,1];
return[0,3];
}
const ELEMENT_BEATS={'木':'土','土':'水','水':'火','火':'金','金':'木'};
function elemMult(atkElem,defElem){
if(!atkElem||!defElem)return 1;
if(ELEMENT_BEATS[atkElem]===defElem)return 1.3;
if(ELEMENT_BEATS[defElem]===atkElem)return 0.75;
return 1;
}

const QUAD=3200,WORLD=QUAD*2;
const PLAYER_COLOR='#1d4ed8';
const KINGDOMS=[
{id:0,name:'馬騰',surname:'馬',qx:0,qy:0,types:[0,1],color:'#f6c90e',icon:'🏯',elem:'木'},
{id:1,name:'公孫瓚',surname:'公孫',qx:1,qy:0,types:[2,3],color:'#ff8fa3',icon:'🏯',elem:'金'},
{id:2,name:'劉焉',surname:'劉',qx:0,qy:1,types:[4,5],color:'#27ae60',icon:'🏯',elem:'火'},
{id:3,name:'袁術',surname:'袁',qx:1,qy:1,types:[0,3],color:'#74b9ff',icon:'🏯',elem:'水'},
{id:4,name:'董卓',isCenter:true,types:[1,2,4,5],color:'#8e44ad',icon:'👑',elem:'土'}
];
const CAPITALS=KINGDOMS.map(k=>k.isCenter
?{id:k.id,name:k.name,x:QUAD,y:QUAD,color:k.color,icon:k.icon,isCenter:true}
:{id:k.id,name:k.name,x:k.qx*QUAD+QUAD/2,y:k.qy*QUAD+QUAD/2,color:k.color,icon:k.icon});
function kingdomCorner(k){return{x:k.qx===0?200:WORLD-200,y:k.qy===0?200:WORLD-200};}
function kingdomOf(x,y){
if(Math.hypot(x-QUAD,y-QUAD)<280)return KINGDOMS[4];
const qx=x<QUAD?0:1,qy=y<QUAD?0:1;
return KINGDOMS.find(k=>!k.isCenter&&k.qx===qx&&k.qy===qy);
}
function nearAnyCapital(x,y,r){return CAPITALS.some(c=>Math.hypot(x-c.x,y-c.y)<r);}
function nearestCapital(x,y){
let best=CAPITALS[0],bd=Infinity;
for(const c of CAPITALS){const d=Math.hypot(x-c.x,y-c.y);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=c;}}
return best;
}

const ROAM_PERKS={liubei:'起始義弟關羽隨行。招兵花費 -40%。',caocao:'起始族弟夏侯惇隨行。經驗值 +30%,典韋許褚可直接招募。',sunjian:'起始部將程普隨行。攻擊力 +20%。',lvbu:'坐騎赤兔:移動力 +20%。攻擊力 +50%,但孤身一人。'};
let pendingIdentity=null;
function isDong(){return player&&player.identity==='fixed'&&player.lordId===4;}
function playerDisplayName(){
if(!player)return '英雄';
if(player.identity==='fixed'){const k=KINGDOMS[player.lordId];return k?k.name:'英雄';}
if(player.identity==='roam'){const d=ROAMING.find(r=>r.id===player.lordId);return d?d.name:'英雄';}
return (player.surname||'')+(player.givenName||'')||'英雄';
}
function playerLordName(){return player&&player.identity!=='custom'?playerDisplayName():null;}
function lordPerk(k){// 流動勢力玩家的加成
const id=player&&player.identity==='roam'?player.lordId:null;
if(k==='atk')return id==='sunjian'?1.2:id==='lvbu'?1.5:1;
if(k==='exp')return id==='caocao'?1.3:1;
if(k==='merc')return id==='liubei'?0.6:1;
if(k==='move')return id==='lvbu'?1.2:1;
return 1;
}
function mercCost(m){return Math.round(m.cost*lordPerk('merc'));}
function defaultState(){
const ident=pendingIdentity||{identity:'custom',region:Math.floor(Math.random()*4)};
let homeK=ident.identity==='custom'?(ident.region!==undefined?ident.region:Math.floor(Math.random()*4)):ident.identity==='fixed'?ident.lordId:ROAMING.find(r=>r.id===ident.lordId).k;
const homeVillage=OUTPOSTS.find(o=>o.kingdom===homeK);
return{x:homeVillage.x,y:homeVillage.y+40,level:1,exp:0,expNext:30,gold:50,hp:50,maxHp:50,weaponTier:0,armorTier:0,captured:[homeVillage.id],homeX:homeVillage.x,homeY:homeVillage.y+40,identity:ident.identity,lordId:ident.lordId,surname:ident.surname,givenName:ident.givenName,courtesy:ident.courtesy,homeKingdom:ident.identity==='roam'?-1:homeK,homeVillageId:homeVillage.id,year:184,month:3,day:4,food:100,morale:50};
}
function applyIdentitySetup(){
const p=player;p.stationed=p.stationed||{};
const mkHero=(name,type,lvl)=>{const h=heroDef(name);const maxHp=Math.round((50+lvl*8)*(h.trait==='hp'?1+h.value:1));
return{type,name,icon:h.icon,level:lvl,weaponTier:0,armorTier:0,exp:0,expNext:expNeededForLevel(lvl),hp:maxHp,maxHp,atkBonus:h.trait==='atk'?h.value:0,trait:h.trait,traitValue:h.value,loyalty:h.loyalty,lastGift:weekIdx(),variableLoyalty:!!h.variableLoyalty,sworn:!h.variableLoyalty&&type==='brother'};};
if(p.identity==='fixed'){
const cap=CAPITALS.find(c=>c.id===p.lordId);
p.capturedCapitals=[cap.id];p.x=cap.x;p.y=cap.y+60;p.homeX=p.x;p.homeY=p.y;
p.gold=400;p.food=(p.food||0)+150;
p.stationed[settlementKey('capital',cap)]=180;
const mi=MERCS.findIndex(m=>m.kingdom===cap.id);
if(mi>=0){mercs[mi]=8;mercHp[mi]=MERCS[mi].hp*8;}
if(p.lordId===4){// 董卓模式
p.level=10;p.exp=0;p.expNext=expNeededForLevel?expNeededForLevel(10):300;p.maxHp=50+9*8;p.hp=p.maxHp;p.gold=2500;p.food=(p.food||0)+400;
p.weaponTier=Math.min(WEAPONS.length-1,4);p.armorTier=Math.min(ARMORS.length-1,4);
p.stationed[settlementKey('capital',cap)]=700;
p.capturedCheckpoints=CHECKPOINTS.filter(c=>c.key.startsWith('spoke_')).map(c=>c.key);
for(const c of CHECKPOINTS)if(c.key.startsWith('spoke_'))p.stationed[settlementKey('checkpoint',c)]=180;
if(mi>=0){mercs[mi]=30;mercHp[mi]=MERCS[mi].hp*30;}
p.brother=mkHero('呂布','brother',14);
p.hist=p.hist||{};p.hist.lvbuPre=true;
}
}else if(p.identity==='roam'){
const start={liubei:['關羽','brother'],caocao:['夏侯惇','brother'],sunjian:['程普','brother']}[p.lordId];
if(start)p[start[1]]=mkHero(start[0],start[1],3);
p.gold=150;
}
}
function formatDate(year,month,day){
return '公元'+year+'年'+month+'月'+(day?day+'日':'');
}
const CAMPAIGN_END={year:192,month:5};
function advanceWeek(){
if(player.year===undefined){player.year=184;player.month=3;player.day=4;}
player.day+=7;
while(player.day>30){player.day-=30;player.month++;}
while(player.month>12){player.month-=12;player.year++;}
checkCampaignEnd();
}
function checkCampaignEnd(){
if(gameOver)return;
if(player.year>CAMPAIGN_END.year||(player.year===CAMPAIGN_END.year&&player.month>=CAMPAIGN_END.month)){
gameOver=true;
const won=isCapitalCaptured(4);
document.getElementById('gameOverTitle').textContent=won?'👑 通關':'💀 遊戲結束';
document.getElementById('gameOverText').textContent=won&&isDong()?'你守住了洛陽,挾天子以令諸侯,天下莫敢不從!董卓模式 —— 通關。':won?'你在時限內攻克了中央帝都,天下歸於一統!序章:黃巾之亂 —— 完。（第二章敬請期待）':'時限已到(公元'+CAMPAIGN_END.year+'年'+CAMPAIGN_END.month+'月),你未能攻下中央帝都,群雄割據的亂世仍在持續…';
document.getElementById('gameOverModal').classList.remove('hidden');
}
}
function unstick(o){
if(!o||o.x===undefined||canMoveTo(o.x,o.y))return;
for(let r=40;r<=800;r+=40)for(let a=0;a<16;a++){const x=o.x+Math.cos(a/16*Math.PI*2)*r,y=o.y+Math.sin(a/16*Math.PI*2)*r;if(x>0&&y>0&&x<WORLD&&y<WORLD&&canMoveTo(x,y)){o.x=x;o.y=y;return;}}
}
function applySave(d){
player=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d.player||defaultState()));
if(player.homeX===undefined){player.homeX=player.x;player.homeY=player.y;}
if(player.homeKingdom===undefined)player.homeKingdom=0;
if(player.homeVillageId===undefined){
const fallback=OUTPOSTS.find(o=>o.kingdom===player.homeKingdom);
player.homeVillageId=fallback?fallback.id:undefined;
}
if(player.year===undefined||player.year<0){player.year=184;player.month=3;player.day=4;}
if(player.day===undefined)player.day=4;
if(player.food===undefined)player.food=100;
if(player.morale===undefined)player.morale=100;
if(player.companion===undefined)player.companion=null;
if(player.brother===undefined)player.brother=null;
if(!player.hist)player.hist={};
for(const ref of ['companion','brother']){const c=player[ref];if(c&&c.loyalty===undefined){const h=heroDef(c.name);c.loyalty=ref==='brother'?100:(h?h.loyalty:70);c.lastGift=weekIdx();}if(c&&ref==='brother'&&c.sworn===undefined)c.sworn=!c.variableLoyalty&&c.loyalty>=100;}
if(player.companion&&player.companion.exp===undefined)player.companion.exp=0;
if(player.brother&&player.brother.exp===undefined)player.brother.exp=0;
if(player.companion)player.companion.expNext=expNeededForLevel(player.companion.level);
if(player.brother)player.brother.expNext=expNeededForLevel(player.brother.level);
if(!mercUpgrade)mercUpgrade={};
if(!player.inventory)player.inventory={};
if(!player.buffs)player.buffs={};
if(!player.captured)player.captured=[];
if(!player.capturedCheckpoints)player.capturedCheckpoints=[];
if(!player.capturedCapitals)player.capturedCapitals=[];
if(!player.stationed)player.stationed={};
mercs=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d.mercs||{}));
mercTier=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d.mercTier||{}));
mercExp=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d.mercExp||{}));
mercHp=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d.mercHp||{}));
mercUpgrade=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d.mercUpgrade||{}));
recruitPool=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d.recruitPool||{}));
if(d.npcs&&d.npcs.length){npcs=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d.npcs));}
else{
initNpc();
if(d.npc){const old=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d.npc));const def=ROAMING.find(r=>r.id===npcs[0].id);Object.assign(npcs[0],old,{id:def.id,name:def.name,icon:def.icon,color:def.color});}// 舊存檔的NPC領主轉為第一位流動勢力
}
for(const nn of npcs){
npc=nn;
const def=ROAMING.find(r=>r.id===nn.id);if(def){nn.atkMult=def.atkMult||1;nn.expMult=def.expMult||1;nn.troopCost=def.troopCost||1;}
if(npc.x===undefined){npc.x=QUAD;npc.y=QUAD;npc.icon='🤴';npc.target=null;}
if(npc&&!npc.captured)npc.captured=[];
if(npc&&!npc.capturedCapitals)npc.capturedCapitals=[];
if(npc&&!npc.capturedCheckpoints)npc.capturedCheckpoints=[];
if(npc&&npc.avoidKey===undefined)npc.avoidKey=null;
if(npc&&npc.homeVillageId===undefined)npc.homeVillageId=npc.captured&&npc.captured[0];
if(npc&&npc.army!==undefined&&npc.hp===undefined){
npc.maxHp=Math.max(50,Math.round(npc.army));
npc.hp=npc.maxHp;
npc.exp=0;npc.expNext=Math.max(30,npc.level*30);
npc.gold=Math.max(50,npc.level*20);
npc.weaponTier=Math.min(WEAPONS.length-1,Math.floor(npc.level/8));
npc.armorTier=Math.min(ARMORS.length-1,Math.floor(npc.level/8));
delete npc.army;
}
if(npc&&!npc.inventory)npc.inventory={};
}
npc=npcs[0]||null;
unstick(player);npcs.forEach(unstick);// 地形平滑化後,舊存檔位置若落在山裡就移出
}
const SAVE_SLOTS=5;
let activeSlot=null;
let CURRENT_CHAPTER='序章:黃巾之亂';
function refreshChapter(){
const h=(player&&player.hist)||{};
CURRENT_CHAPTER=h.coal?'第二章:群雄討董':h.dong?'第一章:董卓亂政':'序章:黃巾之亂';
return CURRENT_CHAPTER;
}
let dbNamespace=null;
async function initDb(){
try{
if(!window.claude)return;
const db=await window.claude.use('db');
if(db)dbNamespace=db;
}catch(e){}
}
function dbDocForSlot(n){return dbNamespace?dbNamespace.doc('game/save'+n):null;}
function formatSaveTime(ts){
if(!ts)return'';
const d=new Date(ts);
const pad=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');
return(d.getMonth()+1)+'/'+d.getDate()+' '+pad(d.getHours())+':'+pad(d.getMinutes());
}
async function peekSlot(n){
const doc=dbDocForSlot(n);
if(doc){
try{
const snap=await doc.get();
if(snap.exists){const d=snap.data();return{has:true,level:(d.player&&d.player.level)||1,savedAt:d.savedAt,chapter:d.chapter,year:d.player&&d.player.year,month:d.player&&d.player.month,data:d};}
}catch(e){}
}
try{
const s=localStorage.getItem('hq_save_slot_'+n);
if(s){const d=JSON.parse(s);return{has:true,level:(d.player&&d.player.level)||1,savedAt:d.savedAt,chapter:d.chapter,year:d.player&&d.player.year,month:d.player&&d.player.month,data:d};}
}catch(e){}
return{has:false};
}
function slotLabel(n,info){
if(!info.has)return'空白欄位'+n;
const chapter=info.chapter||CURRENT_CHAPTER;
const year=info.year!==undefined?info.year:184;
const month=info.month!==undefined?info.month:1;
return chapter+' Lv'+info.level+' 公元'+year+'.'+month;
}
async function migrateLegacySave(){
const slot1=await peekSlot(1);
if(slot1.has)return;
let legacy=null;
if(dbNamespace){
try{const snap=await dbNamespace.doc('game/save').get();if(snap.exists)legacy=snap.data();}catch(e){}
}
if(!legacy){
try{const s=localStorage.getItem('hq_save_v1');if(s)legacy=JSON.parse(s);}catch(e){}
}
if(legacy){
const doc1=dbDocForSlot(1);
if(doc1){try{await doc1.set(legacy);}catch(e){}}
try{localStorage.setItem('hq_save_slot_1',JSON.stringify(legacy));}catch(e){}
}
}
async function saveToSlot(n){
const payload={player,mercs,mercTier,mercExp,mercHp,mercUpgrade,recruitPool,npc:npcs[0]||null,npcs,savedAt:Date.now(),chapter:refreshChapter()};
let ok=false;
const doc=dbDocForSlot(n);
if(doc){
try{await doc.set(payload);ok=true;}catch(e){}
}
try{localStorage.setItem('hq_save_slot_'+n,JSON.stringify(payload));ok=true;}catch(e){}
return ok;
}
function exportSaveCode(){
const payload={player,mercs,mercTier,mercExp,mercHp,mercUpgrade,recruitPool,npc:npcs[0]||null,npcs,savedAt:Date.now(),chapter:refreshChapter()};
try{return btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(payload))));}catch(e){return null;}
}
async function importSaveCode(code,n){
try{
const json=decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(code.trim())));
const d=JSON.parse(json);
if(!d.player)return false;
const doc=dbDocForSlot(n);
if(doc){try{await doc.set(d);}catch(e){}}
try{localStorage.setItem('hq_save_slot_'+n,JSON.stringify(d));}catch(e){}
return true;
}catch(e){return false;}
}
let manualSaveArmed=null;
async function renderManualSaveSlots(){
let html='';
for(let n=1;n<=5;n++){
const info=await peekSlot(n);
const label=slotLabel(n,info);
const armed=manualSaveArmed===n;
const btnStyle=armed?'background:#7a1a1a;color:#fff;font-weight:900;':'';
const btnLabel=armed?(n===activeSlot?'確定覆蓋目前存檔?':'確定覆蓋?'):(n===activeSlot?label+'（目前使用中）':label);
html+=`<button class="buy" data-saveslot="${n}" style="${btnStyle}">${btnLabel}</button>`;
}
html+=`<div style="border-top:1px solid #0002;margin-top:8px;padding-top:8px;">
<button class="buy" id="exportSaveBtn" style="width:100%;">📤 匯出目前進度為存檔碼(手動備份)</button>
<textarea id="exportSaveText" readonly style="width:100%;height:60px;margin-top:6px;font-size:10px;display:none;" onclick="this.select()"></textarea>
<button class="buy" id="showImportBtn" style="width:100%;margin-top:6px;">📥 貼上存檔碼還原</button>
<div id="importSaveArea" style="display:none;margin-top:6px;">
<textarea id="importSaveText" placeholder="貼上存檔碼..." style="width:100%;height:60px;font-size:10px;"></textarea>
<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:6px;">
${[1,2,3,4,5].map(n=>`<button class="buy" data-importslot="${n}" style="flex:1;font-size:11px;padding:6px 2px;">存到${n}</button>`).join('')}
</div>
</div>
</div>`;
document.getElementById('manualSaveSlots').innerHTML=html;
document.querySelectorAll('#manualSaveSlots [data-saveslot]').forEach(b=>{
b.onclick=async()=>{
const n=+b.dataset.saveslot;
if(manualSaveArmed!==n){
manualSaveArmed=n;
renderManualSaveSlots();
return;
}
manualSaveArmed=null;
const ok=await saveToSlot(n);
showToast(ok?'📥 已存到存檔'+n+'!':'⚠️ 存檔失敗');
document.getElementById('manualSaveModal').classList.add('hidden');
};
});
const exportBtn=document.getElementById('exportSaveBtn');
if(exportBtn)exportBtn.onclick=()=>{
const code=exportSaveCode();
const ta=document.getElementById('exportSaveText');
if(code){ta.value=code;ta.style.display='block';ta.select();}
else showToast('⚠️ 匯出失敗');
};
const showImportBtn=document.getElementById('showImportBtn');
if(showImportBtn)showImportBtn.onclick=()=>{
document.getElementById('importSaveArea').style.display='block';
};
document.querySelectorAll('#manualSaveSlots [data-importslot]').forEach(b=>{
b.onclick=async()=>{
const n=+b.dataset.importslot;
const code=document.getElementById('importSaveText').value;
if(!code)return;
const ok=await importSaveCode(code,n);
showToast(ok?'📥 已還原到存檔'+n+'!':'⚠️ 存檔碼無效');
if(ok)document.getElementById('manualSaveModal').classList.add('hidden');
};
});
}
document.getElementById('manualSaveBtn').onclick=()=>{manualSaveArmed=null;renderManualSaveSlots();document.getElementById('manualSaveModal').classList.remove('hidden');};
document.getElementById('manualSaveClose').onclick=()=>document.getElementById('manualSaveModal').classList.add('hidden');
async function save(){
if(!activeSlot)return;
const payload={player,mercs,mercTier,mercExp,mercHp,mercUpgrade,recruitPool,npc:npcs[0]||null,npcs,savedAt:Date.now(),chapter:refreshChapter()};
let ok=false;
const doc=dbDocForSlot(activeSlot);
if(doc){
try{await doc.set(payload);ok=true;}catch(e){}
}
try{localStorage.setItem('hq_save_slot_'+activeSlot,JSON.stringify(payload));ok=true;}catch(e){}
if(ok){
const ic=document.getElementById('saveIcon');
ic.classList.add('flash');
setTimeout(()=>ic.classList.remove('flash'),500);
}else{
document.getElementById('saveWarn').classList.remove('hidden');
}
}

let autoSaveIntervalId=null;
let cachedAutoSaveMin=1;
async function loadAutoSaveSetting(){
if(dbNamespace){
try{
const snap=await dbNamespace.doc('settings/autosave').get();
if(snap.exists&&snap.data().min){cachedAutoSaveMin=snap.data().min;return;}
}catch(e){}
}
try{const ls=localStorage.getItem('hq_autosave_min');if(ls)cachedAutoSaveMin=parseInt(ls);}catch(e){}
}
function getAutoSaveMs(){return cachedAutoSaveMin*60000;}
function restartAutoSave(){
if(autoSaveIntervalId)clearInterval(autoSaveIntervalId);
autoSaveIntervalId=setInterval(save,getAutoSaveMs());
}
async function setAutoSaveMin(min){
cachedAutoSaveMin=min;
if(dbNamespace){
try{await dbNamespace.doc('settings/autosave').set({min});}catch(e){}
}
try{localStorage.setItem('hq_autosave_min',min);}catch(e){}
if(activeSlot)restartAutoSave();
renderAutoSaveOptions();
}
function renderAutoSaveOptions(){
const current=String(cachedAutoSaveMin);
const opts=[1,5,15,30];
let html='';
opts.forEach(m=>{
const active=String(m)===current;
html+=`<button class="buy" data-min="${m}" style="${active?'background:var(--gold);font-weight:900;':''}">${m} 分鐘${active?' ✓ 目前設定':''}</button>`;
});
document.getElementById('autoSaveOptions').innerHTML=html;
document.querySelectorAll('#autoSaveOptions button').forEach(b=>{
b.onclick=()=>setAutoSaveMin(+b.dataset.min);
});
}
document.getElementById('settingsClose').onclick=()=>document.getElementById('settingsModal').classList.add('hidden');
document.getElementById('heroRenameBtn').onclick=()=>{
if(!player)return;
if(player.identity==='fixed'||player.identity==='roam'){showToast('此身分的姓名固定,無法更改');return;}
document.getElementById('renameSur').value=player.surname||'';
document.getElementById('renameGiven').value=player.givenName||'';
document.getElementById('renameErr').textContent='';
document.getElementById('renameModal').classList.remove('hidden');
};
document.getElementById('renameCancel').onclick=()=>document.getElementById('renameModal').classList.add('hidden');
document.getElementById('renameConfirm').onclick=()=>{
const sur=document.getElementById('renameSur').value.trim(),giv=document.getElementById('renameGiven').value.trim();
if(!sur||!giv){document.getElementById('renameErr').textContent='請填寫姓和名';return;}
player.surname=sur;player.givenName=giv;
document.getElementById('renameModal').classList.add('hidden');
updateHud();save();
};
const TIER_NAMES=['普通','老兵','菁英'];
const TIER_MULT=[1,1.4,1.8];
const TIER_EXP=[0,300,1000];
function mercTierOf(k){return mercTier[k]||0;}
function mercExpOf(k){return mercExp[k]||0;}
function mercMaxHp(k){
const eliteMult=1+((mercUpgrade[k]||0)*0.25);
return Math.round(MERCS[k].hp*TIER_MULT[mercTierOf(k)]*eliteMult)*(mercs[k]||0);
}
function mercCurHp(k){
const max=mercMaxHp(k);
if(mercHp[k]===undefined)return max;
return Math.min(max,mercHp[k]);
}

function troopCap(){return player.level*2;}
function mercCount(){let t=0;for(const k in mercs)t+=mercs[k]||0;return t;}
function weaponBonus(){return WEAPONS[player.weaponTier].v;}
function activeBuffMult(who,stat){
if(!who||!who.buffs)return 1;
const b=who.buffs[stat];
if(!b||turnCount>=b.until)return 1;
return 1+b.value;
}
function armorBonus(){return Math.round(ARMORS[player.armorTier].v*activeBuffMult(player,'def'));}
function baseAtk(){return Math.round((8+player.level*2+weaponBonus())*activeBuffMult(player,'atk')*(player.jade?1.1:1)*lordPerk('atk'));}
const ITEMS={
heal_s:{name:'金創藥(小)',icon:'🧪',type:'heal',value:30,cost:20},
heal_m:{name:'金創藥(中)',icon:'🧪',type:'heal',value:80,cost:60},
heal_l:{name:'金創藥(大)',icon:'🧪',type:'heal',value:200,cost:150},
atk_pill:{name:'龍力丹',icon:'💊',type:'buffAtk',value:0.3,duration:5,cost:120},
def_pill:{name:'鐵壁丹',icon:'💊',type:'buffDef',value:0.3,duration:5,cost:120}
};
function renderFood(){
const isCapital=currentSettlement&&currentSettlement.type==='capital';
const isCenter=isCapital&&currentSettlement.obj.isCenter;
const pricePerUnit=isCenter?0.35:isCapital?0.22:0.12;
const batches=[50,100,200];
let html=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><span>目前糧食:${player.food||0}　士氣:${player.morale||0}</span></div></div>`;
batches.forEach(amt=>{
const cost=Math.round(amt*pricePerUnit);
const canBuy=player.gold>=cost;
html+=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>🌾 糧食 x${amt}</b><span>💰${cost}</span></div><button class="buy" data-amt="${amt}" data-cost="${cost}" ${canBuy?'':'disabled'}>購買</button></div>`;
});
document.getElementById('foodPane').innerHTML=html;
document.querySelectorAll('#foodPane .buy').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
const amt=+b.dataset.amt,cost=+b.dataset.cost;
if(player.gold<cost)return;
player.gold-=cost;
player.food=(player.food||0)+amt;
updateHud();save();renderFood();
});
}
function renderPharmacy(){
const isCapital=currentSettlement&&currentSettlement.type==='capital';
const keys=isCapital?Object.keys(ITEMS):['heal_s','heal_m'];
let html='';
keys.forEach(k=>{
const it=ITEMS[k];
const desc=(it.type==='heal'?'恢復 '+it.value+' 生命':'持續 '+it.duration+' 回合,'+(it.type==='buffAtk'?'攻擊':'防禦')+'力 +'+Math.round(it.value*100)+'%')+'　💰'+it.cost;
const canBuy=player.gold>=it.cost;
html+=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>${it.icon} ${it.name}</b><span>${desc}</span></div><button class="buy" data-k="${k}" ${canBuy?'':'disabled'}>購買</button></div>`;
});
document.getElementById('pharmacyPane').innerHTML=html;
document.querySelectorAll('#pharmacyPane .buy').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
const k=b.dataset.k,it=ITEMS[k];
if(player.gold<it.cost)return;
player.gold-=it.cost;
player.inventory=player.inventory||{};
player.inventory[k]=(player.inventory[k]||0)+1;
updateHud();save();renderPharmacy();
});
}
function rollItemDrop(level){
if(level<=5)return null;
if(Math.random()>=0.35)return null;
const roll=Math.random();
let key;
if(level<15){
key=roll<0.75?'heal_s':'heal_m';
}else if(level<25){
key=roll<0.35?'heal_m':roll<0.55?'heal_s':roll<0.78?'atk_pill':'def_pill';
}else{
key=roll<0.35?'heal_l':roll<0.5?'heal_m':roll<0.75?'atk_pill':'def_pill';
}
player.inventory=player.inventory||{};
player.inventory[key]=(player.inventory[key]||0)+1;
return ITEMS[key];
}
function useItem(key,target){
target=target||'player';
const it=ITEMS[key];
if(!it||!player.inventory||!player.inventory[key])return;
if(target!=='player'&&it.type!=='heal')return;
const who=target==='player'?player:player[target];
if(!who)return;
if(it.type==='heal'&&who.hp>=who.maxHp)return;
player.inventory[key]--;
if(player.inventory[key]<=0)delete player.inventory[key];
if(it.type==='heal'){
who.hp=Math.min(who.maxHp,who.hp+it.value);
showToast('🧪 對'+(target==='player'?'英雄':who.name)+'使用了'+it.name+',恢復 '+it.value+' 生命');
}else if(it.type==='buffAtk'){
player.buffs=player.buffs||{};
player.buffs.atk={value:it.value,until:turnCount+it.duration};
showToast('💊 使用了'+it.name+',攻擊力暫時提升!');
}else if(it.type==='buffDef'){
player.buffs=player.buffs||{};
player.buffs.def={value:it.value,until:turnCount+it.duration};
showToast('💊 使用了'+it.name+',防禦力暫時提升!');
}
updateHud();save();renderInventory();renderStatus();
}
// ---- 裝備袋:遣散/離隊武將的裝備存放處,可裝給任何人 ----
function stashGear(c){
if(!c)return;player.gearBag=player.gearBag||[];
if(c.weaponTier>0)player.gearBag.push({kind:'w',tier:c.weaponTier});
if(c.armorTier>0)player.gearBag.push({kind:'a',tier:c.armorTier});
c.weaponTier=0;c.armorTier=0;
}
function equipFromBag(i,ref){
const bag=player.gearBag||[],g=bag[i];if(!g)return;
const t=ref==='player'?player:player[ref];if(!t)return;
const list=g.kind==='w'?WEAPONS:ARMORS,field=g.kind==='w'?'weaponTier':'armorTier';
if((t.level||1)<list[g.tier].lvl)return;
const old=t[field]||0;t[field]=g.tier;bag.splice(i,1);
if(old>0)bag.push({kind:g.kind,tier:old});
showToast('🗡️ '+(ref==='player'?'你':t.name)+' 裝備了 '+list[g.tier].n);
updateHud();save();renderInventory();
}
function renderGearBag(){
const bag=player.gearBag||[];if(!bag.length)return '';
let html='<div style="font-weight:700;margin:6px 0 4px;">🗡️ 裝備</div>';
bag.forEach((g,i)=>{
const it=(g.kind==='w'?WEAPONS:ARMORS)[g.tier];
const targets=[['player','自己',player]].concat(player.companion?[['companion',player.companion.name,player.companion]]:[],player.brother?[['brother',player.brother.name,player.brother]]:[]);
const btns=targets.map(([ref,label,t])=>{const ok=(t.level||1)>=it.lvl;return `<button class="buy" style="font-size:11px;padding:4px 6px;" data-gear="${i}" data-to="${ref}" ${ok?'':'disabled'}>${ok?'給'+label:label+'等級不足'}</button>`;}).join('');
html+=`<div class="item" style="flex-wrap:wrap;"><div class="info"><b>${g.kind==='w'?'⚔️':'🛡️'} ${it.n}(+${it.v})</b><span>${RARITY_NAMES[it.r]||''}　需求 Lv.${it.lvl}</span></div><div style="display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;">${btns}</div></div>`;
});
return html;
}
function renderInventory(){
const inv=player.inventory||{};
const keys=Object.keys(inv).filter(k=>inv[k]>0);
let html='';
if(keys.length===0&&!(player.gearBag||[]).length){
html='<div class="item"><div class="info"><span>目前沒有任何物品,打倒怪物有機會獲得掉落</span></div></div>';
}else{
keys.forEach(k=>{
const it=ITEMS[k];
if(!it)return;
const desc=it.type==='heal'?'恢復 '+it.value+' 生命':'持續 '+it.duration+' 回合,'+(it.type==='buffAtk'?'攻擊':'防禦')+'力 +'+Math.round(it.value*100)+'%';
const atFullHp=it.type==='heal'&&player.hp>=player.maxHp;
html+=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>${it.icon} ${it.name} x${inv[k]}</b><span>${atFullHp?'生命值已全滿':desc}</span></div><button class="buy" data-k="${k}" ${atFullHp?'disabled':''}>使用</button></div>`;
});
}
html+=renderGearBag();
document.getElementById('invBody').innerHTML=html;
document.querySelectorAll('#invBody .buy[data-k]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>useItem(b.dataset.k));
document.querySelectorAll('#invBody .buy[data-gear]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>equipFromBag(+b.dataset.gear,b.dataset.to));
}
document.getElementById('invBtn').onclick=()=>{renderInventory();document.getElementById('invModal').classList.remove('hidden');};
document.getElementById('invClose').onclick=()=>document.getElementById('invModal').classList.add('hidden');

function levelForPosition(x,y){
const dist=Math.hypot(x-QUAD,y-QUAD);
const maxDist=Math.hypot(QUAD-100,QUAD-100);
const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,1-dist/maxDist));
const base=1+t*29;
return Math.max(1,Math.round(base+(Math.random()*6-3)));
}
function spawnMonster(px,py){
let x=px,y=py;
if(x===undefined){
let reject=true;
do{
x=40+Math.random()*(WORLD-80);y=40+Math.random()*(WORLD-80);
reject=nearAnyCapital(x,y,300)||!canMoveTo(x,y);
if(!reject){
const tt=terrainAt(x,y);
if(tt==='road')reject=Math.random()<0.9;// 道路上很少純隨機野怪,主要交給攔路小隊
else if(tt==='plain')reject=Math.random()<0.55;// 淺色平原怪較少
// grass(深色草原)全部接受,不拒絕
}
}while(reject);
}
const k=kingdomOf(x,y);
const t=MTYPES[k.types[Math.floor(Math.random()*k.types.length)]];
const lvl=levelForPosition(x,y);
const mult=k.isCenter?1.4:1;
return{x,y,icon:t.icon,name:t.n,level:lvl,hp:Math.round((20+lvl*9)*mult),maxHp:Math.round((20+lvl*9)*mult),atk:Math.round((3+lvl*2)*mult),exp:Math.round((10+lvl*5)*mult),gold:Math.round((5+lvl*3)*mult),alive:true,elem:k.elem};
}
