const CAMP_ART_BY_KINGDOM={0:{k:'tent'},1:{k:'snow'},2:{k:'wood'},3:{k:'wood',flip:true},4:{k:'stone'}};
const CAMP_ART_IMG={};
function campArtFor(kid){
const cfg=CAMP_ART_BY_KINGDOM[kid];if(!cfg||typeof Image==='undefined')return null;
if(!CAMP_ART_IMG[cfg.k]){const im=new Image();im.src=CAMP_ART_SRC[cfg.k];CAMP_ART_IMG[cfg.k]=im;}
return{img:CAMP_ART_IMG[cfg.k],flip:!!cfg.flip};
}
let campCenters=[];
function spawnKingdomAreaMonster(k,cx,cy,existing){
let mx,my,tries=0,found=false;
const cellSize=QUAD/10;
while(tries<20){
mx=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,cx+(Math.random()-0.5)*cellSize*0.9));
my=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,cy+(Math.random()-0.5)*cellSize*0.9));
const nearVillage=OUTPOSTS.some(o=>o.kingdom===k.id&&Math.hypot(mx-o.x,my-o.y)<640);
const cap=CAPITALS.find(c=>c.id===k.id);
const nearCapital=cap&&Math.hypot(mx-cap.x,my-cap.y)<640;
const tooClose=existing&&existing.some(p=>Math.hypot(mx-p.x,my-p.y)<80);
if(canMoveTo(mx,my)&&!nearVillage&&!nearCapital&&!tooClose){found=true;break;}
tries++;
}
if(!found)return null;
const m=spawnMonster(mx,my);
m.level=Math.max(1,Math.min(5,m.level));
const mult=k.isCenter?1.4:1;
m.maxHp=Math.round((20+m.level*9)*mult);m.hp=m.maxHp;
m.atk=Math.round((3+m.level*2)*mult);
m.exp=Math.round((10+m.level*5)*mult);
m.gold=Math.round((5+m.level*3)*mult);
m.kingdomAreaId=k.id;
return m;
}
function nearMountainFoot(x,y){
const v=fMount(x,y);
return v<0&&v>-0.22;// 剛好在山腳邊緣(山脈之外、緊鄰山體)
}
function initMonsters(){
monsters=[];campCenters=[];
KINGDOMS.forEach(k=>{
let cx,cy,tries=0,foundFoot=false;
const isCenterArea=k.isCenter;
const baseX=isCenterArea?0:k.qx*QUAD,baseY=isCenterArea?0:k.qy*QUAD;
while(tries<400){
if(isCenterArea){cx=QUAD+(Math.random()-0.5)*1600;cy=QUAD+(Math.random()-0.5)*1600;}
else{cx=baseX+150+Math.random()*(QUAD-300);cy=baseY+150+Math.random()*(QUAD-300);}
tries++;
if(nearAnyCapital(cx,cy,440)||!canMoveTo(cx,cy))continue;
if(nearMountainFoot(cx,cy)){foundFoot=true;break;}
}
if(!foundFoot){
if(isCenterArea){
do{cx=QUAD+(Math.random()-0.5)*1600;cy=QUAD+(Math.random()-0.5)*1600;}
while(nearAnyCapital(cx,cy,440)||!canMoveTo(cx,cy));
}else{
do{cx=baseX+150+Math.random()*(QUAD-300);cy=baseY+150+Math.random()*(QUAD-300);}
while(nearAnyCapital(cx,cy,440)||!canMoveTo(cx,cy));
}
}
campCenters.push({x:cx,y:cy,id:k.id});
for(let i=0;i<CAMP_SIZE;i++){
let mx,my,tries=0;
do{
mx=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,cx+(Math.random()-0.5)*100));
my=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,cy+(Math.random()-0.5)*100));
tries++;
}while(!canMoveTo(mx,my)&&tries<15);
if(!canMoveTo(mx,my)){mx=cx;my=cy;}
const m=spawnMonster(mx,my);
m.camp=k.id;
monsters.push(m);
}
});
for(let i=0;i<1120;i++)monsters.push(spawnMonster());
// 攔路打劫:沿道路零星佈置複數小隊,只在可通行處生成,不落在山脈/水域
ROADS.forEach(r=>{
const len=Math.hypot(r.x2-r.x1,r.y2-r.y1);
const groups=Math.max(1,Math.round(len/900));
for(let g=0;g<groups;g++){
const t=(g+0.5)/groups+(Math.random()-0.5)*0.15;
const bx=r.x1+(r.x2-r.x1)*t,by=r.y1+(r.y2-r.y1)*t;
if(nearAnyCapital(bx,by,320)||!canMoveTo(bx,by))continue;
const size=2+Math.floor(Math.random()*3);// 2-4隻一隊
for(let i2=0;i2<size;i2++){
let mx,my,tries=0;
do{
mx=bx+(Math.random()-0.5)*90;
my=by+(Math.random()-0.5)*90;
tries++;
}while(!canMoveTo(mx,my)&&tries<15);
if(!canMoveTo(mx,my)){mx=bx;my=by;}
const m=spawnMonster(mx,my);
m.roadAmbush=true;
monsters.push(m);
}
}
});
KINGDOMS.forEach(k=>{
if(k.isCenter)return;
const baseX=k.qx*QUAD,baseY=k.qy*QUAD;
const cellSize=QUAD/10;
const placed=[];
for(let gx=0;gx<10;gx++){
for(let gy=0;gy<10;gy++){
const cx=baseX+(gx+0.5)*cellSize,cy=baseY+(gy+0.5)*cellSize;
const m=spawnKingdomAreaMonster(k,cx,cy,placed);
if(m){placed.push({x:m.x,y:m.y});monsters.push(m);}
}
}
});
}

const OUTPOSTS=KINGDOMS.flatMap(k=>{
if(k.isCenter){
return[
{id:k.id*2,name:k.name+'-東鎮',x:QUAD+600,y:QUAD-600,kingdom:k.id},
{id:k.id*2+1,name:k.name+'-西鎮',x:QUAD-600,y:QUAD+600,kingdom:k.id}
];
}
const corner=kingdomCorner(k);
const alongX=k.qx===0?700:WORLD-700,alongY=k.qy===0?700:WORLD-700;
return[
{id:k.id*2,name:k.name+'-邊境東鎮',x:alongX,y:corner.y,kingdom:k.id},
{id:k.id*2+1,name:k.name+'-邊境西鎮',x:corner.x,y:alongY,kingdom:k.id}
];
});
let garrisons=[];
function isCaptured(id){return (player.captured||[]).includes(id);}
function makeGarrison(o){
const lvl=player.level+3;
const k=KINGDOMS.find(x=>x.id===o.kingdom);
const mult=k&&k.isCenter?1.5:1;
return{x:o.x,y:o.y,icon:'🎖️',name:o.name+' 駐守官兵',level:lvl,hp:Math.round((40+lvl*12)*mult),maxHp:Math.round((40+lvl*12)*mult),atk:Math.round((6+lvl*3)*mult),exp:Math.round((30+lvl*8)*mult),gold:Math.round((20+lvl*6)*mult),alive:true,outpostId:o.id,elem:k?k.elem:null};
}
function initOutposts(){
garrisons=OUTPOSTS.filter(o=>!isCaptured(o.id)).map(makeGarrison);
}

function isCapitalCaptured(id){return (player.capturedCapitals||[]).includes(id);}
function canChallengeCapital(c){
if(!c.isCenter)return true;
return[0,1,2,3].every(id=>isCapitalCaptured(id));
}
let capitalGuards=[];
function makeCapitalGuard(c){
const lvl=player.level+15;
const mult=(c.isCenter?2.2:1.8)*histCapMult(c.id);
const k=KINGDOMS.find(x=>x.id===c.id);
return{x:c.x,y:c.y,icon:'👑',name:c.name+' 王城守軍',level:lvl,hp:Math.round((60+lvl*15)*mult),maxHp:Math.round((60+lvl*15)*mult),atk:Math.round((10+lvl*4)*mult),exp:Math.round((50+lvl*10)*mult),gold:Math.round((40+lvl*8)*mult),alive:true,capitalId:c.id,elem:k?k.elem:null};
}
function initCapitalGuards(){
capitalGuards=CAPITALS.filter(c=>!isCapitalCaptured(c.id)).map(makeCapitalGuard);
}

const PATROL_RANGE=900;
let patrols=[];
function makeCapitalPatrol(c){
let x,y,tries=0;
do{
x=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,c.x+(Math.random()-0.5)*PATROL_RANGE*2));
y=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,c.y+(Math.random()-0.5)*PATROL_RANGE*2));
tries++;
}while(!canMoveTo(x,y)&&tries<20);
const p=spawnMonster(x,y);
const homeLvl=levelForPosition(c.x,c.y);
p.level=homeLvl;
p.hp=Math.round(20+homeLvl*9);p.maxHp=p.hp;p.atk=Math.round(3+homeLvl*2);
p.exp=Math.round(10+homeLvl*5);p.gold=Math.round(5+homeLvl*3);
const mult=c.isCenter?2.5:1.5;
p.hp=Math.round(p.hp*mult);p.maxHp=p.hp;p.atk=Math.round(p.atk*mult);
p.exp=Math.round(p.exp*mult);p.gold=Math.round(p.gold*mult);
p.icon='🏇';p.name=c.name+' 禁衛軍';
p.isPatrol=true;p.ownerType='capital';p.kingdomId=c.id;p.homeX=c.x;p.homeY=c.y;p.color=c.color;
return p;
}
function statsAtLevel(level){
return{hp:Math.round(20+level*9),atk:Math.round(3+level*2),exp:Math.round(10+level*5),gold:Math.round(5+level*3)};
}
function makeTownPatrol(o){
let x,y,tries=0;
do{
x=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,o.x+(Math.random()-0.5)*300));
y=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,o.y+(Math.random()-0.5)*300));
tries++;
}while(!canMoveTo(x,y)&&tries<20);
const k=KINGDOMS.find(kk=>kk.id===o.kingdom);
const elem=k?k.elem:undefined;
const cs=statsAtLevel(5);
const captain={icon:'🎖️',name:o.name+' 隊長',level:5,hp:cs.hp,maxHp:cs.hp,atk:cs.atk,exp:cs.exp,gold:cs.gold,alive:true,elem};
const members=[captain];
const ms=statsAtLevel(3);
for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
members.push({icon:'🐎',name:o.name+' 巡邏兵',level:3,hp:ms.hp,maxHp:ms.hp,atk:ms.atk,exp:ms.exp,gold:ms.gold,alive:true,elem});
}
const p={
x,y,icon:'🐎',name:o.name+' 巡邏隊',level:5,
hp:members.reduce((s,m)=>s+m.hp,0),
maxHp:members.reduce((s,m)=>s+m.maxHp,0),
atk:members.reduce((s,m)=>s+m.atk,0),
exp:members.reduce((s,m)=>s+m.exp,0),
gold:members.reduce((s,m)=>s+m.gold,0),
alive:true,elem,members,
isPatrol:true,ownerType:'village',patrolOutpostId:o.id,kingdomId:o.kingdom,homeX:o.x,homeY:o.y,
color:k?k.color:'#888'
};
return p;
}
function patrolFriendly(p){
if(p.ownerType==='capital')return isCapitalCaptured(p.kingdomId);
return isCaptured(p.patrolOutpostId);
}
function initPatrols(){
patrols=[...CAPITALS.map(c=>makeCapitalPatrol(c)),...OUTPOSTS.map(o=>makeTownPatrol(o))];
}

function renderHeroNameHud(){
const nameEl=document.getElementById('heroNameTxt');
if(!nameEl||!player)return;
nameEl.textContent=playerDisplayName();
const canRename=player.identity!=='fixed'&&player.identity!=='roam';
const renameBtn=document.getElementById('heroRenameBtn');
if(renameBtn)renameBtn.style.opacity=canRename?'1':'.35';
const flagWrap=document.getElementById('heroFlagWrap');
if(flagWrap){
const surname=player.surname||(playerLordName()?playerLordName()[0]:'')||'';
if(surname){
const c1=surname[0]||'',c2=surname.length>1?surname[1]:'';
flagWrap.innerHTML='<svg width="16" height="20" viewBox="0 0 16 20">'
+'<line x1="1" y1="19" x2="1" y2="1" stroke="#3b2412" stroke-width="1.6"/>'
+'<path d="M2 2 L14 2 L14 15 L8 12.5 L2 15 Z" fill="'+PLAYER_COLOR+'" stroke="rgba(40,20,5,0.8)" stroke-width="0.8"/>'
+'<text x="8" y="'+(c2?7:9)+'" font-size="'+(c2?7:8)+'" font-weight="700" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">'+c1+'</text>'
+(c2?'<text x="8" y="14" font-size="7" font-weight="700" fill="#fff" text-anchor="middle">'+c2+'</text>':'')
+'</svg>';
}else flagWrap.innerHTML='';
}
}
function updateHud(){
document.getElementById('lvTxt').textContent='Lv.'+player.level;
document.getElementById('expbar').firstElementChild.style.width=(100*player.exp/player.expNext)+'%';
document.getElementById('hpbar').firstElementChild.style.width=(100*player.hp/player.maxHp)+'%';
document.getElementById('gold').textContent='💰 '+player.gold;
document.getElementById('dateTxt').textContent=formatDate(player.year!==undefined?player.year:184,player.month||3,player.day||4)+(unifyActive()&&player.unify.announced?'　🏯 守城 '+player.unify.turns+'/'+UNIFY_TURNS:'');
const moraleIcon=(player.morale||0)<=0?'💀':(player.morale||0)<30?'😟':'🌾';
document.getElementById('foodTxt').textContent=moraleIcon+' '+(player.food||0)+'　士氣'+(player.morale||0);
renderHeroNameHud();
}

function gainExp(v){
v=Math.round(v*lordPerk('exp'));
player.exp+=v;
while(player.exp>=player.expNext){
player.exp-=player.expNext;player.level++;
player.expNext=Math.floor(player.expNext*1.25)+10;
player.maxHp+=8;player.hp=player.maxHp;
}
}
function companionGainExp(c,v){
c.exp+=v;
while(c.exp>=c.expNext){
c.exp-=c.expNext;c.level++;
c.expNext=Math.floor(c.expNext*1.25)+10;
c.maxHp+=8;c.hp=c.maxHp;
}
}
function expNeededForLevel(level){
let exp=30;
for(let i=1;i<level;i++){exp=Math.floor(exp*1.25)+10;}
return exp;
}

function teamTotals(){
let mercAtk=0,mercHpSum=0;
for(const k in mercs){if(mercs[k]>0){const mult=TIER_MULT[mercTierOf(k)];mercAtk+=Math.round(MERCS[k].atk*mult)*mercs[k];mercHpSum+=mercCurHp(k);}}
return{atk:baseAtk()+mercAtk,hpPool:player.hp+mercHpSum,mercAtk,mercHp:mercHpSum};
}
function moraleMult(){
const m=player.morale===undefined?50:player.morale;
return 1+Math.max(-0.5,Math.min(0.5,(m-50)/100));
}
function buildPlayerUnits(){
const mm2=moraleMult();
const bondMult=(player.companion&&player.brother&&player.brother.sworn)?1.05:1;
const units=[{icon:'🧙',name:playerDisplayName(),hp:player.hp,maxHp:player.maxHp,atk:Math.round(baseAtk()*mm2)}];
if(player.companion){
const c=player.companion;
units.push({icon:c.icon,name:c.name,hp:c.hp,maxHp:c.maxHp,atk:Math.round(companionBaseAtk(c)*mm2*bondMult),companionRef:'companion'});
}
if(player.brother){
const c=player.brother;
units.push({icon:c.icon,name:c.name,hp:c.hp,maxHp:c.maxHp,atk:Math.round(companionBaseAtk(c)*mm2*bondMult),companionRef:'brother'});
}
for(const k in mercs){
if(mercs[k]>0){
const mm=MERCS[k],cnt=mercs[k],tier=mercTierOf(k),mult=TIER_MULT[tier];
const eliteMult=1+((mercUpgrade[k]||0)*0.25);
const perHp=Math.round(mm.hp*mult*eliteMult),perAtk=Math.round(mm.atk*mult*eliteMult*mm2);
const totalHp=Math.max(1,mercCurHp(k));
let remainingCount=Math.min(cnt,Math.max(1,Math.ceil(totalHp/perHp)));
let curHp=totalHp-(remainingCount-1)*perHp;
if(curHp<=0)curHp=perHp;
units.push({icon:mm.icon,name:mm.n+TIER_NAMES[tier],hp:curHp,maxHp:perHp,atk:perAtk*remainingCount,mercIdx:+k,perHp,perAtk,remainingCount,startCount:cnt,elem:mm.elem});
}
}
return units;
}
// 戰鬥畫面敵方圖示:與地圖一致的Q版兵士(巡邏隊/村莊守軍/王城守軍/關卡守軍/野怪),其餘維持emoji
function enemyArtKey(x,parent){
if(parent&&parent.ownerType!==undefined)return 'patrol';
if(x.isLvbu||x.hist)return null;
if(x.capitalId!==undefined)return 'capguard';
if(x.checkpointKey!==undefined)return 'cpguard';
if(x.outpostId!==undefined)return 'garrison';
return MONSTER_ART_BY_ICON[x.icon]||null;
}
function buildEnemyUnits(m){
if(m.members)return m.members.map(x=>({icon:x.icon,name:x.name,hp:x.hp,maxHp:x.maxHp,atk:x.atk,elem:x.elem,artKey:enemyArtKey(x,m)}));
return[{icon:m.icon,name:m.name,hp:m.hp,maxHp:m.hp,atk:m.atk,elem:m.elem,artKey:m.isNpcBoss?null:enemyArtKey(m,m.ownerType!==undefined?m:null)}];
}
function aliveUnits(list){return list.filter(u=>u.hp>0);}
function snapshotUnits(list){return list.map(u=>({hp:u.hp,maxHp:u.maxHp,remainingCount:u.remainingCount}));}
function applyDamageToUnit(u,dmg){
if(u.perHp===undefined){
u.hp=Math.max(0,u.hp-dmg);
return;
}
let remaining=dmg;
while(remaining>0&&u.remainingCount>0){
if(u.hp>remaining){
u.hp-=remaining;
remaining=0;
}else{
remaining-=u.hp;
u.remainingCount--;
u.hp=u.remainingCount>0?u.perHp:0;
}
}
u.atk=u.perAtk*u.remainingCount;
}
function simulateBattle(playerUnits,enemyUnits){
const def=armorBonus();
const log=[{p:snapshotUnits(playerUnits),e:snapshotUnits(enemyUnits),atkSide:null,atkIdx:null,defIdx:null}];
function nextAlive(list,startIdx){
for(let i=0;i<list.length;i++){
const idx=(startIdx+i)%list.length;
if(list[idx].hp>0)return idx;
}
return -1;
}
function pickPlayerDefender(){
const aliveIdxs=[];
playerUnits.forEach((u,i)=>{if(u.hp>0)aliveIdxs.push(i);});
if(aliveIdxs.length===0)return -1;
if(aliveIdxs.includes(0)&&aliveIdxs.length>1){
if(Math.random()<0.4)return 0;
const mercIdxs=aliveIdxs.filter(i=>i!==0);
return mercIdxs[Math.floor(Math.random()*mercIdxs.length)];
}
return aliveIdxs[Math.floor(Math.random()*aliveIdxs.length)];
}
let pIdx=0,eIdx=0,guard=0,turn='p';
// ---- 武將個人技能 ----
const skills=activeHeroSkills(),skillNotes=[];
const sk=id=>skills.filter(x=>x.id===id);
let critChance=0,recoilCut=0,heroCut=0,guardUsed=true,betrayChance=0,betrayCount=0,betrayWho='';
for(const x of sk('weaken'))if(x.betray){betrayChance+=x.betray;betrayWho=x.who;}
for(const x of sk('weaken')){enemyUnits.forEach(u=>u.atk=Math.max(1,Math.round(u.atk*(1-x.v))));skillNotes.push(x.who+'「'+x.n+'」');}
for(const x of sk('rally')){playerUnits.forEach(u=>{u.atk=Math.round(u.atk*(1+x.v));if(u.perAtk)u.perAtk=Math.round(u.perAtk*(1+x.v));});skillNotes.push(x.who+'「'+x.n+'」');}
for(const x of sk('selfAtk')){const u=playerUnits.find(u=>u.companionRef===x.ref);if(u)u.atk=Math.round(u.atk*(1+x.v));}
for(const x of sk('healHero')){const u=playerUnits[0];if(u&&u.hp>0&&u.hp<u.maxHp){u.hp=Math.min(u.maxHp,u.hp+Math.round(u.maxHp*x.v));skillNotes.push(x.who+'「'+x.n+'」');}}
for(const x of sk('healAll')){playerUnits.forEach(u=>{if(u.companionRef&&u.hp>0)u.hp=Math.min(u.maxHp,u.hp+Math.round(u.maxHp*x.v));});skillNotes.push(x.who+'「'+x.n+'」');}
for(const x of sk('crit'))critChance+=x.v;
for(const x of sk('recoilCut'))recoilCut+=x.v;
for(const x of sk('heroGuard'))heroCut+=x.v;
if(sk('guard').length)guardUsed=false;
for(const x of sk('volley')){
const src=playerUnits.find(u=>u.companionRef===x.ref);if(!src)continue;
const dmg=Math.max(1,Math.round(src.atk*x.v));
enemyUnits.forEach(u=>{if(u.hp>0)applyDamageToUnit(u,dmg);});
skillNotes.push(x.who+'「'+x.n+'」');
}
if(sk('volley').length)log.push({p:snapshotUnits(playerUnits),e:snapshotUnits(enemyUnits),atkSide:null,atkIdx:null,defIdx:null});
const toughOf=u=>{let m=1;if(u.companionRef)for(const x of sk('selfTough'))if(x.ref===u.companionRef)m*=1-x.v;if(u===playerUnits[0])m*=1-heroCut;return m;};
while(aliveUnits(playerUnits).length&&aliveUnits(enemyUnits).length&&guard<200){
guard++;
const playerAttacks=turn==='p';
const atkList=playerAttacks?playerUnits:enemyUnits;
const defList=playerAttacks?enemyUnits:playerUnits;
const ai=nextAlive(atkList,playerAttacks?pIdx:eIdx);
if(ai<0)break;
const di=playerAttacks?nextAlive(defList,eIdx):pickPlayerDefender();
if(di<0)break;
const atkU=atkList[ai],defU=defList[di];
const mult=elemMult(atkU.elem,defU.elem);
let mainDmg=Math.round(atkU.atk*mult*(0.85+Math.random()*0.3));
if(!playerAttacks&&betrayChance>0&&Math.random()<betrayChance){// 離間:敵人誤擊自己人
const others=enemyUnits.filter(u=>u.hp>0&&u!==atkU),vic=others.length?others[Math.floor(Math.random()*others.length)]:atkU;
applyDamageToUnit(vic,Math.max(1,mainDmg));betrayCount++;
log.push({p:snapshotUnits(playerUnits),e:snapshotUnits(enemyUnits),atkSide:null,atkIdx:null,defIdx:null});
eIdx=(ai+1)%enemyUnits.length;turn='p';continue;
}
if(playerAttacks===false){
mainDmg=Math.max(1,mainDmg-Math.floor(def/2));
mainDmg=Math.max(1,Math.round(mainDmg/moraleMult()));
}
if(playerAttacks&&critChance>0&&Math.random()<critChance)mainDmg*=2;
if(!playerAttacks)mainDmg=Math.round(mainDmg*toughOf(defU));
mainDmg=Math.max(1,mainDmg);
if(!playerAttacks&&!guardUsed&&defU===playerUnits[0]&&defU.hp>0&&mainDmg>=defU.hp){mainDmg=defU.hp-1;guardUsed=true;const g=sk('guard')[0];skillNotes.push(g.who+'「'+g.n+'」擋下致命一擊');}
let recoilDmg=Math.round(defU.atk*0.3*(0.85+Math.random()*0.3));
if(playerAttacks===true)recoilDmg=Math.max(0,recoilDmg-Math.floor(def/3));
if(playerAttacks)recoilDmg=Math.round(recoilDmg*(1-Math.min(0.8,recoilCut))*toughOf(atkU));
recoilDmg=Math.max(0,recoilDmg);
if(playerAttacks&&atkU===playerUnits[0]&&!guardUsed&&recoilDmg>=atkU.hp){recoilDmg=Math.max(0,atkU.hp-1);guardUsed=true;const g=sk('guard')[0];skillNotes.push(g.who+'「'+g.n+'」擋下致命一擊');}
applyDamageToUnit(defU,mainDmg);
applyDamageToUnit(atkU,recoilDmg);
log.push({p:snapshotUnits(playerUnits),e:snapshotUnits(enemyUnits),atkSide:playerAttacks?'p':'e',atkIdx:ai,defIdx:di});
if(playerAttacks){pIdx=(ai+1)%playerUnits.length;eIdx=(di+1)%enemyUnits.length;}
else{eIdx=(ai+1)%enemyUnits.length;pIdx=di;}
turn=playerAttacks?'e':'p';
}
if(betrayCount)skillNotes.push(betrayWho+'「離間」使敵軍自相殘殺 x'+betrayCount);
const win=aliveUnits(enemyUnits).length===0;
return{win,rounds:guard,log,skillNotes};
}

let inBattle=false,inTown=false,inStatus=false,inBoot=true,inInn=false,inEntity=false,inNpcPhase=false,inEvent=false;
function campMembers(campId){return monsters.filter(m=>m.alive&&m.camp===campId);}
function respawnSingleMonster(m){
setTimeout(()=>{
const i=monsters.indexOf(m);
if(i>=0){
if(m.kingdomAreaId!==undefined){
const k=KINGDOMS.find(x=>x.id===m.kingdomAreaId);
if(k){
const cellSize=QUAD/10;
const cx=k.qx*QUAD+(0.5+Math.floor(Math.random()*10))*cellSize;
const cy=k.qy*QUAD+(0.5+Math.floor(Math.random()*10))*cellSize;
monsters[i]=spawnKingdomAreaMonster(k,cx,cy,[])||spawnMonster();
}else{
monsters[i]=spawnMonster();
}
}else{
monsters[i]=spawnMonster();
}
}
},400);
}
// ---- 秒殺與群戰:低玩家15等以上的單體怪直接結算;Lv20起碰怪會把半徑200內的單體怪(最多6隻)併成一場 ----
function autoResolveMonsters(list){
let exp=0,gold=0,drops=[];
for(const x of list){
exp+=x.exp;gold+=x.gold;x.alive=false;
const d=rollItemDrop(x.level);if(d)drops.push(d.icon+d.name);
respawnSingleMonster(x);
}
gainExp(exp);player.gold+=gold;
for(const r of ['companion','brother'])if(player[r])companionGainExp(player[r],exp);
showToast('⚡ 秒殺 '+(list.length>1?list.length+' 隻野怪':list[0].name+' Lv.'+list[0].level)+',經驗 +'+exp+' 金幣 +'+gold+(drops.length?' 🎁'+drops.join(''):''));
}
function engageMonster(m){
let group=[m];
if(player.level>=20){
group=monsters.filter(x=>x.alive&&x.camp===undefined&&!x.hist&&Math.hypot(x.x-player.x,x.y-player.y)<200)
.sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-player.x,a.y-player.y)-Math.hypot(b.x-player.x,b.y-player.y)).slice(0,6);
if(!group.includes(m)){if(group.length>=6)group.pop();group.unshift(m);}
}
const weak=group.filter(x=>x.level<=player.level-15),strong=group.filter(x=>!weak.includes(x));
if(weak.length)autoResolveMonsters(weak);
if(!strong.length){updateHud();save();return false;}
target=null;joyActive=false;joyDX=0;joyDY=0;joyKnob.style.transform='translate(0,0)';
if(strong.length===1){triggerBattle(strong[0]);return true;}
triggerBattle({icon:strong[0].icon,name:'野怪群(x'+strong.length+')',level:Math.max(...strong.map(x=>x.level)),
exp:strong.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.exp,0),gold:strong.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.gold,0),alive:true,members:strong,groupMembers:strong});
return true;
}
function triggerCampBattle(campId){
const members=campMembers(campId);
if(members.length===0)return;
const squad={
icon:members[0].icon,
name:'山寨盜匪團(x'+members.length+')',
level:Math.max(...members.map(m=>m.level)),
exp:members.reduce((s,m)=>s+m.exp,0),
gold:members.reduce((s,m)=>s+m.gold,0),
alive:true,campId,members
};
triggerBattle(squad);
}
function rowHtml(u,i,side){
const iconHtml=u.icon==='🧙'?'<img src="'+PLAYER_IMG.src+'" style="width:18px;height:18px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:2px;vertical-align:middle;">':(u.artKey&&UNIT_ART_SRC[u.artKey])?'<img src="'+UNIT_ART_SRC[u.artKey]+'" style="height:24px;width:auto;vertical-align:middle;">':u.icon;
const cntHtml=u.remainingCount!==undefined?' <span id="'+side+'Cnt'+i+'">x'+u.remainingCount+'</span>':'';
return `<div class="urow" id="${side}Row${i}"><div class="uiconname"><span class="uicon">${iconHtml}</span><span class="uname">${u.name}</span>${cntHtml}</div><div class="ubarWrap"><div class="ufill" id="${side}Fill${i}" style="width:100%"></div></div><span class="uhp" id="${side}Hp${i}">${u.hp}/${u.maxHp}</span></div>`;
}
function triggerBattle(m){
inBattle=true;
const playerUnits=buildPlayerUnits();
const enemyUnits=buildEnemyUnits(m);
const res=simulateBattle(playerUnits,enemyUnits);
if(res.skillNotes&&res.skillNotes.length)showToast('✨ '+res.skillNotes.join('、'));
loyaltyAfterBattle(res.win);
document.getElementById('battleName').textContent=m.name+' Lv.'+m.level;
document.getElementById('battleResult').textContent='';
document.getElementById('battleReward').textContent='';
document.getElementById('battleClose').classList.add('hidden');
document.getElementById('teamList').innerHTML=playerUnits.map((u,i)=>rowHtml(u,i,'team')).join('');
document.getElementById('enemyList').innerHTML=enemyUnits.map((u,i)=>rowHtml(u,i,'enemy')).join('');
document.getElementById('battleModal').classList.remove('hidden');
const clash=document.getElementById('clashIntro');
const clashLeftEl=document.getElementById('clashLeft'),clashRightEl=document.getElementById('clashRight');
const clashBoltEl=document.querySelector('.clashBolt');
clashLeftEl.innerHTML='<img src="'+PLAYER_IMG.src+'" style="width:44px;height:44px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:6px;">';
const ek=enemyUnits[0].artKey;
if(ek&&UNIT_ART_SRC[ek])clashRightEl.innerHTML='<img src="'+UNIT_ART_SRC[ek]+'" style="height:64px;width:auto;">';else clashRightEl.textContent=enemyUnits[0].icon;
[clashLeftEl,clashRightEl,clashBoltEl].forEach(el=>{el.style.animation='none';});
void clash.offsetWidth;
[clashLeftEl,clashRightEl,clashBoltEl].forEach(el=>{el.style.animation='';});
clash.classList.remove('hidden');

function renderFrame(frame){
frame.p.forEach((s,i)=>{
document.getElementById('teamFill'+i).style.width=Math.max(0,s.hp/s.maxHp*100)+'%';
document.getElementById('teamHp'+i).textContent=Math.ceil(s.hp)+'/'+s.maxHp;
const dead=s.remainingCount!==undefined?s.remainingCount<=0:s.hp<=0;
document.getElementById('teamRow'+i).classList.toggle('dead',dead);
if(s.remainingCount!==undefined){
const cntEl=document.getElementById('teamCnt'+i);
if(cntEl)cntEl.textContent='x'+Math.max(0,s.remainingCount);
}
});
frame.e.forEach((s,i)=>{
document.getElementById('enemyFill'+i).style.width=Math.max(0,s.hp/s.maxHp*100)+'%';
document.getElementById('enemyHp'+i).textContent=Math.ceil(s.hp)+'/'+s.maxHp;
document.getElementById('enemyRow'+i).classList.toggle('dead',s.hp<=0);
});
if(frame.atkSide){
const atkEl=document.getElementById((frame.atkSide==='p'?'teamRow':'enemyRow')+frame.atkIdx);
const defEl=document.getElementById((frame.atkSide==='p'?'enemyRow':'teamRow')+frame.defIdx);
const bumpClass=frame.atkSide==='p'?'bumping-right':'bumping-left';
if(atkEl){
atkEl.style.animation='none';void atkEl.offsetWidth;atkEl.style.animation='';
atkEl.classList.add(bumpClass);
}
if(defEl){
defEl.style.animation='none';void defEl.offsetWidth;defEl.style.animation='';
defEl.classList.add('shaking');
}
setTimeout(()=>{
if(atkEl)atkEl.classList.remove(bumpClass);
if(defEl)defEl.classList.remove('shaking');
},300);
}
}
renderFrame(res.log[0]);
let idx=0;
setTimeout(()=>{
clash.classList.add('hidden');
const timer=setInterval(()=>{
try{
idx++;
if(idx>=res.log.length){
clearInterval(timer);
finishBattle();
return;
}
renderFrame(res.log[idx]);
}catch(err){
clearInterval(timer);
inBattle=false;
document.getElementById('battleModal').classList.add('hidden');
}
},450);
},750);

function finishBattle(){
try{
player.hp=res.win?Math.max(1,Math.round(playerUnits[0].hp)):1;
player.morale=res.win?Math.min(100,(player.morale||0)+2):Math.max(0,(player.morale||0)-5);
let casualties=[];
playerUnits.forEach(u=>{
if(u.mercIdx!==undefined){
const k=u.mercIdx;
if(u.remainingCount<=0){
mercs[k]=0;mercHp[k]=0;mercTier[k]=0;mercExp[k]=0;
casualties.push(MERCS[k].n+' 全軍覆沒');
}else{
const lost=u.startCount-u.remainingCount;
mercs[k]=u.remainingCount;
mercHp[k]=Math.max(1,Math.round((u.remainingCount-1)*u.perHp+u.hp));
if(lost>0)casualties.push(MERCS[k].n+' 陣亡 '+lost+' 名');
}
}else if(u.companionRef){
const c=player[u.companionRef];
if(c)c.hp=Math.max(1,Math.round(u.hp));
}
});
let promotions=[];
if(res.win){
playerUnits.forEach(u=>{
if(u.mercIdx!==undefined){
const k=u.mercIdx;
mercExp[k]=(mercExp[k]||0)+m.exp;
const oldTier=mercTierOf(k);
let newTier=oldTier;
if(mercExp[k]>=TIER_EXP[2])newTier=2;
else if(mercExp[k]>=TIER_EXP[1])newTier=1;
if(newTier>oldTier){
mercTier[k]=newTier;
promotions.push(MERCS[k].n+'晉升為'+TIER_NAMES[newTier]+'!');
}
}else if(u.companionRef){
const c=player[u.companionRef];
if(c){
const oldLevel=c.level;
companionGainExp(c,m.exp);
if(c.level>oldLevel)promotions.push(c.name+' 升級為 Lv.'+c.level+'!');
}
}
});
}
if(res.win){
gainExp(m.exp);player.gold+=m.gold;
document.getElementById('battleResult').textContent='🎉 勝利!';
document.getElementById('battleResult').style.color='#2e7d32';
m.alive=false;
if(m.capitalId!==undefined){
player.capturedCapitals=player.capturedCapitals||[];
if(!player.capturedCapitals.includes(m.capitalId))player.capturedCapitals.push(m.capitalId);
npcs.forEach(n=>n.capturedCapitals=n.capturedCapitals.filter(id=>id!==m.capitalId));
document.getElementById('battleReward').textContent='獲得經驗 +'+m.exp+'　金幣 +'+m.gold+'　👑 已攻陷王城!';
}else if(m.outpostId!==undefined){
player.captured=player.captured||[];
if(!player.captured.includes(m.outpostId))player.captured.push(m.outpostId);
npcs.forEach(n=>n.captured=n.captured.filter(id=>id!==m.outpostId));
document.getElementById('battleReward').textContent='獲得經驗 +'+m.exp+'　金幣 +'+m.gold+'　🚩 已佔領該城鎮!';
}else if(m.campId!==undefined){
m.members.forEach(mm=>mm.alive=false);
let dropTxt='';
const drop=rollItemDrop(m.level);
if(drop)dropTxt='　🎁 獲得 '+drop.icon+drop.name;
document.getElementById('battleReward').textContent='獲得經驗 +'+m.exp+'　金幣 +'+m.gold+'　🏴 山寨已掃蕩!'+dropTxt;
const campId=m.campId,center=campCenters.find(c=>c.id===campId);
setTimeout(()=>{
if(!center)return;
for(let i=0;i<monsters.length;i++){
if(monsters[i].camp===campId){
let nx,ny,tries=0;
do{
nx=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,center.x+(Math.random()-0.5)*80));
ny=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,center.y+(Math.random()-0.5)*80));
tries++;
}while(!canMoveTo(nx,ny)&&tries<15);
if(!canMoveTo(nx,ny)){nx=center.x;ny=center.y;}
const nm=spawnMonster(nx,ny);
nm.camp=campId;
monsters[i]=nm;
}
}
},20000);
}else if(m.checkpointKey!==undefined){
player.capturedCheckpoints=player.capturedCheckpoints||[];
if(!player.capturedCheckpoints.includes(m.checkpointKey))player.capturedCheckpoints.push(m.checkpointKey);
npcs.forEach(n=>n.capturedCheckpoints=(n.capturedCheckpoints||[]).filter(k=>k!==m.checkpointKey));
document.getElementById('battleReward').textContent='獲得經驗 +'+m.exp+'　金幣 +'+m.gold+'　🚩 已攻下關卡,永久免費通行!';
}else if(m.isPatrol){
document.getElementById('battleReward').textContent='獲得經驗 +'+m.exp+'　金幣 +'+m.gold+'　🚩 擊退巡邏隊!';
respawnPatrol(m);
}else if(m.isNpcBoss){
if(m.npcIdx!==undefined&&npcs[m.npcIdx])npc=npcs[m.npcIdx];
if(npc){npc.defeats=(npc.defeats||0)+1;npc.hp=Math.max(1,Math.round(npc.maxHp*0.15));npc.gold=Math.round(npc.gold*0.7);npc.target=null;
const d=Math.hypot(npc.x-player.x,npc.y-player.y)||1,ux=(npc.x-player.x)/d||1,uy=(npc.y-player.y)/d;// 潰逃:推離玩家約300,下回合撤回大本營
const st=npcFindStep(npc.x,npc.y,npc.x+ux*300,npc.y+uy*300,300);npc.x=st.x;npc.y=st.y;}
document.getElementById('battleReward').textContent='獲得經驗 +'+m.exp+'　金幣 +'+m.gold+'　⚔️ '+npcName()+'大敗潰逃!';
}else{
let dropTxt='';
for(const x of (m.groupMembers||[m])){const drop=rollItemDrop(x.level);if(drop)dropTxt+='　🎁 獲得 '+drop.icon+drop.name;}
document.getElementById('battleReward').textContent='獲得經驗 +'+m.exp+'　金幣 +'+m.gold+(m.groupMembers?'　🗡️ 一舉擊潰 '+m.groupMembers.length+' 隻':'')+dropTxt;
(m.groupMembers||[m]).forEach(x=>{x.alive=false;respawnSingleMonster(x);});
}
if(promotions.length){
document.getElementById('battleReward').textContent+='　🎖️ '+promotions.join('　');
}
}else{
const lost=Math.floor(player.gold*0.2);
player.gold-=lost;
const hx=player.homeX!==undefined?player.homeX:CAPITALS[0].x;
const hy=player.homeY!==undefined?player.homeY:CAPITALS[0].y+80;
player.x=hx;player.y=hy;
player.hp=player.maxHp;
MERCS.forEach((mm,i)=>{if(mercs[i]>0)mercHp[i]=mercMaxHp(i);});
if(player.companion)player.companion.hp=player.companion.maxHp;
if(player.brother)player.brother.hp=player.brother.maxHp;
document.getElementById('battleResult').textContent='💀 敗退...';
document.getElementById('battleResult').style.color='var(--danger)';
document.getElementById('battleReward').textContent='損失金幣 -'+lost+'，已送回出生地休養,全軍生命已恢復';
}
if(casualties.length){
document.getElementById('battleReward').textContent+='　⚰️ '+casualties.join('　');
}
updateHud();save();
document.getElementById('battleClose').classList.remove('hidden');
}catch(err){
inBattle=false;
document.getElementById('battleModal').classList.add('hidden');
}
}
}
document.getElementById('battleClose').onclick=()=>{document.getElementById('battleModal').classList.add('hidden');inBattle=false;};

function renderStatus(){
const tt=teamTotals();
const w=WEAPONS[player.weaponTier],a=ARMORS[player.armorTier];
let html='';
html+=row('等級',player.level);
html+=row('經驗',player.exp+' / '+player.expNext);
html+=row('生命上限','❤️ '+player.maxHp+'(目前 '+player.hp+')');
html+=row('攻擊力','⚔️ '+baseAtk()+'（基礎 '+(8+player.level*2)+' + 武器 '+w.v+'）');
html+=row('防禦力','🛡️ '+armorBonus());
html+=row('武器',w.n+'（'+RARITY_NAMES[w.r]+'　+'+w.v+'攻擊）');
html+=row('防具',a.n+'（'+RARITY_NAMES[a.r]+'　+'+a.v+'防禦）');
html+=row('金幣','💰 '+player.gold);
html+=row('傭兵團戰力','⚔️ +'+tt.mercAtk+'　❤️ +'+tt.mercHp);
html+=row('帶兵數',mercCount()+' / '+troopCap());
MERCS.forEach((mm,i)=>{
if(mercs[i]>0){
const tier=mercTierOf(i),exp=mercExpOf(i),cnt=mercs[i];
const eliteMult=1+((mercUpgrade[i]||0)*0.25);
const perAtk=Math.round(mm.atk*TIER_MULT[tier]*eliteMult),perHp=Math.round(mm.hp*TIER_MULT[tier]*eliteMult);
const maxHp=mercMaxHp(i),curHp=mercCurHp(i);
const nextReq=tier<2?TIER_EXP[tier+1]:null;
const progress=nextReq?`（經驗 ${exp}/${nextReq} 晉升下一階）`:'（已達最高階）';
html+=`<div class="srow"><span>${mm.icon} ${mm.n} ${TIER_NAMES[tier]} x${cnt}</span><button class="buy" style="background:var(--danger);color:#fff;font-size:11px;padding:4px 8px;" data-dismiss="${i}">解散</button></div>`;
html+=`<div style="font-size:10px;opacity:.65;margin:-2px 0 2px;">❤️ ${curHp}/${maxHp}　每人 ⚔️${perAtk}　全隊 ⚔️${perAtk*cnt}</div>`;
html+=`<div style="font-size:10px;opacity:.65;margin:0 0 4px;">${progress}</div>`;
}
});
const bondActive=player.companion&&player.brother&&player.brother.sworn;
['companion','brother'].forEach(role=>{
const c=player[role];
if(!c)return;
const label=role==='companion'?'💑 伴侶':'⚔️ '+brotherRank(c);
const w=WEAPONS[c.weaponTier],a=ARMORS[c.armorTier];
const traitLabel=c.trait==='hp'?'（防禦型 生命+'+Math.round((c.traitValue||0)*100)+'%）':'（攻擊型 攻擊+'+Math.round((c.atkBonus||0)*100)+'%）';
const armed=dismissArmed===role;
const btnLabel=armed?'確定遣散?':'遣散';
const btnStyle=armed?'background:#7a1a1a;color:#fff;font-size:11px;padding:4px 8px;font-weight:900;':'background:var(--danger);color:#fff;font-size:11px;padding:4px 8px;';
html+=`<div class="srow"><span>${c.icon} ${label}:${c.name} Lv.${c.level} ${traitLabel}</span><button class="buy" style="${btnStyle}" data-companiondismiss="${role}">${btnLabel}</button></div>`;
html+=`<div style="font-size:10px;opacity:.65;margin:-2px 0 2px;">經驗 ${c.exp} / ${c.expNext}</div>`;
html+=`<div style="font-size:10px;opacity:.65;margin:-2px 0 2px;">❤️ ${c.hp}/${c.maxHp}　⚔️${companionBaseAtk(c)}　🛡️${companionArmorBonus(c)}　武器:${w.n}(+${w.v})　防具:${a.n}(+${a.v})${bondActive?'　🔗羈絆+5%':''}</div>`;
const healKeys=Object.keys(player.inventory||{}).filter(k=>ITEMS[k]&&ITEMS[k].type==='heal'&&player.inventory[k]>0);
if(c.hp<c.maxHp&&healKeys.length){
html+='<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 6px;">';
healKeys.forEach(k=>{
html+=`<button class="buy" style="font-size:11px;padding:4px 8px;" data-healtarget="${role}" data-healkey="${k}">${ITEMS[k].icon} 使用${ITEMS[k].name}(x${player.inventory[k]})</button>`;
});
html+='</div>';
}
});
document.getElementById('statusBody').innerHTML=html;
document.querySelectorAll('#statusBody [data-companiondismiss]').forEach(b=>{
b.onclick=()=>{
const role=b.dataset.companiondismiss;
const c=player[role];
if(!c)return;
if(dismissArmed!==role){
dismissArmed=role;
renderStatus();
return;
}
dismissArmed=null;
stashGear(c);
player[role]=null;
showToast(c.name+' 已離開隊伍,裝備留在物品欄。');
updateHud();save();renderStatus();
};
});
document.querySelectorAll('#statusBody [data-healtarget]').forEach(b=>{
b.onclick=()=>useItem(b.dataset.healkey,b.dataset.healtarget);
});
document.querySelectorAll('#statusBody [data-dismiss]').forEach(b=>{
b.onclick=()=>{
const i=+b.dataset.dismiss;
if(b.dataset.confirm==='1'){
mercs[i]=0;mercTier[i]=0;mercExp[i]=0;mercHp[i]=0;
updateHud();save();renderStatus();
}else{
b.dataset.confirm='1';
b.textContent='確定解散?';
setTimeout(()=>{if(b.dataset.confirm==='1'){b.dataset.confirm='0';b.textContent='解散';}},3000);
}
};
});
renderGarrisonStatus();
}
function garrisonStatusName(key){
const[type,idStr]=key.split('_');
const id=+idStr;
if(type==='capital'){const c=CAPITALS.find(x=>x.id===id);return c?c.icon+' '+c.name:key;}
const o=OUTPOSTS.find(x=>x.id===id);return o?'🏘️ '+o.name:key;
}
function renderGarrisonStatus(){
const box=document.getElementById('statusGarrison');
const st=player.stationed||{};
const keys=Object.keys(st).filter(k=>st[k]>0);
if(keys.length===0){box.innerHTML='<div style="font-size:11px;opacity:.6;margin-top:4px;">目前沒有駐軍</div>';return;}
let html='<div style="font-weight:700;font-size:13px;margin-top:8px;">🛡️ 各地駐軍</div>';
keys.forEach(key=>{
const[type,idStr]=key.split('_');
const obj=type==='capital'?CAPITALS.find(x=>x.id===+idStr):OUTPOSTS.find(x=>x.id===+idStr);
const cap=obj?garrisonCap(type,obj):100;
html+=`<div class="srow"><span>${garrisonStatusName(key)}</span><b>${Math.round(st[key])} / ${cap}</b></div>`;
});
box.innerHTML=html;
}
function row(k,v){return`<div class="srow"><span>${k}</span><b>${v}</b></div>`;}
document.getElementById('statusBtn').onclick=()=>{inStatus=true;dismissArmed=null;renderStatus();document.getElementById('statusModal').classList.remove('hidden');};
document.getElementById('statusClose').onclick=()=>{inStatus=false;document.getElementById('statusModal').classList.add('hidden');};

// ---- Town ----
let currentSettlement=null;
function openSettlement(type,obj){
inTown=true;target=null;
try{
currentSettlement={type,obj};
document.getElementById('townTitle').textContent=(type==='capital'?obj.icon+' ':'🏘️ ')+obj.name;
if(type==='village'&&obj.id===player.homeVillageId)healHomeIfNeeded();
maybeOfferRecruit();
shopEquipTarget='player';
replaceArmed=null;renderShop();renderPharmacy();renderFood();renderMerc();renderHeroHall('brother');renderHeroHall('companion');updateHeroTabs();renderInn();renderConquer();renderGarrison();
document.getElementById('townModal').classList.remove('hidden');
}catch(err){
inTown=false;
document.getElementById('townModal').classList.add('hidden');
}
}
document.getElementById('townClose').onclick=()=>{document.getElementById('townModal').classList.add('hidden');inTown=false;};

function renderConquer(){
const pane=document.getElementById('conquerPane');
if(!currentSettlement){pane.innerHTML='';return;}
const{type,obj}=currentSettlement;
if(type==='capital'){
if(isCapitalCaptured(obj.id)){
pane.innerHTML='<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>👑 已佔領</b><span>這座王城已是你的領地</span></div></div>';
return;
}
if(!canChallengeCapital(obj)){
pane.innerHTML='<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>🔒 王城深鎖</b><span>需先攻下四方王國,才能挑戰中央王城</span></div></div>';
return;
}
const g=capitalGuards.find(x=>x.capitalId===obj.id&&x.alive);
if(!g){
pane.innerHTML='<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>⚔️ 攻城</b><span>暫無守軍資料</span></div></div>';
return;
}
pane.innerHTML=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>${g.icon} ${g.name}</b><span>Lv.${g.level}　❤️${g.maxHp}　⚔️${g.atk}（極強,務必先壯大部隊）</span></div><button class="buy" id="conquerCapitalBtn">⚔️ 挑戰王城</button></div>`;
document.getElementById('conquerCapitalBtn').onclick=()=>{
document.getElementById('townModal').classList.add('hidden');
inTown=false;
try{triggerBattle(g);}catch(err){inBattle=false;}
};
return;
}
if(isCaptured(obj.id)){
pane.innerHTML='<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>🚩 已佔領</b><span>此城鎮已是你的領地,持續提供稅收</span></div></div>';
return;
}
const g=garrisons.find(x=>x.outpostId===obj.id&&x.alive);
if(!g){
pane.innerHTML='<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>⚔️ 攻城</b><span>暫無守軍資料</span></div></div>';
return;
}
pane.innerHTML=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>${g.icon} ${g.name}</b><span>Lv.${g.level}　❤️${g.maxHp}　⚔️${g.atk}</span></div><button class="buy" id="conquerBtn">⚔️ 發動攻城戰</button></div>`;
document.getElementById('conquerBtn').onclick=()=>{
document.getElementById('townModal').classList.add('hidden');
inTown=false;
try{triggerBattle(g);}catch(err){inBattle=false;}
};
}

function renderGarrison(){
const pane=document.getElementById('garrisonPane');
if(!currentSettlement){pane.innerHTML='';return;}
const{type,obj}=currentSettlement;
const owned=type==='capital'?isCapitalCaptured(obj.id):isCaptured(obj.id);
if(!owned){
pane.innerHTML='<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>🛡️ 駐軍</b><span>需先佔領此地才能駐軍</span></div></div>';
return;
}
const key=settlementKey(type,obj);
const cap=garrisonCap(type,obj);
const cur=(player.stationed&&player.stationed[key])||0;
let html=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>目前駐軍強度</b><span>${Math.round(cur)} / ${cap}</span></div></div>`;
let any=false;
MERCS.forEach((mm,i)=>{
if(mercs[i]>0){
any=true;
const tier=mercTierOf(i),mult=TIER_MULT[tier];
const strength=Math.round((Math.round(mm.atk*mult)+Math.round(mm.hp*mult))/2);
html+=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>${mm.icon} ${mm.n} x${mercs[i]}</b><span>每名派駐強度 +${strength}</span></div><button class="buy" data-station="${i}" ${cur+strength>cap?'disabled':''}>派駐1名</button></div>`;
}
});
if(!any)html+='<div class="item"><div class="info"><span>目前沒有可派駐的部隊</span></div></div>';
pane.innerHTML=html;
document.querySelectorAll('#garrisonPane [data-station]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
const i=+b.dataset.station;
if((mercs[i]||0)<=0)return;
const tier=mercTierOf(i),mult=TIER_MULT[tier];
const strength=Math.round((Math.round(MERCS[i].atk*mult)+Math.round(MERCS[i].hp*mult))/2);
mercs[i]-=1;
player.stationed=player.stationed||{};
player.stationed[key]=(player.stationed[key]||0)+strength;
updateHud();save();renderGarrison();
});
}

});

let shopEquipTarget='player';
let dismissArmed=null;
function getEquipTarget(){
if(shopEquipTarget==='companion'&&player.companion)return player.companion;
if(shopEquipTarget==='brother'&&player.brother)return player.brother;
shopEquipTarget='player';
return player;
}
function renderShop(){
const[minR,maxR]=shopRarityRange();
const target=getEquipTarget();
let selHtml='';
if(player.companion||player.brother){
selHtml='<div class="item" style="display:flex;gap:6px;"><button class="buy" data-sel="player" style="flex:1;'+(shopEquipTarget==='player'?'':'opacity:.55;')+'">🧙 英雄</button>';
if(player.companion)selHtml+='<button class="buy" data-sel="companion" style="flex:1;'+(shopEquipTarget==='companion'?'':'opacity:.55;')+'">'+player.companion.icon+' '+player.companion.name+'</button>';
if(player.brother)selHtml+='<button class="buy" data-sel="brother" style="flex:1;'+(shopEquipTarget==='brother'?'':'opacity:.55;')+'">'+player.brother.icon+' '+player.brother.name+'</button>';
selHtml+='</div>';
}
const wRefund=Math.floor(WEAPONS[target.weaponTier].cost*0.5);
const aRefund=Math.floor(ARMORS[target.armorTier].cost*0.5);
let html=selHtml+'<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>武器</b></div></div>';
WEAPONS.forEach((w,i)=>{
const owned=i===target.weaponTier;
if(!owned&&(w.r<minR||w.r>maxR))return;
const locked=target.level<w.lvl;
const netCost=Math.max(0,w.cost-wRefund);
const canBuy=!owned&&!locked&&player.gold>=netCost&&i>target.weaponTier;
const status=locked?'需求 Lv.'+w.lvl:owned?'使用中':'花費 💰'+w.cost;
html+=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>[${RARITY_NAMES[w.r]}] ${w.n} (+${w.v}攻擊)</b><span>${status}</span></div>${owned?'':`<button class="buy" data-type="w" data-i="${i}" ${canBuy?'':'disabled'}>${locked?'鎖定':'裝備'}</button>`}</div>`;
});
html+='<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>防具</b></div></div>';
ARMORS.forEach((a,i)=>{
const owned=i===target.armorTier;
if(!owned&&(a.r<minR||a.r>maxR))return;
const locked=target.level<a.lvl;
const netCost=Math.max(0,a.cost-aRefund);
const canBuy=!owned&&!locked&&player.gold>=netCost&&i>target.armorTier;
const status=locked?'需求 Lv.'+a.lvl:owned?'使用中':'花費 💰'+a.cost;
html+=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>[${RARITY_NAMES[a.r]}] ${a.n} (+${a.v}防禦)</b><span>${status}</span></div>${owned?'':`<button class="buy" data-type="a" data-i="${i}" ${canBuy?'':'disabled'}>${locked?'鎖定':'裝備'}</button>`}</div>`;
});
document.getElementById('shopPane').innerHTML=html;
document.querySelectorAll('#shopPane .buy[data-sel]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
shopEquipTarget=b.dataset.sel;renderShop();
});
document.querySelectorAll('#shopPane .buy[data-type]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
const i=+b.dataset.i;
const t=getEquipTarget();
if(b.dataset.type==='w'){
if(i<=t.weaponTier)return;
const refund=Math.floor(WEAPONS[t.weaponTier].cost*0.5);
player.gold+=refund;
player.gold-=WEAPONS[i].cost;
t.weaponTier=i;
}else{
if(i<=t.armorTier)return;
const refund=Math.floor(ARMORS[t.armorTier].cost*0.5);
player.gold+=refund;
player.gold-=ARMORS[i].cost;
t.armorTier=i;
}
updateHud();save();renderShop();
});
}
// 英雄池:home=出身地區(kingdom id,在該區較易遇到)、lord=原屬君主(該王城未被玩家攻下前無法招募;字串為流動勢力,待流動NPC實作)
// loyalty=天生忠誠基準(供忠誠度系統使用)、skill=個人技能(於 simulateBattle 生效)
const COMPANION_POOL=[
{name:'貂蟬',icon:'👸',trait:'atk',value:0.10,home:4,lord:4,loyalty:55,skill:{id:'weaken',v:0.15,betray:0.15,n:'離間',d:'敵軍攻擊力 -15%;敵人攻擊時 15% 機率自相殘殺'}},
{name:'孫尚香',icon:'🏹',trait:'atk',value:0.10,home:3,loyalty:70,skill:{id:'volley',v:0.6,n:'弓腰姬',d:'開戰先射一輪,對所有敵人造成傷害'}},

{name:'甘寧',icon:'🛡️',trait:'atk',value:0.10,home:2,loyalty:60,skill:{id:'rally',v:0.10,n:'錦帆',d:'我方全軍攻擊力 +10%'}},
{name:'典韋',icon:'💪',trait:'hp',value:0.15,home:3,lord:'曹操',loyalty:95,skill:{id:'guard',v:1,n:'護主',d:'英雄受到致命傷時擋下一次'}},

{name:'龐德',icon:'🏇',trait:'atk',value:0.12,home:0,lord:0,loyalty:80,skill:{id:'selfAtk',v:0.20,n:'抬櫬',d:'自身攻擊力 +20%'}},
{name:'文醜',icon:'🔱',trait:'atk',value:0.10,home:1,loyalty:60,skill:{id:'crit',v:0.12,n:'猛將',d:'我方攻擊 12% 機率造成雙倍傷害'}}
];
const UNIQUE_HEROES=[// 身分專屬武將,不會隨機來訪
{name:'關羽',icon:'🧔',trait:'atk',value:0.15,home:1,loyalty:100,skill:{id:'selfAtk',v:0.3,n:'武聖',d:'自身攻擊力 +30%'}},
{name:'夏侯惇',icon:'🦾',trait:'hp',value:0.15,home:3,loyalty:100,skill:{id:'selfTough',v:0.25,n:'剛烈',d:'自身承受傷害 -25%'}},
{name:'程普',icon:'🛶',trait:'atk',value:0.10,home:2,loyalty:100,skill:{id:'rally',v:0.08,n:'老將',d:'我方全軍攻擊力 +8%'}},
{name:'呂布',icon:'🔱',trait:'atk',value:0.35,home:4,loyalty:45,variableLoyalty:true,skill:{id:'selfAtk',v:0.5,n:'飛將',d:'自身攻擊力 +50%;忠誠度會變動,過低可能叛變'}}
];
function heroDef(name){return COMPANION_POOL.concat(BROTHER_POOL,UNIQUE_HEROES).find(h=>h.name===name)||null;}
function heroLocked(h){
if(h.lord===undefined)return false;
if(typeof h.lord==='number')return !isCapitalCaptured(h.lord);
if(playerLordName()===h.lord)return false;
const n=npcs.find(x=>x.name===h.lord);// 流動勢力:需擊敗其本人至少一次(或其已身亡)才能挖角
return n?!(n.dead||(n.defeats||0)>=1):false;
}
function heroTaken(name){return (player.companion&&player.companion.name===name)||(player.brother&&player.brother.name===name);}
function activeHeroSkills(){
const out=[];
for(const ref of ['companion','brother']){
const c=player[ref];if(!c||c.hp<=0)continue;
const h=heroDef(c.name);if(h&&h.skill)out.push(Object.assign({ref,who:c.name},h.skill));
}
return out;
}
function companionBaseAtk(c){return Math.round((8+c.level*2+WEAPONS[c.weaponTier].v)*(1+(c.atkBonus||0)));}
function companionArmorBonus(c){return ARMORS[c.armorTier].v;}
let pendingRecruit=null;
const visitorCache={};// 每座城每回合的來訪者固定,結束回合才重抽
function maybeOfferRecruit(){
const vk=currentSettlement?currentSettlement.type+'_'+(currentSettlement.obj.id!==undefined?currentSettlement.obj.id:currentSettlement.obj.key)+'@'+weekIdx():null;
if(vk&&vk in visitorCache){
const v=visitorCache[vk];
pendingRecruit=(v&&!heroTaken(v.name))?v:null;
return;
}
rollRecruit();
if(vk)visitorCache[vk]=pendingRecruit;
}
function rollRecruit(){
pendingRecruit=null;
if(Math.random()>0.8)return;
const wantCompanion=(!player.companion&&player.brother)?true:(player.companion&&!player.brother)?false:Math.random()<0.5;// 有空缺優先補空缺;滿員也會有人來訪
const wk='@'+weekIdx(),shown=Object.keys(visitorCache).filter(k=>k.endsWith(wk)).map(k=>visitorCache[k]).filter(Boolean).map(v=>v.name);// 本回合已在其他城出現者不重複
const all=(wantCompanion?COMPANION_POOL:BROTHER_POOL).filter(h=>!heroTaken(h.name)&&!heroLocked(h)&&!shown.includes(h.name));
if(!all.length)return;
const kid=currentSettlement?(currentSettlement.type==='capital'?currentSettlement.obj.id:currentSettlement.obj.kingdom):null;
const local=all.filter(h=>h.home===kid);
const pool=(local.length&&Math.random()<0.7)?local:all;
const pick=pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)];
const lvl=Math.max(1,player.level+Math.floor(Math.random()*5)-2);
let maxHp=50+lvl*8,atkBonus=0;
if(pick.trait==='hp')maxHp=Math.round(maxHp*(1+pick.value));
else atkBonus=pick.value;
pendingRecruit={type:wantCompanion?'companion':'brother',name:pick.name,icon:pick.icon,level:lvl,weaponTier:0,armorTier:0,exp:0,expNext:expNeededForLevel(lvl),hp:maxHp,maxHp,atkBonus,trait:pick.trait,traitValue:pick.value};
}
function heroInfoLine(h,traitType,traitValue){
if(!traitType&&h)traitType=h.trait;
if(typeof traitValue!=='number'||isNaN(traitValue))traitValue=h?h.value:0;
const t=traitType==='hp'?'防禦型(生命 +'+Math.round(traitValue*100)+'%)':'攻擊型(攻擊 +'+Math.round(traitValue*100)+'%)';
const home=h&&KINGDOMS[h.home]?'出身:'+(KINGDOMS[h.home].isCenter?'中原':KINGDOMS[h.home].name+'領地')+'　':'';
return home+t+(h&&h.skill?'<br>✨ '+h.skill.n+':'+h.skill.d:'');
}
// ---- 武將忠誠度:義兄弟恆定 100;伴侶會因士氣、勝敗、賞賜變動,過低會離隊,歸零會帶兵投敵 ----
function weekIdx(){return ((player.year||184)*12+(player.month||3))*5+Math.floor((player.day||1)/7);}
function giftCost(c){return 50+(c.level||1)*10;}
function brotherRank(c){
if(!c)return '義兄弟';
if(c.variableLoyalty)return '義子';
if(c.sworn)return '義兄弟';
const v=c.loyalty||60;return v>=90?'生死之交':v>=80?'親信':v>=70?'心腹':'部將';
}
function giftedThisTurn(c){return c&&c.giftWeek===weekIdx();}
function loyaltyLine(c,kind){
if(kind==='brother'&&c.sworn)return '🤝 義結金蘭(忠誠恆定)';
if(kind==='brother'&&!c.variableLoyalty){const v=Math.round(c.loyalty||60);return '🤝 親疏:'+brotherRank(c)+'　忠誠 '+v+'/100(滿 100 結拜為義兄弟)';}
const v=Math.round(c.loyalty===undefined?70:c.loyalty);
const tag=v>=80?'死心塌地':v>=50?'忠心':v>=30?'動搖':'離心';
return (v<30?'⚠️':'❤️')+' 忠誠 '+v+'/100('+tag+')';
}
function changeLoyalty(d,ref){
const c=player[ref||'companion'];if(!c||c.sworn)return;
c.loyalty=Math.max(0,Math.min(c.variableLoyalty?99:100,(c.loyalty===undefined?70:c.loyalty)+d));
if(ref==='brother'&&!c.variableLoyalty&&c.loyalty>=100&&!c.sworn){c.sworn=true;c.loyalty=100;showToast('🍑 你與'+c.name+'焚香結拜,從此義結金蘭,生死與共!');}
}
function loyaltyAfterBattle(win){if(player.companion)changeLoyalty(win?1:-3);if(player.brother&&!player.brother.sworn)changeLoyalty(win?1:-3,'brother');}
function processLoyalty(){
if(player.brother&&!player.brother.sworn)processLoyaltyOf('brother');
processLoyaltyOf('companion');
}
function processLoyaltyOf(ref){
const c=player[ref];if(!c)return;
const m=player.morale===undefined?50:player.morale;
let d=0;
if(m>=70)d+=1;else if(m===0)d-=4;else if(m<=20)d-=2;
if(weekIdx()-(c.lastGift||weekIdx())>8)d-=1;// 久未賞賜
changeLoyalty(d,ref);
if(c.loyalty<=0){
let lost=0;
for(const k in mercs){const n=Math.floor((mercs[k]||0)*0.1);if(n>0){mercs[k]-=n;lost+=n;}}
player[ref]=null;if(c.name==='呂布')lvbuDefects();
showToast('💔 '+c.name+' 對你徹底失望,帶著裝備與 '+lost+' 名士兵投敵!');
}else if(c.loyalty<=10&&Math.random()<0.5){
stashGear(c);player[ref]=null;if(c.name==='呂布')lvbuDefects();
showToast('💔 '+c.name+' 心灰意冷,離開了隊伍(裝備留在物品欄)……');
}else if(c.loyalty<30&&!c.lowWarned){
c.lowWarned=true;
showToast('⚠️ '+c.name+' 忠誠動搖(剩 '+Math.round(c.loyalty)+'),到'+(ref==='brother'?'招賢閣':'鳳儀亭')+'贈禮可挽回');
}
}
function updateHeroTabs(){
const zx=document.querySelector('.tab[data-tab="zhaoxian"]'),fy=document.querySelector('.tab[data-tab="fengyi"]');
const pc=pendingRecruit&&pendingRecruit.type==='companion',pb=pendingRecruit&&pendingRecruit.type==='brother';
if(zx)zx.textContent='🏛️ 招賢閣'+(pb?'❗':'');
if(fy)fy.textContent='🌸 鳳儀亭'+(pc?'❗':'');
}
let replaceArmed=null;
function renderHeroHall(kind){
const paneId=kind==='brother'?'zhaoxianPane':'fengyiPane';
const label=kind==='brother'?'義兄弟':'伴侶';
let html='';
const cur=player[kind];
if(cur){
const h=heroDef(cur.name);
html+=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>${cur.icon} 目前${kind==='brother'?brotherRank(cur):label}:${cur.name}(Lv.${cur.level})</b><span>${heroInfoLine(h,cur.trait,cur.traitValue)}<br>${loyaltyLine(cur,kind)}</span></div>${(kind==='companion'||!cur.sworn)?`<button class="buy" id="giftBtn_${kind}" ${player.gold<giftCost(cur)||cur.loyalty>=(cur.variableLoyalty?99:100)||giftedThisTurn(cur)?'disabled':''}>${giftedThisTurn(cur)?'本回合<br>已贈禮':'贈禮<br>💰'+giftCost(cur)}</button>`:''}</div>`;
}
if(pendingRecruit&&pendingRecruit.type===kind){
const p=pendingRecruit,h=heroDef(p.name),cost=50+p.level*20;
const armed=replaceArmed===kind;
const btnTxt=!cur?'招募':armed?'確定替換':'替換招募';
html+=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>❗ ${p.icon} ${p.name} 來訪(Lv.${p.level})</b><span>${heroInfoLine(h,p.trait,p.traitValue)}<br>能自行購買裝備　💰${cost}${cur?`<br>${armed?'⚠️ 再按一次確認:':''}${cur.name}將離開隊伍(裝備留在物品欄)`:''}</span></div><button class="buy" id="recruit_${kind}" ${player.gold<cost?'disabled':''} ${armed?'style="background:#7a1a1a;color:#fff;"':''}>${btnTxt}</button></div>`;
}else if(!cur){
html+=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><span>${kind==='brother'?'暫無賢士來訪。':'亭中寂靜,暫無佳人來訪。'}(常到各地城鎮走動,或許會有奇遇)</span></div></div>`;
}else{
html+=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><span>已有${kind==='brother'?brotherRank(cur):label},若想換人請先到狀態欄遣散(裝備會留在物品欄)。</span></div></div>`;
}
document.getElementById(paneId).innerHTML=html;
const gb=document.getElementById('giftBtn_'+kind);
if(gb)gb.onclick=()=>{
const c=player[kind],cost=giftCost(c);if(!c||player.gold<cost||giftedThisTurn(c))return;
player.gold-=cost;c.giftWeek=weekIdx();c.lastGift=weekIdx();c.lowWarned=false;
showToast('🎁 '+c.name+' 收下禮物,忠誠 +10');changeLoyalty(10,kind);updateHud();save();renderHeroHall(kind);
};
const btn=document.getElementById('recruit_'+kind);
if(btn)btn.onclick=()=>{
const cost=50+pendingRecruit.level*20;
if(player.gold<cost)return;
if(player[kind]&&replaceArmed!==kind){replaceArmed=kind;renderHeroHall(kind);return;}
replaceArmed=null;
if(player[kind]){const old=player[kind];stashGear(old);showToast(old.name+' 離開了隊伍,裝備留在物品欄。');}
player.gold-=cost;
{const h=heroDef(pendingRecruit.name);pendingRecruit.loyalty=kind==='brother'?60:(h?h.loyalty:70);pendingRecruit.sworn=false;pendingRecruit.lastGift=weekIdx();}
player[kind]=pendingRecruit;
showToast('🎉 '+pendingRecruit.name+' 加入了你的隊伍!');
pendingRecruit=null;
updateHud();save();renderHeroHall(kind);updateHeroTabs();
};
}
function renderMerc(){
const cap=troopCap(),cur=mercCount();
const kid=currentSettlement?(currentSettlement.type==='capital'?currentSettlement.obj.id:currentSettlement.obj.kingdom):null;
const k=KINGDOMS.find(x=>x.id===kid);
let html='';
html+=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>兵力上限</b><span>${cur} / ${cap}</span></div></div>`;
if(k)html+=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>本地兵種</b><span>${k.name}（${k.elem}屬性）</span></div></div>`;
MERCS.forEach((m,i)=>{
if(m.kingdom!==kid)return;
const locked=player.level<m.lvl;
const cnt=mercs[i]||0;
const tier=mercTierOf(i);
const tierLabel=cnt>0?TIER_NAMES[tier]:'';
const pool=recruitPool[i]||0;
const canHire=!locked&&player.gold>=mercCost(m)&&cur<cap&&pool>0;
const statLine=locked?'需求 Lv.'+m.lvl
:cnt>0?'❤️ '+mercCurHp(i)+'/'+mercMaxHp(i)+'　攻'+Math.round(m.atk*TIER_MULT[tier]*(1+((mercUpgrade[i]||0)*0.25)))+'／每人　可募集 '+pool
:'花費 💰'+mercCost(m)+'／每人　攻'+m.atk+' 血'+m.hp+'　可募集 '+pool;
html+=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>${m.icon} ${m.n}${tierLabel?'('+tierLabel+')':''} x${cnt}</b><span>${statLine}</span></div><button class="buy" data-i="${i}" ${canHire?'':'disabled'}>${locked?'鎖定':pool<=0?'兵源不足':'僱用'}</button></div>`;
if(cnt>0&&tier===2){
const upLv=mercUpgrade[i]||0;
if(upLv<3){
const upCost=(upLv+1)*150;
const canUp=player.gold>=upCost;
html+=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>⭐ 菁英裝備強化 +${upLv}→+${upLv+1}</b><span>攻擊與血量大幅提升　💰${upCost}</span></div><button class="buy" data-up="${i}" ${canUp?'':'disabled'}>強化</button></div>`;
}else{
html+=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><span>${m.icon} ${m.n} ⭐ 已強化至最高 +3</span></div></div>`;
}
}
});
document.getElementById('mercPane').innerHTML=html;
document.querySelectorAll('#mercPane .buy[data-i]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
const i=+b.dataset.i;
if((recruitPool[i]||0)<=0)return;
recruitPool[i]--;
player.gold-=mercCost(MERCS[i]);
mercs[i]=(mercs[i]||0)+1;
const perHp=Math.round(MERCS[i].hp*TIER_MULT[mercTierOf(i)]*(1+((mercUpgrade[i]||0)*0.25)));
mercHp[i]=(mercHp[i]===undefined?perHp*(mercs[i]-1):mercHp[i])+perHp;
updateHud();save();renderMerc();
});
document.querySelectorAll('#mercPane .buy[data-up]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
const i=+b.dataset.up;
const upLv=mercUpgrade[i]||0;
const upCost=(upLv+1)*150;
if(player.gold<upCost||upLv>=3)return;
player.gold-=upCost;
mercUpgrade[i]=upLv+1;
showToast('⭐ '+MERCS[i].n+' 裝備強化至 +'+(upLv+1)+'!');
updateHud();save();renderMerc();
});
}
function renderInn(){
const isVillage=currentSettlement&&currentSettlement.type==='village';
const isHomeVillage=isVillage&&currentSettlement.obj&&(currentSettlement.obj.id===player.homeVillageId||npcs.some(n=>currentSettlement.obj.id===n.homeVillageId));
const isFreeHome=isHomeVillage&&player.level<=10;
const cost=isFreeHome?0:(isVillage?Math.max(3,Math.round(player.level*2.5)):Math.max(5,player.level*5));
const mercsWounded=MERCS.some((mm,i)=>mercs[i]>0&&mercCurHp(i)<mercMaxHp(i));
const compWounded=player.companion&&player.companion.hp<player.companion.maxHp;
const brotherWounded=player.brother&&player.brother.hp<player.brother.maxHp;
const full=player.hp>=player.maxHp&&!mercsWounded&&!compWounded&&!brotherWounded;
const canAfford=player.gold>=cost;
let costLabel=isFreeHome?'免費（家鄉優惠,11級起收費）':'花費 💰'+cost+(isVillage?'（比王城便宜）':'');
let html=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>🛏️ 住宿一晚</b><span>${full?'全軍生命值已全滿':'恢復你與全體部隊生命值　'+costLabel}</span></div><button class="buy" id="sleepBtn" ${(full||!canAfford)?'disabled':''}>${full?'已滿血':'投宿'}</button></div>`;
document.getElementById('innPane').innerHTML=html;
const btn=document.getElementById('sleepBtn');
if(btn)btn.onclick=()=>{
player.gold-=cost;player.hp=player.maxHp;
MERCS.forEach((mm,i)=>{if(mercs[i]>0)mercHp[i]=mercMaxHp(i);});
if(player.companion)player.companion.hp=player.companion.maxHp;
if(player.brother)player.brother.hp=player.brother.maxHp;
updateHud();save();renderInn();
};
}

// ---- Map & movement ----
const canvas=document.getElementById('map');const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
const miniCanvas=document.getElementById('minimap');const miniCtx=miniCanvas.getContext('2d');
const MINI_CSS=112,MINI_DPR=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
miniCanvas.width=Math.round(MINI_CSS*MINI_DPR);
miniCanvas.height=Math.round(MINI_CSS*MINI_DPR);
miniCtx.setTransform(MINI_DPR,0,0,MINI_DPR,0,0);
let VIEW_W=window.innerWidth,VIEW_H=400;
function resize(){
const dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
canvas.style.height=document.getElementById('wrap').clientHeight+'px';
const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
VIEW_W=rect.width;
VIEW_H=rect.height;
canvas.width=Math.round(VIEW_W*dpr);
canvas.height=Math.round(VIEW_H*dpr);
ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
}
window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
window.addEventListener('orientationchange',()=>setTimeout(resize,150));
if(window.visualViewport)window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize',resize);

let target=null;
function findTappedEntity(wx,wy){
{const nn=activeNpcs().find(n=>Math.hypot(wx-n.x,wy-n.y)<30);if(nn&&!gameOver)return{kind:'npcBoss',obj:nn};}
for(const c of campCenters){
if(campMembers(c.id).length>0&&Math.hypot(wx-c.x,wy-c.y)<34+campMembers(c.id).length*2.6+15)return{kind:'camp',obj:c};
}
for(const p of patrols){
if(p.alive&&Math.hypot(wx-p.x,wy-p.y)<26)return{kind:'patrol',obj:p};
}
for(const g of garrisons){
if(g.alive&&Math.hypot(wx-g.x,wy-g.y)<26)return{kind:'garrison',obj:g};
}
for(const cg of capitalGuards){
if(cg.alive&&Math.hypot(wx-cg.x,wy-cg.y)<26){
const c=CAPITALS.find(x=>x.id===cg.capitalId);
return c?{kind:'capital',obj:c}:{kind:'capitalGuard',obj:cg};
}
}
for(const cp of CHECKPOINTS){
if(Math.hypot(wx-cp.x,wy-cp.y)<45)return{kind:'checkpoint',obj:cp};
}
for(const c of CAPITALS){
if(Math.hypot(wx-c.x,wy-c.y)<(c.isCenter?60:35))return{kind:'capital',obj:c};
}
for(const o of OUTPOSTS){
if(Math.hypot(wx-o.x,wy-o.y)<26)return{kind:'village',obj:o};
}
return null;
}
function openEntityInfo(hit){
inEntity=true;target=null;
try{
const{kind,obj}=hit;
const title=document.getElementById('entityTitle'),body=document.getElementById('entityBody');
if(kind==='npcBoss'){
npc=obj;
const def=ROAMING.find(d=>d.id===obj.id);
title.textContent=obj.icon+' '+obj.name+'(Lv.'+obj.level+')';
body.innerHTML=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>流動勢力</b><span>${def?def.desc:''}<br>兵員 ${obj.troops||0}　據點 ${obj.captured.length+obj.capturedCapitals.length}</span></div><button class="buy" id="entityAttackNpcBtn">⚔️ 攻擊</button></div>`;
}else if(kind==='camp'){
const members=campMembers(obj.id);
title.textContent='⛺ 山寨盜匪團(x'+members.length+')';
body.innerHTML=`
<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>⚔️ 攻擊</b><span>對整團盜匪發動戰鬥</span></div><button class="buy" id="entityAttackCampBtn">攻擊</button></div>
<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>🔍 查看部隊</b><span>檢視山寨內的兵種組成</span></div><button class="buy" id="entityViewCampBtn">查看</button></div>
<div id="campDetail"></div>`;
}else if(kind==='patrol'){
const friendly=patrolFriendly(obj);
title.textContent=(friendly?'🤝 ':'⚔️ ')+obj.name;
body.innerHTML=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>部隊組成</b><span>${obj.icon} Lv.${obj.level}　❤️${obj.maxHp}　⚔️${obj.atk}${obj.elem?'　屬性:'+obj.elem:''}</span></div>${friendly?'<span style="font-size:12px;">我方部隊,無法攻擊</span>':`<button class="buy" id="entityAttackBtn">⚔️ 攻擊</button>`}</div>`;
}else if(kind==='garrison'||kind==='capitalGuard'){
title.textContent='⚔️ '+obj.name;
body.innerHTML=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>Lv.${obj.level}</b><span>❤️${obj.maxHp}　⚔️${obj.atk}${obj.elem?'　屬性:'+obj.elem:''}</span></div><button class="buy" id="entityAttackBtn">⚔️ 攻擊</button></div>`;
}else if(kind==='checkpoint'){
const names=obj.owners.map(id=>{const k=KINGDOMS.find(x=>x.id===id);return k?k.name:'';}).join('／');
const blocked=checkpointBlocked(obj);
const captured=checkpointCaptured(obj);
const npcHolds=npcOwnsCheckpoint(obj.key);
title.textContent='⛩️ '+obj.name+'（'+names+'）'+(npcHolds?' 👑':'');
if(checkpointUnderPlayerControl(obj)&&!npcHolds){
const key=settlementKey('checkpoint',obj);
const cap=garrisonCap('checkpoint',obj);
const cur=(player.stationed&&player.stationed[key])||0;
const statusMsg=captured?'🚩 此關已被你攻下,永久免費通行':'✅ 母國關卡,永久免費通行';
let stationHtml=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><span>${statusMsg}</span></div></div>`;
stationHtml+=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>🛡️ 目前駐軍強度</b><span>${Math.round(cur)} / ${cap}</span></div></div>`;
let any=false;
MERCS.forEach((mm,i)=>{
if(mercs[i]>0){
any=true;
const tier=mercTierOf(i),mult=TIER_MULT[tier];
const strength=Math.round((Math.round(mm.atk*mult)+Math.round(mm.hp*mult))/2);
stationHtml+=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>${mm.icon} ${mm.n} x${mercs[i]}</b><span>每名派駐強度 +${strength}</span></div><button class="buy" data-cpstation="${i}" ${cur+strength>cap?'disabled':''}>派駐1名</button></div>`;
}
});
if(!any)stationHtml+='<div class="item"><div class="info"><span>目前沒有可派駐的部隊</span></div></div>';
body.innerHTML=stationHtml;
}else if(npcHolds){
const guard=checkpointGuards.find(g=>g.checkpointKey===obj.key&&g.alive);
body.innerHTML='<div class="item"><div class="info"><span>👑 此關已被 NPC 領主攻佔,你仍須繳費或攻打才能通行</span></div></div>'+
(guard?`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>通行費</b><span>💰 ${checkpointToll()}（可通行 ${CHECKPOINT_PASS_TURNS} 回合)</span></div><button class="buy" id="entityTollBtn">繳費通過</button></div><div class="item"><div class="info"><b>⚔️ 奪回關卡</b><span>守軍 Lv.${guard.level}　❤️${guard.maxHp}　⚔️${guard.atk}　打贏可從NPC手中奪回</span></div><button class="buy" id="entityAttackCheckpointBtn">攻擊</button></div>`:'');
}else if(!blocked){
const remain=checkpointCleared[obj.key]?Math.max(0,checkpointCleared[obj.key]-turnCount):0;
body.innerHTML=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><span>✅ 已繳費通行中${remain>0?'（還剩 '+remain+' 回合)':''}</span></div></div>`;
}else{
const guard=checkpointGuards.find(g=>g.checkpointKey===obj.key&&g.alive);
body.innerHTML=`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>通行費</b><span>💰 ${checkpointToll()}（可通行 ${CHECKPOINT_PASS_TURNS} 回合)</span></div><button class="buy" id="entityTollBtn">繳費通過</button></div>`+
(guard?`<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>⚔️ 攻打關卡</b><span>守軍 Lv.${guard.level}　❤️${guard.maxHp}　⚔️${guard.atk}　打贏永久佔領此關</span></div><button class="buy" id="entityAttackCheckpointBtn">攻擊</button></div>`:'');
}
}else if(kind==='capital'||kind==='village'){
const owned=kind==='capital'?isCapitalCaptured(obj.id):isCaptured(obj.id);
title.textContent=(kind==='capital'?obj.icon:'🏘️')+' '+obj.name;
if(owned){
body.innerHTML=`<button class="buy" id="entityEnterBtn" style="width:100%;">🚪 進入</button>`;
}else if(kind==='capital'&&!canChallengeCapital(obj)){
body.innerHTML=`
<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>🔒 尚不能攻擊</b><span>需先攻下四方王國,才能挑戰中央王城</span></div></div>
<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>🚪 免費進入</b><span>和平進入逛商店旅館,不會佔領此地</span></div><button class="buy" id="entityEnterBtn">進入</button></div>`;
}else{
body.innerHTML=`
<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>🚪 免費進入</b><span>和平進入逛商店旅館,不會佔領此地</span></div><button class="buy" id="entityEnterBtn">進入</button></div>
<div class="item"><div class="info"><b>⚔️ 攻擊征服</b><span>發動戰爭,打贏永久佔領此地</span></div><button class="buy" id="entityAttackEnterBtn">攻擊</button></div>`;
}
}
document.getElementById('entityModal').classList.remove('hidden');
const atkBtn=document.getElementById('entityAttackBtn');
if(atkBtn)atkBtn.onclick=()=>{
document.getElementById('entityModal').classList.add('hidden');inEntity=false;
try{triggerBattle(obj);}catch(err){inBattle=false;}
};
const atkNpcBtn=document.getElementById('entityAttackNpcBtn');
if(atkNpcBtn)atkNpcBtn.onclick=()=>{
document.getElementById('entityModal').classList.add('hidden');inEntity=false;
try{triggerBattle(npcAsEnemy());}catch(err){inBattle=false;}
};
const atkCampBtn=document.getElementById('entityAttackCampBtn');
if(atkCampBtn)atkCampBtn.onclick=()=>{
document.getElementById('entityModal').classList.add('hidden');inEntity=false;
try{triggerCampBattle(obj.id);}catch(err){inBattle=false;}
};
const viewCampBtn=document.getElementById('entityViewCampBtn');
if(viewCampBtn)viewCampBtn.onclick=()=>{
const members=campMembers(obj.id);
const counts={};
members.forEach(mm=>{counts[mm.name]=(counts[mm.name]||{icon:mm.icon,level:mm.level,n:0});counts[mm.name].n++;});
let html='<div style="margin-top:8px;">';
Object.keys(counts).forEach(name=>{
const c=counts[name];
html+=`<div class="srow"><span>${c.icon} ${name} Lv.${c.level}</span><b>x${c.n}</b></div>`;
});
html+='</div>';
document.getElementById('campDetail').innerHTML=html;
};
document.querySelectorAll('#entityBody [data-cpstation]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
const i=+b.dataset.cpstation;
if((mercs[i]||0)<=0)return;
const tier=mercTierOf(i),mult=TIER_MULT[tier];
const strength=Math.round((Math.round(MERCS[i].atk*mult)+Math.round(MERCS[i].hp*mult))/2);
const key=settlementKey('checkpoint',obj);
mercs[i]-=1;
player.stationed=player.stationed||{};
player.stationed[key]=(player.stationed[key]||0)+strength;
updateHud();save();
openEntityInfo({kind,obj});
});
const atkCpBtn=document.getElementById('entityAttackCheckpointBtn');
if(atkCpBtn)atkCpBtn.onclick=()=>{
const guard=checkpointGuards.find(g=>g.checkpointKey===obj.key&&g.alive);
if(!guard)return;
document.getElementById('entityModal').classList.add('hidden');inEntity=false;
try{triggerBattle(guard);}catch(err){inBattle=false;}
};
const tollBtn=document.getElementById('entityTollBtn');
if(tollBtn)tollBtn.onclick=()=>{
const toll=checkpointToll();
if(player.gold<toll)return;
player.gold-=toll;checkpointCleared[obj.key]=turnCount+CHECKPOINT_PASS_TURNS;
updateHud();save();
document.getElementById('entityModal').classList.add('hidden');inEntity=false;
};
const enterBtn=document.getElementById('entityEnterBtn');
if(enterBtn)enterBtn.onclick=()=>{
document.getElementById('entityModal').classList.add('hidden');inEntity=false;
openSettlement(kind,obj);
};
const atkEnterBtn=document.getElementById('entityAttackEnterBtn');
if(atkEnterBtn)atkEnterBtn.onclick=()=>{
document.getElementById('entityModal').classList.add('hidden');inEntity=false;
const g=kind==='capital'?capitalGuards.find(x=>x.capitalId===obj.id&&x.alive):garrisons.find(x=>x.outpostId===obj.id&&x.alive);
if(g){try{triggerBattle(g);}catch(err){inBattle=false;}}
};
}catch(err){
inEntity=false;
document.getElementById('entityModal').classList.add('hidden');
}
}
document.getElementById('entityClose').onclick=()=>{document.getElementById('entityModal').classList.add('hidden');inEntity=false;};

// ---- 自由平移:拖曳地圖移動視野(超過10px才算拖曳),輕點照舊;點小地圖跳轉;移動時自動回正 ----
let panX=0,panY=0,panDrag=null;
function viewCenter(){
if(cameraFocus)return{x:cameraFocus.x,y:cameraFocus.y};
return{x:Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,player.x+panX)),y:Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,player.y+panY))};
}
function recenterView(){panX=0;panY=0;}
function isPanned(){return Math.abs(panX)>1||Math.abs(panY)>1;}
let recenterShown=false;
function syncRecenterBtn(){const v=isPanned()&&!cameraFocus;if(v!==recenterShown){recenterShown=v;const b=document.getElementById('recenterBtn');if(b)b.classList.toggle('hidden',!v);}}
function uiBlocked(){return inBattle||inTown||inStatus||inBoot||inInn||inPatrolPhase||gameOver||inEntity||inNpcPhase||inEvent;}
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
if(uiBlocked())return;
panDrag={id:e.pointerId,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,px:panX,py:panY,moved:false};
try{canvas.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);}catch(err){}
});
canvas.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
if(!panDrag||panDrag.id!==e.pointerId)return;
const dx=e.clientX-panDrag.x,dy=e.clientY-panDrag.y;
if(!panDrag.moved&&Math.hypot(dx,dy)<10)return;
panDrag.moved=true;target=null;
panX=Math.min(WORLD-player.x,Math.max(-player.x,panDrag.px-dx));
panY=Math.min(WORLD-player.y,Math.max(-player.y,panDrag.py-dy));
});
canvas.addEventListener('pointerup',e=>{
if(!panDrag||panDrag.id!==e.pointerId)return;
const moved=panDrag.moved;panDrag=null;
if(moved||uiBlocked())return;
resize();
const rect=canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
const sx=e.clientX-rect.left,sy=e.clientY-rect.top,vc=viewCenter();
const ox=vc.x-VIEW_W/2,oy=vc.y-VIEW_H/2;
const wx=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,sx+ox)),wy=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,sy+oy));
const hit=findTappedEntity(wx,wy);
if(hit){openEntityInfo(hit);return;}
recenterView();
target={x:wx,y:wy};
});
canvas.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>{panDrag=null;});
document.getElementById('minimap').addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
if(uiBlocked())return;
e.stopPropagation();
const r=e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
const wx=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*WORLD,wy=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*WORLD;
panX=wx-player.x;panY=wy-player.y;
});
document.getElementById('recenterBtn').addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();recenterView();});

let joyActive=false,joyDX=0,joyDY=0;
const joyPad=document.getElementById('joyPad'),joyKnob=document.getElementById('joyKnob');
const JOY_R=42;
function joyMove(e){
if(!joyActive)return;
const rect=joyPad.getBoundingClientRect();
const cx=rect.left+rect.width/2,cy=rect.top+rect.height/2;
let dx=e.clientX-cx,dy=e.clientY-cy;
const dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
const clamped=Math.min(dist,JOY_R);
joyDX=(dx/dist)*(clamped/JOY_R);
joyDY=(dy/dist)*(clamped/JOY_R);
joyKnob.style.transform=`translate(${(dx/dist)*clamped}px,${(dy/dist)*clamped}px)`;
}
joyPad.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
if(inBattle||inTown||inStatus||inBoot||inInn||inPatrolPhase||gameOver||inEntity||inNpcPhase||inEvent)return;
e.stopPropagation();
joyActive=true;target=null;recenterView();
joyPad.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
joyMove(e);
});
joyPad.addEventListener('pointermove',joyMove);
function joyEnd(e){
joyActive=false;joyDX=0;joyDY=0;
joyKnob.style.transform='translate(0,0)';
}
joyPad.addEventListener('pointerup',joyEnd);
joyPad.addEventListener('pointercancel',joyEnd);
joyPad.addEventListener('pointerleave',e=>{if(e.buttons===0)joyEnd(e);});

const TILE=160;
function fractSin(v){const s=Math.sin(v)*43758.5453;return s-Math.floor(s);}
function tileNoise(gx,gy){
const s=6,cgx=Math.floor(gx/s),cgy=Math.floor(gy/s);
const n1=fractSin(cgx*12.9898+cgy*78.233);
const n2=fractSin(cgx*3.331+cgy*5.729+50);
return n1*0.65+n2*0.35;
}
const cornerCaps=CAPITALS.filter(c=>!c.isCenter);
const ringPairs=[[0,1],[1,3],[3,2],[2,0]];
const ROADS=[
...cornerCaps.map(c=>{
const k=KINGDOMS.find(x=>x.id===c.id);
const corner=kingdomCorner(k);
return{x1:corner.x,y1:corner.y,x2:QUAD,y2:QUAD};
}),
...ringPairs.map(([a,b])=>{
const ca=cornerCaps.find(c=>c.id===a),cb=cornerCaps.find(c=>c.id===b);
return{x1:ca.x,y1:ca.y,x2:cb.x,y2:cb.y};
})
];

const CHECKPOINT_ART_BY_KEY={spoke_0:'mengjin',spoke_1:'hulao',spoke_2:'hangu',spoke_3:'dagu',ring_0_1:'hulao',ring_1_3:'dagu',ring_3_2:'mengjin',ring_2_0:'hangu'};
const CHECKPOINT_ART_FLIP={ring_0_1:true,ring_1_3:true,ring_3_2:true,ring_2_0:true};// 外環沿用關樓圖並左右鏡像
const CHECKPOINT_ART_IMG={};
function checkpointArtFor(cp){
const k=CHECKPOINT_ART_BY_KEY[cp.key];if(!k||typeof Image==='undefined')return null;
if(!CHECKPOINT_ART_IMG[k]){const im=new Image();im.src=CHECKPOINT_ART_SRC[k];CHECKPOINT_ART_IMG[k]=im;}
return CHECKPOINT_ART_IMG[k];
}
const RING_NAMES={'0_1':'小平津','1_3':'轘轅關','3_2':'伊闕關','2_0':'廣成關'};// 東漢洛陽八關
const CHECKPOINTS=[
...cornerCaps.map((c,i)=>{
const angle=Math.atan2(QUAD-c.y,QUAD-c.x);
return{key:'spoke_'+c.id,name:SPOKE_NAMES[i]||('關卡'+c.id),owners:[c.id],x:QUAD-Math.cos(angle)*GATE_DIST,y:QUAD-Math.sin(angle)*GATE_DIST,angle};
}),
...ringPairs.map(([a,b])=>{
const ca=cornerCaps.find(c=>c.id===a),cb=cornerCaps.find(c=>c.id===b);
const mx=(ca.x+cb.x)/2,my=(ca.y+cb.y)/2;
const angle=Math.atan2(cb.y-ca.y,cb.x-ca.x);
return{key:'ring_'+a+'_'+b,name:RING_NAMES[a+'_'+b]||('關卡'+a+'-'+b),owners:[a,b],x:mx,y:my,angle};
})
];
let checkpointCleared={};
let checkpointGuards=[];
const CHECKPOINT_PASS_TURNS=5;
function makeCheckpointGuard(cp){
const isSpoke=cp.key.startsWith('spoke_');
const lvl=player.level+(isSpoke?8:5);
const mult=(isSpoke?1.3:1.1)*histCpMult(cp.key);
if(isLvbuGate(cp.key)){
const L=lvl+6,M=mult*1.8;
return{x:cp.x,y:cp.y,icon:'🔱',name:'呂布(虎牢關)',level:L,hp:Math.round((50+L*13)*M),maxHp:Math.round((50+L*13)*M),atk:Math.round((8+L*3.5)*M),exp:Math.round((40+L*9)*M*1.5),gold:Math.round((30+L*7)*M*1.5),alive:true,checkpointKey:cp.key,elem:'火',isLvbu:true};
}
return{x:cp.x,y:cp.y,icon:'🏯',name:cp.name+' 守軍',level:lvl,hp:Math.round((50+lvl*13)*mult),maxHp:Math.round((50+lvl*13)*mult),atk:Math.round((8+lvl*3.5)*mult),exp:Math.round((40+lvl*9)*mult),gold:Math.round((30+lvl*7)*mult),alive:true,checkpointKey:cp.key,elem:null};
}
function initCheckpointGuards(){
checkpointGuards=CHECKPOINTS.filter(cp=>!(player.capturedCheckpoints||[]).includes(cp.key)).map(makeCheckpointGuard);
}
function checkpointCaptured(cp){return(player.capturedCheckpoints||[]).includes(cp.key);}
function checkpointUnderPlayerControl(cp){
if(checkpointCaptured(cp))return true;
if(player.homeKingdom!==undefined&&cp.owners.includes(player.homeKingdom))return true;
if(cp.owners.some(id=>isCapitalCaptured(id)))return true;
return false;
}
function checkpointBlocked(cp){
if(player.homeKingdom!==undefined&&cp.owners.includes(player.homeKingdom))return false;
if(cp.owners.some(id=>isCapitalCaptured(id)))return false;
if(checkpointCaptured(cp))return false;
return!(checkpointCleared[cp.key]&&turnCount<checkpointCleared[cp.key]);
}
function checkpointToll(){const h=player.hist||{};return Math.round((20+player.level*3)*(h.dong&&!h.move?2:1));}
function distToSegment(px,py,x1,y1,x2,y2){
const dx=x2-x1,dy=y2-y1;
const len2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
let t=len2===0?0:((px-x1)*dx+(py-y1)*dy)/len2;
t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));
return Math.hypot(px-(x1+t*dx),py-(y1+t*dy));
}
function isNearRoad(x,y){
for(const r of ROADS){if(distToSegment(x,y,r.x1,r.y1,r.x2,r.y2)<40)return true;}
return false;
}
// 平滑地形場:把 6x6 格一塊的區塊噪聲做雙線性內插,再疊一層細碎擾動,邊界變成自然曲線(通行判定與畫面一致)
const NOISE_MEMO=new Map();
function memoN(tag,a,b,f){const key=tag+a+','+b;let v=NOISE_MEMO.get(key);if(v===undefined){v=f();NOISE_MEMO.set(key,v);}return v;}// 噪聲格點快取
function smoothField(x,y){
const B=TILE*6,u=x/B-0.5,v=y/B-0.5,i=Math.floor(u),j=Math.floor(v);
let fx=u-i,fy=v-j;fx=fx*fx*(3-2*fx);fy=fy*fy*(3-2*fy);
const n=(a,b)=>memoN('t',a,b,()=>tileNoise(a*6,b*6));
const base=(n(i,j)*(1-fx)+n(i+1,j)*fx)*(1-fy)+(n(i,j+1)*(1-fx)+n(i+1,j+1)*fx)*fy;
const D=240,du=x/D,dv=y/D,di=Math.floor(du),dj=Math.floor(dv);
let gx=du-di,gy=dv-dj;gx=gx*gx*(3-2*gx);gy=gy*gy*(3-2*gy);
const h=(a,b)=>memoN('d',a,b,()=>fractSin(a*127.1+b*311.7+7.3));
const det=(h(di,dj)*(1-gx)+h(di+1,dj)*gx)*(1-gy)+(h(di,dj+1)*(1-gx)+h(di+1,dj+1)*gx)*gy;
return base+(det-0.5)*0.12;
}
// 湖泊:另一層低頻噪聲,只在非山區、遠離據點/關卡/中央山牆處形成;不可通行,道路經過處架橋
function lakeField(x,y){
const S=900,u=x/S,v=y/S,i=Math.floor(u),j=Math.floor(v);
let fx=u-i,fy=v-j;fx=fx*fx*(3-2*fx);fy=fy*fy*(3-2*fy);
const h=(a,b)=>memoN('l',a,b,()=>fractSin(a*269.5+b*183.3+41.7));
const base=(h(i,j)*(1-fx)+h(i+1,j)*fx)*(1-fy)+(h(i,j+1)*(1-fx)+h(i+1,j+1)*fx)*fy;
const D=220,du=x/D,dv=y/D,di=Math.floor(du),dj=Math.floor(dv);
let gx=du-di,gy=dv-dj;gx=gx*gx*(3-2*gx);gy=gy*gy*(3-2*gy);
const k=(a,b)=>memoN('k',a,b,()=>fractSin(a*71.3+b*19.9+3.1));
const det=(k(di,dj)*(1-gx)+k(di+1,dj)*gx)*(1-gy)+(k(di,dj+1)*(1-gx)+k(di+1,dj+1)*gx)*gy;
return base+(det-0.5)*0.18;
}
const LAKE_T=0.885;// 提高閾值縮小湖泊面積至約原本1/3
// ================= 地形場(連續數值,>0 即成立;畫面輪廓與通行判定共用同一組) =================
// 山脈骨架:仿中國主要山系走向(座標為全圖比例)
const RIDGES=[
{n:'祁連隴山',w:150,p:[[0.03,0.42],[0.11,0.31],[0.21,0.15],[0.30,0.03]]},
{n:'燕山',w:135,p:[[0.44,0.09],[0.60,0.06],[0.79,0.11],[0.97,0.08]]},
{n:'太行山',w:130,p:[[0.97,0.41],[0.85,0.40],[0.71,0.35]]},
{n:'秦嶺',w:160,p:[[0.02,0.58],[0.14,0.55],[0.26,0.57],[0.31,0.62]]},
{n:'大巴巫山',w:140,p:[[0.07,0.71],[0.19,0.80],[0.29,0.87],[0.37,0.98]]},
{n:'武夷南嶺',w:140,p:[[0.62,0.97],[0.72,0.87],[0.86,0.83],[0.98,0.70]]},
{n:'大別山',w:120,p:[[0.79,0.56],[0.90,0.52],[0.99,0.54]]}
].map(r=>{const w=r.w*0.62,xs=r.p.map(p=>p[0]*WORLD),ys=r.p.map(p=>p[1]*WORLD),m=w*2.8;return{...r,w,seg:r.p.slice(1).map((q,i)=>[r.p[i][0]*WORLD,r.p[i][1]*WORLD,q[0]*WORLD,q[1]*WORLD]),bx0:Math.min(...xs)-m,bx1:Math.max(...xs)+m,by0:Math.min(...ys)-m,by1:Math.max(...ys)+m};});
function settleDist(x,y){let m=1e9;for(const o of OUTPOSTS){const d=Math.hypot(x-o.x,y-o.y);if(d<m)m=d;}for(const c of CAPITALS){const d=Math.hypot(x-c.x,y-c.y);if(d<m)m=d;}return m;}
function fMount(x,y){
let v=-1;
for(const r of RIDGES){
if(x<r.bx0||x>r.bx1||y<r.by0||y>r.by1)continue;// 包圍盒快速排除
let d=1e9;for(const s of r.seg){const t=distToSegment(x,y,s[0],s[1],s[2],s[3]);if(t<d)d=t;}
if(d>r.w*2.6)continue;
d+=(lowNoise(x*1.7+r.w,y*1.7,260)-0.5)*r.w*0.9;// 邊緣不規則
const we=r.w*(0.4+1.25*lowNoise(x+r.w*7,y,430));// 寬度大幅起伏:時寬時窄
let s2=(we-d)/we;
const gap=lowNoise(x*1.3,y*1.3+999,640);if(gap<0.16)s2-=(0.16-gap)*5;// 偶爾斷開形成隘口
if(s2>v)v=s2;
}
const dC=Math.hypot(x-QUAD,y-QUAD),ring=Math.min(dC-CENTER_WALL_INNER,CENTER_WALL_OUTER-dC)/140;
if(ring>v)v=ring;
return Math.min(v,(settleDist(x,y)-240)/150);
}
function fWater(x,y){const b=fWaterBase(x,y);if(b<=-0.05)return b;return Math.min(b,-fMount(x,y)*0.3-0.02);}
function fWaterBase(x,y){
let v=lakeField(x,y)-LAKE_T;if(v<-0.05)return v;
for(const o of OUTPOSTS)v=Math.min(v,(Math.hypot(x-o.x,y-o.y)-340)/1500);
for(const c of CAPITALS)v=Math.min(v,(Math.hypot(x-c.x,y-c.y)-(c.isCenter?420:360))/1500);
for(const cp of CHECKPOINTS)v=Math.min(v,(Math.hypot(x-cp.x,y-cp.y)-320)/1500);
const dC=Math.hypot(x-QUAD,y-QUAD);v=Math.min(v,Math.max(CENTER_WALL_INNER-200-dC,dC-CENTER_WALL_OUTER-200)/1500);
return v;
}
function fGrass(x,y){
const base=Math.max(smoothField(x,y)-0.444,(240-settleDist(x,y))/1500);
const m=fMount(x,y),w=fWater(x,y);
if(m<=0&&w<=0&&m>-0.2&&w>-0.2)return Math.max(base,0.5);// 山腳與湖泊交界留一圈綠地過渡,避免山直接貼水
return base;
}
function lakeOK(x,y){return fWater(x,y)>-1;}
function biomeAt(x,y){
if(fMount(x,y)>0)return 'mountain';
if(fWater(x,y)>0)return 'water';
if(fGrass(x,y)>0)return 'grass';
return 'plain';
}

function terrainAt(x,y){
if(isNearRoad(x,y))return 'road';
return biomeAt(x,y);
}
function checkpointWallBlocked(x,y){
for(const cp of CHECKPOINTS){
if(!checkpointBlocked(cp))continue;
const perp=cp.angle+Math.PI/2;
const x1=cp.x+Math.cos(perp)*260,y1=cp.y+Math.sin(perp)*260;
const x2=cp.x-Math.cos(perp)*260,y2=cp.y-Math.sin(perp)*260;
if(distToSegment(x,y,x1,y1,x2,y2)<55)return true;
}
return false;
}
function canMoveTo(x,y){
if(x<0||x>WORLD||y<0||y>WORLD)return false;
const tt=terrainAt(x,y);if(tt==='mountain'||tt==='water')return false;
if(checkpointWallBlocked(x,y))return false;
return true;
}
const TERRAIN_SPEED={road:1.6,plain:1.1,grass:1.0,mountain:0.5,water:0.5};
const TERRAIN_COLOR={plain:'#b8dd7f',grass:'#7ead5f',mountain:'#c9c2b0'};
const TERRAIN_NAME={road:'道路',plain:'平原',grass:'草原',mountain:'山脈(無法通行)',water:'湖泊(無法通行)'};

const MONSTER_ART_BY_ICON={'🚶':'liumin','🥷':'daozei','🦹':'qiangdao','💂':'huangjin','🥸':'tufei','🧔':'liukou'};
const UNIT_IMG={};
function unitImg(k){if(typeof Image==='undefined'||!UNIT_ART_SRC[k])return null;if(!UNIT_IMG[k]){const im=new Image();im.src=UNIT_ART_SRC[k];UNIT_IMG[k]=im;}return UNIT_IMG[k];}
function drawUnitSprite(k,sx,footY,h){// 腳底對齊 footY,腳下加淡影
const im=unitImg(k);if(!im||!im.complete||!im.naturalWidth)return false;
const w=h*im.naturalWidth/im.naturalHeight;
ctx.save();ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.22)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(sx,footY-1,h*0.3,h*0.08,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();
ctx.drawImage(im,sx-w/2,footY-h,w,h);return true;
}
function drawLvTag(lv,sx,y){ctx.save();ctx.font='bold 10px sans-serif';const t='Lv'+lv,tw=ctx.measureText(t).width;ctx.fillStyle='rgba(30,20,10,0.6)';ctx.fillRect(sx-tw/2-3,y-6,tw+6,12);ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.fillText(t,sx,y+0.5);ctx.restore();}
