const ROAD_STRIP_IMG=new Image();ROAD_STRIP_IMG.src=ROAD_STRIP_SRC;
function mountainImg(k){if(typeof Image==='undefined')return null;if(!MOUNTAIN_IMG[k]){const im=new Image();im.src=MOUNTAIN_ART_SRC[k];MOUNTAIN_IMG[k]=im;}return MOUNTAIN_IMG[k];}
function mountainArtReady(){return ['1','2','3','4','5'].every(k=>{const im=mountainImg(k);return im&&im.complete&&im.naturalWidth>0;});}

const PROP_IMG={};
function propImg(k){if(typeof Image==='undefined')return null;if(!PROP_IMG[k]){const im=new Image();im.src=PROP_ART_SRC[k];PROP_IMG[k]=im;}return PROP_IMG[k];}
function propArtReady(){return Object.keys(PROP_ART_SRC).every(k=>{const im=propImg(k);return im&&im.complete&&im.naturalWidth>0;});}
function hash2(a,b){return fractSin(a*91.7+b*47.3+13.1);}
function lowNoise(x,y,S){const u=x/S,v=y/S,i=Math.floor(u),j=Math.floor(v);let fx=u-i,fy=v-j;fx=fx*fx*(3-2*fx);fy=fy*fy*(3-2*fy);
return (hash2(i,j)*(1-fx)+hash2(i+1,j)*fx)*(1-fy)+(hash2(i,j+1)*(1-fx)+hash2(i+1,j+1)*fx)*fy;}
function propOK(x,y){
for(const r of ROADS)if(distToSegment(x,y,r.x1,r.y1,r.x2,r.y2)<140)return false;
for(const o of OUTPOSTS)if(Math.hypot(x-o.x,y-o.y)<260)return false;
for(const c of CAPITALS)if(Math.hypot(x-c.x,y-c.y)<(c.isCenter?360:300))return false;
for(const cp of CHECKPOINTS)if(Math.hypot(x-cp.x,y-cp.y)<260)return false;
for(let a=0;a<6;a++){const t=biomeAt(x+Math.cos(a)*90,y+Math.sin(a)*60);if(t!=='grass'&&t!=='plain')return false;}
return true;
}
function contourFill(g,V,N,S,color){// 以 marching squares 把數值場 >0 的區域描成平滑輪廓並填色
g.beginPath();
const P=(i,j)=>V[j*(N+1)+i];
for(let j=0;j<N;j++)for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
const c=[[i,j,P(i,j)],[i+1,j,P(i+1,j)],[i+1,j+1,P(i+1,j+1)],[i,j+1,P(i,j+1)]];
if(c.every(k=>k[2]<=0))continue;
if(c.every(k=>k[2]>0)){g.rect(i*S,j*S,S,S);continue;}
const pts=[];
for(let k=0;k<4;k++){const a=c[k],b=c[(k+1)%4];if(a[2]>0)pts.push([a[0]*S,a[1]*S]);if((a[2]>0)!==(b[2]>0)){const t=a[2]/(a[2]-b[2]);pts.push([(a[0]+(b[0]-a[0])*t)*S,(a[1]+(b[1]-a[1])*t)*S]);}}
g.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);for(let k=1;k<pts.length;k++)g.lineTo(pts[k][0],pts[k][1]);g.closePath();
}
g.fillStyle=color;g.fill();
}
function mountSpriteAt(px,py,small){// 山體規格(決定性,各區塊一致)
const dC=Math.hypot(px-QUAD,py-QUAD),wall=dC>CENTER_WALL_INNER-40&&dC<CENTER_WALL_OUTER+40,q=hash2(px*0.37,py*0.53);
const kind=wall?(q<0.5?'3':'5'):(q<0.38?'2':q<0.76?'4':q<0.87?'3':(q<0.99||small)?'5':'1');// 火山僅約1%
const w=small?82+hash2(py,px*3)*26:122+hash2(py,px*3)*58;
return{px,py,kind,w,flip:hash2(px*2,py)<0.5};
}
function primaryMount(ix,iy,P){
const wx=ix*P,wy=iy*P,r=hash2(wx*1.3,wy*0.7),odd=(iy&1)?P*0.5:0;
const px=wx+odd+(hash2(wy,wx*2)-0.5)*P*0.9,py=wy+(r-0.5)*P*0.8;
if(px<0||py<0||px>WORLD||py>WORLD||fMount(px,py)<=0||isNearRoad(px,py))return null;
return mountSpriteAt(px,py,false);
}
function renderChunk(cx,cy){
const dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=Math.round(CHUNK*dpr);cv.height=Math.round(CHUNK*dpr);
const g=cv.getContext('2d');g.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
const X0=cx*CHUNK,Y0=cy*CHUNK,S=8,N=CHUNK/S,L=(N+1)*(N+1);
const VM=new Float32Array(L),VW=new Float32Array(L),VG=new Float32Array(L);
for(let j=0;j<=N;j++)for(let i=0;i<=N;i++){
const wx=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,X0+i*S)),wy=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,Y0+j*S)),k=j*(N+1)+i;
const m=fMount(wx,wy);VM[k]=m;VW[k]=Math.min(fWaterBase(wx,wy),-m*0.3-0.02);VG[k]=fGrass(wx,wy);
}
const bioAt=(wx,wy)=>{const i=Math.round((wx-X0)/S),j=Math.round((wy-Y0)/S);if(i<0||j<0||i>N||j>N)return biomeAt(wx,wy);const k=j*(N+1)+i;return VM[k]>0?'mountain':VW[k]>0?'water':VG[k]>0?'grass':'plain';};
// 底色與平滑輪廓:平原 → 草原 → 大範圍柔和明暗 → 沙岸 → 淺水 → 深水 → 山腳
const rgb=c=>'rgb('+c.join(',')+')';
g.fillStyle=rgb(TERRAIN_FILL.plain);g.fillRect(0,0,CHUNK,CHUNK);
contourFill(g,VG,N,S,rgb(TERRAIN_FILL.grass));
const VS=VW.map(v=>v+0.016),VD=VW.map(v=>v-0.04);
contourFill(g,VS,N,S,'rgb(214,200,150)');
contourFill(g,VW,N,S,'rgb(96,150,168)');
contourFill(g,VD,N,S,'rgb(70,124,156)');
contourFill(g,VM,N,S,'rgb(104,138,74)');
// 手繪筆觸:草叢;湖面波光
const M=40,TS=13;
for(let wy=Math.floor((Y0-M)/TS)*TS;wy<Y0+CHUNK+M;wy+=TS)for(let wx=Math.floor((X0-M)/TS)*TS;wx<X0+CHUNK+M;wx+=TS){
const r=hash2(wx,wy),px=wx+hash2(wy,wx)*TS,py=wy+r*TS;
if(px<0||py<0||px>WORLD||py>WORLD)continue;
const t=bioAt(px,py),lx=px-X0,ly=py-Y0;
if(t==='grass'||t==='plain'){
const q=hash2(px,py*1.3);if(q>0.55)continue;
const dark=q<0.38,len=3+r*4,tilt=(hash2(px*1.7,py)-0.5)*0.5;
g.strokeStyle=dark?(t==='grass'?'rgba(62,92,36,0.42)':'rgba(92,108,48,0.36)'):'rgba(232,240,170,0.42)';
g.lineWidth=1;g.beginPath();
for(const da of[-0.45,0,0.45]){const ang=-Math.PI/2+tilt+da;g.moveTo(lx,ly);g.lineTo(lx+Math.cos(ang)*len,ly+Math.sin(ang)*len);}
g.stroke();
}else if(t==='water'&&r<0.035){
g.strokeStyle='rgba(235,248,255,0.4)';g.lineWidth=1;g.beginPath();g.moveTo(lx-5,ly);g.quadraticCurveTo(lx,ly-2.5,lx+5,ly);g.stroke();
}
}
// 地面點綴已移除，地圖僅保留純色地形
// 山脈:主山體錯落疊放;再檢查山區內沒被蓋到的空地,補上較小的山(全為決定性計算,區塊接縫一致)
const ready=mountainArtReady(),P=70,MM=200,F=44,list=[],pm=new Map();
const prim=(ix,iy)=>{const k=ix+','+iy;if(!pm.has(k))pm.set(k,primaryMount(ix,iy,P));return pm.get(k);};
const foot=(sp)=>{const h=sp.w*0.58;return{cx:sp.px,cy:sp.py-0.06*h,rx:sp.w*0.45,ry:sp.w*0.21};};
const inFoot=(x,y,f)=>{const dx=(x-f.cx)/f.rx,dy=(y-f.cy)/f.ry;return dx*dx+dy*dy<1;};
for(let iy=Math.floor((Y0-MM)/P);iy<=Math.ceil((Y0+CHUNK+MM)/P);iy++)for(let ix=Math.floor((X0-MM)/P)-1;ix<=Math.ceil((X0+CHUNK+MM)/P);ix++){const sp=prim(ix,iy);if(sp)list.push(sp);}
for(let wy=Math.floor((Y0-MM)/F)*F;wy<Y0+CHUNK+MM;wy+=F)for(let wx=Math.floor((X0-MM)/F)*F;wx<X0+CHUNK+MM;wx+=F){
const px=wx+hash2(wx*3.1,wy)*F*0.6,py=wy+hash2(wy*2.7,wx)*F*0.6;
if(px<0||py<0||px>WORLD||py>WORLD||fMount(px,py)<=0.03||isNearRoad(px,py))continue;
let covered=false;
const bx=Math.floor(px/P),by=Math.floor(py/P);
for(let iy=by-3;iy<=by+3&&!covered;iy++)for(let ix=bx-3;ix<=bx+3&&!covered;ix++){const sp=prim(ix,iy);if(sp&&inFoot(px,py,foot(sp)))covered=true;}
if(!covered)list.push(mountSpriteAt(px,py,true));
}
list.sort((a,b)=>a.py-b.py);
cv.mountainSprites=list;// 山峰圖交由外層在道路之後繪製，讓山峰可以稍微疊在道路上，但道路本身不會畫進山區
cv._fallback=!ready;
return cv;
}
function drawMountainSpriteList(list,ox,oy,w,h){
const ready=mountainArtReady();
for(const sp of list){
const lx=sp.px-ox,ly=sp.py-oy;
if(lx<-200||lx>w+200||ly<-160||ly>h+280)continue;
const im=ready?mountainImg(sp.kind):null;
if(im&&im.complete&&im.naturalWidth>0){
const hh=sp.w*im.naturalHeight/im.naturalWidth;
ctx.save();if(sp.flip){ctx.translate(lx,0);ctx.scale(-1,1);ctx.translate(-lx,0);}
ctx.drawImage(im,lx-sp.w/2,ly-hh*0.78,sp.w,hh);ctx.restore();
}else{
ctx.fillStyle='#6f8f5a';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(lx-30,ly);ctx.lineTo(lx,ly-40);ctx.lineTo(lx+30,ly);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
}
}
}
function getChunk(cx,cy){
const k=cx+','+cy;
if(chunkCache.has(k)){const v=chunkCache.get(k);if(!(v._fallback&&mountainArtReady())){chunkCache.delete(k);chunkCache.set(k,v);return v;}chunkCache.delete(k);}// 素材載入後重畫
const v=renderChunk(cx,cy);chunkCache.set(k,v);
if(chunkCache.size>12)chunkCache.delete(chunkCache.keys().next().value);
return v;
}
// ---- 蜿蜒土路:沿原道路中線做小幅度彎曲(仍在可通行帶內),邊緣深色、中間兩道車轍;過湖處畫木橋 ----
let roadPaths=null,bridgeSpots=null;
function buildRoadPaths(){
roadPaths=ROADS.map((r,ri)=>{
const len=Math.hypot(r.x2-r.x1,r.y2-r.y1),ux=(r.x2-r.x1)/len,uy=(r.y2-r.y1)/len,nx=-uy,ny=ux,pts=[];
for(let d=0;d<=len;d+=24){const amp=11*Math.min(1,d/200,(len-d)/200),off=amp*(Math.sin(d/310+ri*1.7)*0.7+Math.sin(d/97+ri)*0.3);pts.push([r.x1+ux*d+nx*off,r.y1+uy*d+ny*off]);}
pts.push([r.x2,r.y2]);
let minx=Infinity,miny=Infinity,maxx=-Infinity,maxy=-Infinity;for(const p of pts){minx=Math.min(minx,p[0]);maxx=Math.max(maxx,p[0]);miny=Math.min(miny,p[1]);maxy=Math.max(maxy,p[1]);}
return{pts,minx,miny,maxx,maxy,ang:Math.atan2(uy,ux)};
});
bridgeSpots=[];
for(const rp of roadPaths)for(const[x,y]of rp.pts)if(biomeAt(x,y)==='water')bridgeSpots.push({x,y,ang:rp.ang});
}
function drawRoads(ox,oy,w,h){
if(!roadPaths)buildRoadPaths();
const vis=roadPaths.filter(r=>r.maxx-ox>-60&&r.minx-ox<w+60&&r.maxy-oy>-60&&r.miny-oy<h+60);
const imgReady=ROAD_STRIP_IMG&&ROAD_STRIP_IMG.complete&&ROAD_STRIP_IMG.naturalWidth>0;
const roadW=34;
ctx.save();ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.lineJoin='round';
for(const r of vis){
for(let i=0;i<r.pts.length-1;i++){
const p1=r.pts[i],p2=r.pts[i+1];
const mx=(p1[0]+p2[0])/2,my=(p1[1]+p2[1])/2;
if(fMount(mx,my)>-0.02)continue;// 道路不畫進山脈範圍,把該段留白讓山體圖案顯示
const sx1=p1[0]-ox,sy1=p1[1]-oy,sx2=p2[0]-ox,sy2=p2[1]-oy;
const midx=(sx1+sx2)/2,midy=(sy1+sy2)/2;
if(midx<-100||midx>w+100||midy<-100||midy>h+100)continue;
const dx=sx2-sx1,dy=sy2-sy1,len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,ang=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
ctx.save();ctx.translate(midx,midy);ctx.rotate(ang);
if(imgReady){
ctx.drawImage(ROAD_STRIP_IMG,-len/2-3,-roadW/2,len+6,roadW);
}else{
ctx.fillStyle='rgba(120,92,56,0.55)';ctx.fillRect(-len/2-2,-roadW/2-3,len+4,roadW+6);
ctx.fillStyle='#c9ad7c';ctx.fillRect(-len/2,-roadW*0.42,len,roadW*0.84);
}
ctx.restore();
}
}
for(const b of bridgeSpots){// 木橋
const sx=b.x-ox,sy=b.y-oy;if(sx<-40||sx>w+40||sy<-40||sy>h+40)continue;
ctx.save();ctx.translate(sx,sy);ctx.rotate(b.ang);
ctx.fillStyle='#8a6038';ctx.fillRect(-13,-19,26,38);
ctx.strokeStyle='#5c3d20';ctx.lineWidth=1.5;for(let k=-10;k<=10;k+=6){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(k,-19);ctx.lineTo(k,19);ctx.stroke();}
ctx.fillStyle='#4a2f17';ctx.fillRect(-13,-21,26,3);ctx.fillRect(-13,18,26,3);
ctx.restore();
}
ctx.restore();
}
function drawTileDecor(t,sx,sy,size){
if(t==='mountain'){
ctx.fillStyle='#8b8378';
ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(sx+size*0.15,sy+size*0.8);ctx.lineTo(sx+size*0.42,sy+size*0.28);ctx.lineTo(sx+size*0.62,sy+size*0.58);ctx.lineTo(sx+size*0.8,sy+size*0.22);ctx.lineTo(sx+size*0.95,sy+size*0.8);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
ctx.strokeStyle='#5f574c';ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.stroke();
ctx.fillStyle='#ffffffcc';
ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(sx+size*0.36,sy+size*0.38);ctx.lineTo(sx+size*0.42,sy+size*0.28);ctx.lineTo(sx+size*0.48,sy+size*0.38);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(sx+size*0.74,sy+size*0.32);ctx.lineTo(sx+size*0.8,sy+size*0.22);ctx.lineTo(sx+size*0.86,sy+size*0.32);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
}else if(t==='grass'){
ctx.strokeStyle='#4a7a3a';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.lineCap='round';
for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
const bx=sx+16+i*(size-32)/3,by=sy+size*0.72;
ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(bx,by);ctx.lineTo(bx-5,by-16);ctx.moveTo(bx,by);ctx.lineTo(bx,by-20);ctx.moveTo(bx,by);ctx.lineTo(bx+5,by-16);ctx.stroke();
}
}else if(t==='plain'){
ctx.fillStyle='#e8d97a';
for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
const bx=sx+18+i*(size-36)/2,by=sy+size*0.6;
ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(bx,by,3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
}
}
}

const SPEED=2.6;
function moveBudget(){return (TILE*24+(player.level-1)*TILE*0.5)*lordPerk('move');}
let movesLeft=TILE*24;
function healHomeIfNeeded(){
const mercsWounded=MERCS.some((mm,i)=>mercs[i]>0&&mercCurHp(i)<mercMaxHp(i));
const compWounded=player.companion&&player.companion.hp<player.companion.maxHp;
const brotherWounded=player.brother&&player.brother.hp<player.brother.maxHp;
const wasHurt=player.hp<player.maxHp||mercsWounded||compWounded||brotherWounded;
if(wasHurt){
player.hp=player.maxHp;
MERCS.forEach((mm,i)=>{if(mercs[i]>0)mercHp[i]=mercMaxHp(i);});
if(player.companion)player.companion.hp=player.companion.maxHp;
if(player.brother)player.brother.hp=player.brother.maxHp;
showToast('🏠 回到家鄉,全軍生命值已恢復!');
updateHud();save();
}
}
function update(){
if(inBattle||inTown||inStatus||inBoot||inInn||inPatrolPhase||gameOver||inEntity||inNpcPhase||inEvent)return;
const curTerrain=terrainAt(player.x,player.y);
const terrainMult=TERRAIN_SPEED[curTerrain];
document.getElementById('terrainLabel').textContent=TERRAIN_NAME[curTerrain]+'　x'+terrainMult+' 速度';
const mb=moveBudget();
document.getElementById('movesLeftTxt').textContent='步數 '+Math.max(0,Math.round(movesLeft/TILE))+'/'+Math.round(mb/TILE);
document.getElementById('moveBarFill').style.width=Math.max(0,movesLeft/mb*100)+'%';
const canMove=movesLeft>0;
if(canMove&&joyActive&&(Math.abs(joyDX)>0.05||Math.abs(joyDY)>0.05)){
target=null;
const mag=Math.min(1,Math.hypot(joyDX,joyDY));
const nx=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,player.x+joyDX*SPEED*mag*terrainMult));
const ny=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,player.y+joyDY*SPEED*mag*terrainMult));
const startX=player.x,startY=player.y;
if(canMoveTo(nx,player.y))player.x=nx;
if(canMoveTo(player.x,ny))player.y=ny;
movesLeft=Math.max(0,movesLeft-Math.hypot(player.x-startX,player.y-startY));
checkMonsterCollision();
}else if(canMove&&target){
const dx=target.x-player.x,dy=target.y-player.y;
const dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
if(dist>4){
const nx=player.x+dx/dist*SPEED*terrainMult,ny=player.y+dy/dist*SPEED*terrainMult;
const movedX=canMoveTo(nx,player.y),movedY=canMoveTo(player.x,ny);
const startX=player.x,startY=player.y;
if(movedX)player.x=nx;
if(movedY)player.y=ny;
movesLeft=Math.max(0,movesLeft-Math.hypot(player.x-startX,player.y-startY));
if(!movedX&&!movedY)target=null;
}else{
target=null;

}
checkMonsterCollision();
}
let nearSettlement=null,nearType=null;
for(const c of CAPITALS){if(Math.hypot(player.x-c.x,player.y-c.y)<60){nearSettlement=c;nearType='capital';break;}}
if(!nearSettlement){
for(const o of OUTPOSTS){if(Math.hypot(player.x-o.x,player.y-o.y)<60){nearSettlement=o;nearType='village';break;}}
}
const tp=document.getElementById('townPrompt');
if(nearSettlement){
tp.textContent=(nearType==='capital'?nearSettlement.icon+' 進入':'🏘️ 進入')+nearSettlement.name;
tp.dataset.type=nearType;tp.dataset.id=nearSettlement.id;
tp.style.display='block';
}else{
tp.style.display='none';
}
let nearCp=null;
for(const cp of CHECKPOINTS){
if(checkpointBlocked(cp)&&Math.hypot(player.x-cp.x,player.y-cp.y)<90){nearCp=cp;break;}
}
const cpEl=document.getElementById('checkpointPrompt');
if(nearCp){
cpEl.textContent='⛩️ '+nearCp.name+' - 繳費 💰'+checkpointToll()+' 通過('+CHECKPOINT_PASS_TURNS+'回合)';
cpEl.dataset.key=nearCp.key;
cpEl.style.display='block';
}else{
cpEl.style.display='none';
}
}
function checkMonsterCollision(){
const hitN=activeNpcs().find(n=>Math.hypot(player.x-n.x,player.y-n.y)<32);
if(hitN&&!gameOver){
npc=hitN;
target=null;joyActive=false;joyDX=0;joyDY=0;joyKnob.style.transform='translate(0,0)';
try{triggerBattle(npcAsEnemy());}catch(err){inBattle=false;}
return;
}
for(const m of monsters){
if(m.alive&&m.camp===undefined&&Math.hypot(player.x-m.x,player.y-m.y)<30){
try{engageMonster(m);}catch(err){inBattle=false;}// 全是弱怪時秒殺、不打斷移動
return;
}
}
}

let cameraFocus=null;
function draw(){
const w=VIEW_W,h=VIEW_H;
const vc=viewCenter(),focusX=vc.x,focusY=vc.y;
const ox=focusX-w/2,oy=focusY-h/2;
syncRecenterBtn();
ctx.fillStyle='#b8dd7f';ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
const visibleMountainSprites=[];
for(let cy=Math.floor(oy/CHUNK);cy<=Math.floor((oy+h)/CHUNK);cy++)for(let cx=Math.floor(ox/CHUNK);cx<=Math.floor((ox+w)/CHUNK);cx++){
if(cx<0||cy<0||cx*CHUNK>WORLD||cy*CHUNK>WORLD)continue;
const chunkCv=getChunk(cx,cy);
ctx.drawImage(chunkCv,Math.round(cx*CHUNK-ox),Math.round(cy*CHUNK-oy),CHUNK,CHUNK);
if(chunkCv.mountainSprites)for(const sp of chunkCv.mountainSprites)visibleMountainSprites.push(sp);
}
ctx.save();
drawRoads(ox,oy,w,h);
ctx.restore();
visibleMountainSprites.sort((a,b)=>a.py-b.py);
drawMountainSpriteList(visibleMountainSprites,ox,oy,w,h);// 山峰疊在道路之上，可稍微蓋住道路邊緣
drawTrails(ox,oy,w,h);
ctx.font='34px serif';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
for(const c of CAPITALS){
const sx=c.x-ox,sy=c.y-oy;
const rad=c.isCenter?90:44;
if(sx<-rad-60||sx>w+rad+60||sy<-rad-60||sy>h+rad+60)continue;
const size=c.isCenter?68:34;
const captured=isCapitalCaptured(c.id);
const npcOwned=npcOwnsCapital(c.id);
const haloColor=captured?PLAYER_COLOR:npcOwned?NPC_COLOR:c.color;
ctx.save();
ctx.fillStyle=haloColor+'50';
ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy,rad*0.7,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
ctx.strokeStyle=haloColor;ctx.lineWidth=c.isCenter?5:3;
ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy,rad*0.7,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
ctx.restore();
const capImg=capitalArtFor(c.id);
let cw=size,ch=size;
if(capImg&&capImg.complete&&capImg.naturalWidth>0){
cw=c.isCenter?170:120;ch=cw*capImg.naturalHeight/capImg.naturalWidth;
ctx.drawImage(capImg,sx-cw/2,sy-ch*0.58,cw,ch);
if(!c.isCenter)drawSurnameFlag(sx-cw*0.02,sy-ch*0.58,captured?(player.surname||'我'):KINGDOMS[c.id]&&KINGDOMS[c.id].surname,captured?PLAYER_COLOR:c.color);
}else{
ctx.font=size+'px serif';ctx.fillText(c.icon,sx,sy);
}
{
const label=captured?playerDisplayName():c.name,fs=c.isCenter?13:11,ly=sy+ch*0.42+(c.isCenter?10:8);
ctx.save();ctx.font='bold '+fs+'px sans-serif';
const tw=ctx.measureText(label).width;
ctx.fillStyle='rgba(40,24,10,0.78)';ctx.beginPath();
if(ctx.roundRect)ctx.roundRect(sx-tw/2-7,ly-fs/2-4,tw+14,fs+8,(fs+8)/2);else ctx.rect(sx-tw/2-7,ly-fs/2-4,tw+14,fs+8);
ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle=haloColor;ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.stroke();
ctx.fillStyle='#ffe7b3';ctx.fillText(label,sx,ly+1);ctx.restore();
}
const badge=Math.max(16,size*0.4);
if(captured){
ctx.font=badge+'px serif';ctx.fillText('✅',sx+cw*0.42,sy-ch*0.45);
}else if(npcOwned){
ctx.font=badge+'px serif';ctx.fillText('☠️',sx+cw*0.42,sy-ch*0.45);
}
}
for(const c of campCenters){
const count=monsters.filter(m=>m.alive&&m.camp===c.id).length;
if(count===0)continue;
const sx=c.x-ox,sy=c.y-oy;
if(sx<-160||sx>w+160||sy<-160||sy>h+160)continue;
const radius=Math.min(100,70+count*1.3)/2.5;// 山寨寬 70~100 封頂
const art=campArtFor(c.id);
const zj=monsters.some(m=>m.alive&&m.camp===c.id&&m.hist==='zhangjiao');// 張角所在的黃巾大營
if(zj){ctx.save();const pulse=0.55+0.25*Math.sin(Date.now()/300);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(250,204,21,'+(pulse*0.35)+')';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy,radius*1.45,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(250,204,21,'+pulse+')';ctx.lineWidth=4;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy,radius*1.45,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();}
if(art&&art.img.complete&&art.img.naturalWidth){
const dw=radius*2.5,dh=dw*art.img.naturalHeight/art.img.naturalWidth;
ctx.save();
ctx.translate(sx,sy);if(art.flip)ctx.scale(-1,1);
ctx.drawImage(art.img,-dw/2,-dh/2,dw,dh);
ctx.restore();
const label=zj?'🟡 黃巾大營・張角 x'+count:'山寨 x'+count;
ctx.save();ctx.font='bold 13px sans-serif';
const tw=ctx.measureText(label).width,ly=sy+dh/2+4;
ctx.fillStyle=zj?'rgba(120,80,0,0.9)':'rgba(40,24,10,0.78)';ctx.beginPath();
if(ctx.roundRect)ctx.roundRect(sx-tw/2-7,ly-10,tw+14,20,10);else ctx.rect(sx-tw/2-7,ly-10,tw+14,20);
ctx.fill();if(zj){ctx.strokeStyle='#facc15';ctx.lineWidth=1.5;ctx.stroke();}ctx.fillStyle=zj?'#fde68a':'#ffe7b3';ctx.fillText(label,sx,ly+1);ctx.restore();
continue;
}
ctx.save();
ctx.fillStyle='#7a5230aa';
ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy,radius,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
ctx.strokeStyle='#3f2814';ctx.lineWidth=5;
ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy,radius,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
const stakes=12;
ctx.font='18px serif';
for(let i=0;i<stakes;i++){
const ang=(i/stakes)*Math.PI*2;
ctx.fillText('🪵',sx+Math.cos(ang)*radius,sy+Math.sin(ang)*radius);
}
ctx.restore();
const firstMember=monsters.find(mm=>mm.alive&&mm.camp===c.id);
if(firstMember){ctx.font='24px serif';ctx.fillText(firstMember.icon,sx,sy);}
ctx.font='40px serif';ctx.fillText('⛺',sx,sy-radius+4);
ctx.font='13px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#3f2814';ctx.fillText('山寨 x'+count,sx,sy-radius+34);
}
for(const o of OUTPOSTS){
const sx=o.x-ox,sy=o.y-oy;
if(sx<-30||sx>w+30||sy<-30||sy>h+30)continue;
const npcOwned=npcOwnsVillage(o.id);
if(isCaptured(o.id)||npcOwned){
ctx.save();
ctx.strokeStyle=isCaptured(o.id)?PLAYER_COLOR:NPC_COLOR;ctx.lineWidth=3;
ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy,22,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
ctx.restore();
}
ctx.font='30px serif';ctx.fillText('🏘️',sx,sy);
ctx.font='16px serif';ctx.fillText(isCaptured(o.id)?'✅':npcOwned?'☠️':'🚩',sx+18,sy-18);
ctx.font='10px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#222';ctx.fillText(o.name,sx,sy+20);
if(isCaptured(o.id))drawSurnameFlag(sx-16,sy-14,player.surname||'我',PLAYER_COLOR);
}
for(const cp of CHECKPOINTS){
const sx=cp.x-ox,sy=cp.y-oy;
if(sx<-90||sx>w+90||sy<-90||sy>h+90)continue;
const blocked=checkpointBlocked(cp);
const cpImg=checkpointArtFor(cp);
if(cpImg&&cpImg.complete&&cpImg.naturalWidth>0){
const cw=90,ch=cw*cpImg.naturalHeight/cpImg.naturalWidth;
if(CHECKPOINT_ART_FLIP[cp.key]){ctx.save();ctx.translate(sx,sy);ctx.scale(-1,1);ctx.drawImage(cpImg,-cw/2,-ch*0.5,cw,ch);ctx.restore();}
else ctx.drawImage(cpImg,sx-cw/2,sy-ch*0.5,cw,ch);
const label=cp.name;
ctx.save();ctx.font='bold 12px sans-serif';
const tw=ctx.measureText(label).width,ly=sy+ch*0.5+8;
ctx.fillStyle='rgba(40,24,10,0.78)';ctx.beginPath();
if(ctx.roundRect)ctx.roundRect(sx-tw/2-7,ly-10,tw+14,20,10);else ctx.rect(sx-tw/2-7,ly-10,tw+14,20);
ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#ffe7b3';ctx.fillText(label,sx,ly+1);ctx.restore();
ctx.font='15px serif';ctx.fillText(blocked?'🔒':'✅',sx+cw*0.42,sy-ch*0.42);
if(checkpointCaptured(cp))drawSurnameFlag(sx-cw*0.02,sy-ch*0.5,player.surname||'我',PLAYER_COLOR);
}else{
ctx.font='28px serif';ctx.fillText('⛩️',sx,sy);
ctx.font='12px serif';ctx.fillText(blocked?'🔒':'✅',sx+16,sy-16);
if(checkpointCaptured(cp))drawSurnameFlag(sx-6,sy-14,player.surname||'我',PLAYER_COLOR);
}
}
for(const g of garrisons){
if(!g.alive)continue;
const sx=g.x-ox,sy=g.y-oy;
if(sx<-40||sx>w+40||sy<-70||sy>h+30)continue;
if(drawUnitSprite('garrison',sx,sy-10,44)){drawLvTag(g.level,sx,sy-58);}
else{ctx.font='26px serif';ctx.fillText(g.icon,sx,sy-24);ctx.font='10px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#222';ctx.fillText('Lv'+g.level,sx,sy-6);}
}
for(const p of patrols){
if(!p.alive)continue;
const sx=p.x-ox,sy=p.y-oy;
if(sx<-30||sx>w+30||sy<-30||sy>h+30)continue;
const friendly=patrolFriendly(p);
const pRadius=16+((p.members?p.members.length:1)-1)*2.2;
ctx.save();
ctx.fillStyle=(friendly?PLAYER_COLOR:(p.color||'#888'))+'60';
ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy-2,pRadius,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
ctx.strokeStyle=friendly?PLAYER_COLOR:(p.color||'#888');ctx.lineWidth=2;
ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy-2,pRadius,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
ctx.restore();
if(drawUnitSprite('patrol',sx,sy+10,44))drawLvTag(p.level,sx,sy+20);
else{ctx.font='22px serif';ctx.fillText(p.icon,sx,sy);ctx.font='10px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#222';ctx.fillText('Lv'+p.level,sx,sy+18);}
}
if(!gameOver)for(const n of activeNpcs()){
const sx=n.x-ox,sy=n.y-oy,col=n.color||NPC_COLOR;
if(sx>-30&&sx<w+30&&sy>-30&&sy<h+30){
ctx.save();
ctx.fillStyle=col+'70';
ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy-2,18,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
ctx.strokeStyle=col;ctx.lineWidth=2.5;
ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy-2,18,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
ctx.restore();
ctx.font='26px serif';ctx.fillText(n.icon,sx,sy);
ctx.font='bold 11px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.fillText(n.name+' Lv.'+n.level,sx,sy-24);
}
}
for(const m of monsters){
if(!m.alive||m.camp!==undefined)continue;
const sx=m.x-ox,sy=m.y-oy;
if(sx<-40||sx>w+40||sy<-50||sy>h+30)continue;
const mk=MONSTER_ART_BY_ICON[m.icon];
if(mk&&drawUnitSprite(mk,sx,sy+12,46))drawLvTag(m.level,sx,sy+22);
else{ctx.font='26px serif';ctx.fillText(m.icon,sx,sy);ctx.font='10px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#222';ctx.fillText('Lv'+m.level,sx,sy+18);}
}
const psx=player.x-ox,psy=player.y-oy;
if(PLAYER_IMG.complete&&PLAYER_IMG.naturalWidth>0){
const r=22;
ctx.drawImage(PLAYER_IMG,psx-r,psy-r,r*2,r*2);
}else{
ctx.font='30px serif';ctx.fillText('🧙',psx,psy);
}
ctx.font='11px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#1d4ed8';ctx.fillText('Lv.'+player.level,psx,psy-26);
const partySize=1+mercCount();
if(partySize>1){
ctx.font='13px serif';ctx.fillText('👥',psx+16,psy-16);
ctx.font='10px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#222';ctx.fillText('x'+partySize,psx+16,psy-4);
}

const homeCap=nearestCapital(player.x,player.y);
const townSX=homeCap.x-ox,townSY=homeCap.y-oy,margin=40;
const townOffscreen=townSX<-margin||townSX>w+margin||townSY<-margin||townSY>h+margin;
if(townOffscreen){
const angle=Math.atan2(homeCap.y-player.y,homeCap.x-player.x);
const r=55;
const px=player.x-ox,py=player.y-oy;
const ax=px+Math.cos(angle)*r,ay=py+Math.sin(angle)*r;
ctx.save();
ctx.translate(ax,ay);ctx.rotate(angle);
ctx.fillStyle='#e0a72e';ctx.strokeStyle='#3f2814';ctx.lineWidth=2;
ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(12,0);ctx.lineTo(-8,8);ctx.lineTo(-8,-8);ctx.closePath();
ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
ctx.restore();
const dist=Math.round(Math.hypot(homeCap.x-player.x,homeCap.y-player.y));
ctx.font='11px sans-serif';ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.textAlign='center';
ctx.fillText('🏯 '+dist,ax+Math.cos(angle)*20,ay+Math.sin(angle)*20+14);
}
if(target){
ctx.strokeStyle='#e0a72e';ctx.lineWidth=2;
ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(target.x-ox,target.y-oy,10,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();
}
drawMinimap();
}
// 小地圖地形:地形由 tileNoise 決定、不會變動,只在第一次時取樣繪成縮圖快取
let miniTerrain=null,miniTerrainTried=false;
const MINI_TERRAIN_COLOR={road:[232,213,163],plain:[172,186,114],grass:[140,166,98],mountain:[70,100,60],water:[86,146,172]};
function buildMiniTerrain(){
miniTerrainTried=true;
try{
const N=112,cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=N;cv.height=N;
const c2=cv.getContext('2d'),img=c2.createImageData(N,N),cell=WORLD/N;
for(let y=0;y<N;y++)for(let x=0;x<N;x++){
const col=MINI_TERRAIN_COLOR[terrainAt((x+0.5)*cell,(y+0.5)*cell)]||MINI_TERRAIN_COLOR.plain,i=(y*N+x)*4;
img.data[i]=col[0];img.data[i+1]=col[1];img.data[i+2]=col[2];img.data[i+3]=255;
}
c2.putImageData(img,0,0);miniTerrain=cv;
}catch(err){miniTerrain=null;}
}
function drawMinimap(){
const mw=MINI_CSS,mh=MINI_CSS,scale=mw/WORLD;
miniCtx.clearRect(0,0,mw,mh);
if(!miniTerrain&&!miniTerrainTried)buildMiniTerrain();
if(miniTerrain){miniCtx.save();miniCtx.globalAlpha=0.9;miniCtx.imageSmoothingEnabled=true;miniCtx.drawImage(miniTerrain,0,0,mw,mh);miniCtx.restore();}
drawTrailsMini(scale);
miniCtx.strokeStyle='#ffffff33';miniCtx.lineWidth=1;
miniCtx.beginPath();miniCtx.moveTo(mw/2,0);miniCtx.lineTo(mw/2,mh);miniCtx.moveTo(0,mh/2);miniCtx.lineTo(mw,mh/2);miniCtx.stroke();
miniCtx.font='9px serif';miniCtx.textAlign='center';miniCtx.textBaseline='middle';
for(const cp of CAPITALS){
miniCtx.font=(cp.isCenter?13:9)+'px serif';
miniCtx.fillText(cp.icon,cp.x*scale,cp.y*scale);
if(isCapitalCaptured(cp.id)){
miniCtx.fillStyle='#4ade80';
miniCtx.beginPath();miniCtx.arc(cp.x*scale+5,cp.y*scale-5,2,0,Math.PI*2);miniCtx.fill();
}
}
for(const o of OUTPOSTS){
miniCtx.fillStyle=isCaptured(o.id)?'#4ade80':'#f87171';
miniCtx.beginPath();miniCtx.arc(o.x*scale,o.y*scale,2.5,0,Math.PI*2);miniCtx.fill();
miniCtx.strokeStyle='#1f2937';miniCtx.lineWidth=0.8;miniCtx.stroke();
}
miniCtx.fillStyle='#eab308';
for(const c of campCenters){
if(!monsters.some(m=>m.alive&&m.camp===c.id))continue;
if(monsters.some(m=>m.alive&&m.camp===c.id&&m.hist==='zhangjiao')){const fs=miniCtx.fillStyle;miniCtx.fillStyle='#facc15';miniCtx.beginPath();miniCtx.arc(c.x*scale,c.y*scale,4,0,Math.PI*2);miniCtx.fill();miniCtx.strokeStyle='#7c2d12';miniCtx.lineWidth=1;miniCtx.stroke();miniCtx.fillStyle=fs;continue;}
miniCtx.beginPath();miniCtx.arc(c.x*scale,c.y*scale,2,0,Math.PI*2);miniCtx.fill();
}
if(!gameOver)for(const n of activeNpcs()){
miniCtx.fillStyle=n.color||NPC_COLOR;
miniCtx.beginPath();miniCtx.arc(n.x*scale,n.y*scale,3,0,Math.PI*2);miniCtx.fill();
miniCtx.strokeStyle='#fff';miniCtx.lineWidth=1;miniCtx.stroke();
}
miniCtx.fillStyle='#60a5fa';
miniCtx.beginPath();miniCtx.arc(player.x*scale,player.y*scale,3.5,0,Math.PI*2);miniCtx.fill();
miniCtx.strokeStyle='#fff';miniCtx.lineWidth=1;miniCtx.stroke();
const vc=viewCenter(),focusX=vc.x,focusY=vc.y;
const frameW=(VIEW_W/WORLD)*mw,frameH=(VIEW_H/WORLD)*mh;
miniCtx.strokeStyle=cameraFocus?'#facc15':'#ffffffcc';
miniCtx.lineWidth=1.5;
miniCtx.strokeRect(focusX*scale-frameW/2,focusY*scale-frameH/2,frameW,frameH);
}

document.getElementById('townPrompt').onclick=(e)=>{
const type=e.target.dataset.type,id=+e.target.dataset.id;
if(type==='capital'){
const c=CAPITALS.find(x=>x.id===id);
if(c)openEntityInfo({kind:'capital',obj:c});
}else{
const o=OUTPOSTS.find(x=>x.id===id);
if(o)openEntityInfo({kind:'village',obj:o});
}
};
document.getElementById('checkpointPrompt').onclick=(e)=>{
const key=e.target.dataset.key;
const toll=checkpointToll();
if(player.gold<toll)return;
player.gold-=toll;
checkpointCleared[key]=turnCount+CHECKPOINT_PASS_TURNS;
updateHud();save();
};

let inPatrolPhase=false;
let turnCount=0;
function processFoodAndMorale(){
const cnt=mercCount();
const needed=cnt*3;
if((player.food||0)>=needed){
player.food-=needed;
player.morale=Math.min(100,(player.morale||0)+1);
}else{
player.food=0;
player.morale=Math.max(0,(player.morale||0)-5);
showToast('⚠️ 糧食不足,士氣下滑!');
}
if((player.morale||0)<=0&&cnt>0){
let desertCount=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(cnt*0.1));
let candidates=[];
for(const k in mercs){if(mercs[k]>0)candidates.push(+k);}
candidates.sort((a,b)=>(mercTierOf(a)-mercTierOf(b))||(a-b));
let deserted=[];
for(const k of candidates){
if(desertCount<=0)break;
const take=Math.min(mercs[k],desertCount);
mercs[k]-=take;
desertCount-=take;
if(mercs[k]<=0){mercTier[k]=0;mercExp[k]=0;mercHp[k]=0;}
else{
const perHp=Math.round(MERCS[k].hp*TIER_MULT[mercTierOf(k)]*(1+((mercUpgrade[k]||0)*0.25)));
mercHp[k]=Math.min(mercHp[k],perHp*mercs[k]);
}
deserted.push(MERCS[k].n+' x'+take);
}
if(deserted.length)showToast('💀 士氣低落,士兵大量逃亡:'+deserted.join('、'));
}
}
// ================= 董卓模式 =================
function lvbuDefects(){
if(!isDong()||npcs.some(n=>n.id==='lvbu'))return;
const n=makeRoamingNpc(ROAMING.find(r=>r.id==='lvbu'));n.level=Math.max(8,player.level);n.maxHp=50+n.level*8;n.hp=n.maxHp;n.troops=20;n.gold=500;
n.x=QUAD+300;n.y=QUAD+300;npcs.push(n);
showToast('🔱 呂布叛離,自立為一方勢力!');
}
function dongLoseLuoyang(reason){
if(gameOver)return;
gameOver=true;
document.getElementById('gameOverTitle').textContent='💀 洛陽陷落';
document.getElementById('gameOverText').textContent=reason+' 董卓政權就此覆滅……';
document.getElementById('gameOverModal').classList.remove('hidden');
}
function coalitionSiege(){// 反董聯軍(固定勢力)每回合有機率進攻董卓的據點
const h=player.hist||{};
if(!isDong()||!h.coal||gameOver||Math.random()>0.3)return;
const lords=KINGDOMS.filter(k=>!k.isCenter&&!isCapitalCaptured(k.id));
if(!lords.length)return;
const lord=lords[Math.floor(Math.random()*lords.length)];
const cps=CHECKPOINTS.filter(c=>(player.capturedCheckpoints||[]).includes(c.key)&&c.key.startsWith('spoke_'));
const cap=CAPITALS.find(c=>c.id===4);
const tgt=cps.length?{type:'checkpoint',obj:cps[Math.floor(Math.random()*cps.length)]}:{type:'capital',obj:cap};
const key=settlementKey(tgt.type,tgt.obj);
const months=ym()-(190*12+1);
const atk=Math.round((60+months*12+player.level*5)*(0.85+Math.random()*0.3));
const def=Math.round(((player.stationed||{})[key]||0)*(tgt.type==='checkpoint'?1.5:1.2));
if(atk>def){
delete player.stationed[key];
if(tgt.type==='checkpoint'){player.capturedCheckpoints=player.capturedCheckpoints.filter(k=>k!==tgt.obj.key);showToast('🔥 '+lord.name+'軍攻破了 '+tgt.obj.name+'!');}
else{player.capturedCapitals=(player.capturedCapitals||[]).filter(id=>id!==4);dongLoseLuoyang(lord.name+'率關東聯軍攻破洛陽。');}
}else{
player.stationed[key]=Math.round(player.stationed[key]*0.88);
showToast('🛡️ '+tgt.obj.name+' 擊退了'+lord.name+'軍的進攻(守軍折損)');
}
}
// ================= 天下一統:持有洛陽守滿12回合 =================
const UNIFY_TURNS=12;
function unifyActive(){return !!(player&&player.unify&&!isDong());}
function coalitionGarrison(type,obj){// 聯軍奪下據點後留守,玩家可再攻打奪回
const nm='諸侯聯軍 駐守部隊';
if(type==='capital'){capitalGuards=capitalGuards.filter(x=>x.capitalId!==obj.id);capitalGuards.push(Object.assign(makeCapitalGuard(obj),{name:nm}));}
else{checkpointGuards=checkpointGuards.filter(x=>x.checkpointKey!==obj.key);checkpointGuards.push(Object.assign(makeCheckpointGuard(obj),{name:nm}));}
}
function unifySiege(){
const lords=KINGDOMS.filter(k=>!k.isCenter&&!isCapitalCaptured(k.id));
if(!lords.length)return;
const lord=lords[Math.floor(Math.random()*lords.length)];
const cap4=CAPITALS.find(c=>c.id===4);
const others=CHECKPOINTS.filter(c=>(player.capturedCheckpoints||[]).includes(c.key)).map(c=>({type:'checkpoint',obj:c}))
.concat(CAPITALS.filter(c=>c.id!==4&&isCapitalCaptured(c.id)).map(c=>({type:'capital',obj:c})));
const tgt=(!others.length||Math.random()<0.5)?{type:'capital',obj:cap4}:others[Math.floor(Math.random()*others.length)];
const key=settlementKey(tgt.type,tgt.obj);
const atk=Math.round((150+player.unify.turns*40+player.level*8)*(0.85+Math.random()*0.3));
const def=Math.round(((player.stationed||{})[key]||0)*(tgt.type==='checkpoint'?1.5:1.2));
if(atk>def){
if(player.stationed)delete player.stationed[key];
if(tgt.type==='checkpoint')player.capturedCheckpoints=player.capturedCheckpoints.filter(k=>k!==tgt.obj.key);
else player.capturedCapitals=(player.capturedCapitals||[]).filter(id=>id!==tgt.obj.id);
coalitionGarrison(tgt.type,tgt.obj);
showToast('🔥 '+lord.name+'率聯軍攻破了 '+tgt.obj.name+'!');
}else{
player.stationed[key]=Math.round(player.stationed[key]*0.88);
showToast('🛡️ '+tgt.obj.name+' 擊退了'+lord.name+'的聯軍(守軍折損)');
}
}
function unifyTick(){
if(isDong()||gameOver)return;
const hold=isCapitalCaptured(4);
if(!player.unify){if(hold)player.unify={turns:0,announced:false};return;}
if(!hold){player.unify=null;npcs.forEach(n=>n.target=null);showToast('💔 洛陽失守,諸侯聯盟解散。奪回洛陽即可重新開始倒數');return;}
if(!player.unify.announced)return;
player.unify.turns++;
unifySiege();
if(!isCapitalCaptured(4))return;
if(player.unify.turns>=UNIFY_TURNS){
gameOver=true;
document.getElementById('gameOverTitle').textContent='👑 天下一統';
document.getElementById('gameOverText').textContent='你坐鎮洛陽,擊退了天下諸侯的聯合討伐,四海歸心,天下一統!('+formatDate(player.year,player.month,player.day)+')';
document.getElementById('gameOverModal').classList.remove('hidden');
}
}
// ================= 歷史事件 =================
// player.hist 記錄已發生事件:yt 黃巾起義 / zjDead 張角伏誅 / ytEnd 黃巾平定 / liang 涼州之亂 / dong 董卓進京
// coal 反董聯盟(值:'join'/'dong'/'watch') / lvbuDead 虎牢關擊敗呂布 / move 遷都長安 / jade 得玉璽 / dzDeath 董卓之死
function ym(){return (player.year||184)*12+(player.month||3);}
function histCapMult(id){
const h=(player&&player.hist)||{};let m=1;
if(id===0&&h.liang)m*=1.3;
if(id===4){if(h.dong)m*=1.5;if(h.coal==='join')m*=0.85;if(h.move)m*=0.6;if(h.dzDeath)m*=0.5;}
return m;
}
function histCpMult(key){const h=(player&&player.hist)||{};return key.startsWith('spoke_')&&h.dong?1.4:1;}
function isLvbuGate(key){const h=(player&&player.hist)||{};if(isDong()||(player&&player.lordId==='lvbu'))return false;return key==='spoke_1'&&!!h.coal&&h.coal!=='dong'&&!h.lvbuDead&&!h.dzDeath;}
function refreshHistoryGuards(){
capitalGuards=capitalGuards.map(g=>g.alive?makeCapitalGuard(CAPITALS.find(c=>c.id===g.capitalId)):g);
checkpointGuards=checkpointGuards.map(g=>g.alive?makeCheckpointGuard(CHECKPOINTS.find(c=>c.key===g.checkpointKey)):g);
}
function ensureHistoryBosses(){
const h=player.hist||(player.hist={});
if(h.yt&&!h.zjDead&&!h.ytEnd&&!monsters.some(m=>m.hist==='zhangjiao')){
const c=campCenters.find(c=>c.id===1)||campCenters[0];if(!c)return;
const b=spawnMonster(c.x,c.y);
const L=Math.max(8,(player.level||1)+6);
Object.assign(b,{icon:'🧙‍♂️',name:'天公將軍 張角',level:L,hp:(80+L*20)*2,maxHp:(80+L*20)*2,atk:(12+L*5)*2,exp:(60+L*12)*2,gold:(50+L*10)*3,alive:true,camp:c.id,hist:'zhangjiao',elem:'土'});
monsters.push(b);
}
}
function histInfo(icon,title,text,after){return{icon,title,text,choices:[{label:'繼續',effect:()=>{const r=after?after():'';refreshHistoryGuards();refreshChapter();return r||text;}}]};}
function dongHistoryEvent(){
const h=player.hist||(player.hist={}),t=ym();
if(!h.dong&&t>=189*12+8)return histInfo('😈','廢立天子','你廢少帝、立獻帝,自封相國,權傾朝野。天下諸侯對你恨之入骨……',()=>{h.dong=true;player.gold+=1000;return '搜刮宮中財寶 💰1000。進入【第一章:董卓亂政】。';});
if(!h.coal&&h.dong&&t>=190*12+1)return histInfo('🔥','關東聯軍','關東諸侯歃血為盟,共推袁紹為盟主,起兵討伐你!從此各路諸侯將不斷進攻你的關隘與洛陽,流動勢力也會把你當成首要目標。',()=>{h.coal='enemy';npcs.forEach(n=>{n.troops=(n.troops||0)+5;n.gold+=300;n.target=null;});return '聯軍來襲!記得到關卡和洛陽補充駐軍。進入【第二章:群雄討董】。';});
if(!h.dzDeath&&t>=192*12+4){
const lb=player.brother&&player.brother.name==='呂布'?player.brother:null;
if(lb&&lb.loyalty>=60)return histInfo('🛡️','連環計破','司徒王允獻上美人貂蟬,企圖離間你與呂布。但呂布對你忠心耿耿,當眾揭穿了這條連環計!',()=>{h.dzDeath='foiled';player.morale=Math.min(100,(player.morale||50)+20);return '王允伏誅,士氣 +20。只要再撐一個月,天下就是你的!';});
return histInfo('🗡️','未央宮之變','王允設下連環計,'+(lb?'心懷不滿的呂布':'叛將呂布')+'於未央宮突襲你!',()=>{h.dzDeath='betrayed';player.hp=Math.max(1,Math.round(player.hp*0.3));const k=settlementKey('capital',CAPITALS.find(c=>c.id===4));if(player.stationed&&player.stationed[k])player.stationed[k]=Math.round(player.stationed[k]*0.5);if(lb){player.brother=null;lvbuDefects();}return '你身受重傷、洛陽守軍折損一半!呂布自立為一方勢力。撐到 5 月就能通關!';});
}
return null;
}
function nextHistoryEvent(){
if(unifyActive()&&!player.unify.announced)return histInfo('⚔️','天下震動','你攻佔帝都洛陽,天下震動!四方諸侯與各路群雄放下恩怨,結成聯盟共同討伐你。',()=>{player.unify.announced=true;npcs.forEach(n=>n.target=null);return '守住洛陽 '+UNIFY_TURNS+' 回合即可一統天下!聯軍每回合都會進攻,記得補充駐軍。';});
if(isDong()){// 董卓模式不觸發討董方的事件
const h=player.hist||(player.hist={});if(!h.yt||h.zjDead||h.ytEnd)return null;
}
const h=player.hist||(player.hist={}),t=ym();
if(!h.yt)return{icon:'🟡',title:'黃巾起義',text:'蒼天已死,黃天當立!鉅鹿張角自稱天公將軍,三十六方同日起事,各地山寨盡成黃巾據點。朝廷下詔,四方豪傑可自募義兵討賊。',choices:[
{label:'響應詔令,募兵討賊',effect:()=>{h.yt='join';player.gold+=100;player.morale=Math.min(100,(player.morale||50)+5);ensureHistoryBosses();return '朝廷撥給軍資 💰100,士氣 +5。張角據守東北山寨,擊敗他可獲重賞!';}},
{label:'靜觀其變',effect:()=>{h.yt='watch';ensureHistoryBosses();return '你按兵不動。張角盤據東北山寨,黃巾之勢日盛。';}}]};
if(h.yt&&!h.zjDead&&!h.ytEnd&&monsters.some(m=>m.hist==='zhangjiao'&&!m.alive)){
return histInfo('⚔️','張角伏誅','天公將軍張角兵敗身死,黃巾群龍無首。朝廷論功行賞,你的威名傳遍天下!',()=>{h.zjDead=true;player.gold+=800;player.food=(player.food||0)+100;player.morale=Math.min(100,(player.morale||50)+15);return '張角伏誅!獲得 💰800、🌾100,士氣 +15。';});
}
if(!h.ytEnd&&!h.zjDead&&t>=185*12+1)return histInfo('🏳️','黃巾平定','左中郎將皇甫嵩於廣宗大破黃巾,張角病死軍中,黃巾之亂漸平。',()=>{h.ytEnd=true;monsters=monsters.filter(m=>m.hist!=='zhangjiao');return '';});
if(!h.liang&&t>=187*12+4)return histInfo('🐎','涼州之亂','邊章、韓遂作亂涼州,馬騰聚眾響應,西涼兵勢大振。',()=>{h.liang=true;return '馬騰王城守軍大幅增強!';});
if(!h.dong&&t>=189*12+8)return histInfo('😈','董卓進京','靈帝駕崩,何進被殺,并州牧董卓率西涼鐵騎入洛陽,廢少帝、立獻帝,專斷朝政。',()=>{h.dong=true;return '洛陽守軍暴增,主幹道四關守備加強,過路費加倍。呂布殺丁原投靠董卓,暫時離開地圖。進入【第一章:董卓亂政】。';});
if(!h.coal&&h.dong&&t>=190*12+1&&(player.capturedCheckpoints||[]).includes('spoke_1'))h.lvbuPre=true;
if(!h.coal&&h.dong&&t>=190*12+1)return{icon:'🤝',title:'反董聯盟',text:'關東諸侯歃血為盟,共推袁紹為盟主,起兵討伐國賊董卓。同時,董卓也派使者帶重金前來拉攏你……',choices:[
{label:'加入聯軍討董',effect:()=>{h.coal='join';player.gold+=300;player.morale=Math.min(100,(player.morale||50)+10);refreshHistoryGuards();refreshChapter();return '諸侯撥給軍資 💰300,士氣 +10,聯軍牽制使洛陽守軍減弱。但董卓派猛將呂布鎮守虎牢關!進入【第二章:群雄討董】。';}},
{label:'收下重金,投靠董卓',effect:()=>{h.coal='dong';player.gold+=600;player.morale=Math.max(0,(player.morale||50)-15);refreshHistoryGuards();refreshChapter();return '獲得 💰600,但士兵不齒此舉,士氣 -15。進入【第二章:群雄討董】。';}},
{label:'兩不相幫',effect:()=>{h.coal='watch';refreshHistoryGuards();refreshChapter();return '你選擇坐山觀虎鬥。呂布已率軍進駐虎牢關。進入【第二章:群雄討董】。';}}]};
if(h.coal&&!h.lvbuDead&&!h.lvbuPre&&(player.capturedCheckpoints||[]).includes('spoke_1')&&h.coal!=='dong')
return histInfo('🔱','力破呂布','你在虎牢關擊敗了呂布!人中呂布負傷退走,天下震動。',()=>{h.lvbuDead=true;player.gold+=1000;player.morale=Math.min(100,(player.morale||50)+20);return '威震虎牢!獲得 💰1000,士氣 +20。';});
if(!h.move&&h.coal&&t>=190*12+3)return histInfo('🔥','遷都長安','董卓畏懼聯軍,挾天子西遷長安,臨行前縱火焚燒洛陽,宮室盡毀。',()=>{h.move=true;return '洛陽守軍大減,但城中財貨已被搬空。過路費恢復正常。';});
if(!player.jade&&h.move&&isCapitalCaptured(4))return histInfo('💎','傳國玉璽','你在洛陽宮殿廢墟的井中,發現了失落的傳國玉璽!「受命於天,既壽永昌」。',()=>{player.jade=true;h.jade=true;return '獲得傳國玉璽:英雄攻擊力永久 +10%!';});
if(player.lordId==='sunjian'&&!h.sjDeath&&t>=191*12+10)return{icon:'🏹',title:'峴山伏擊',text:'你追擊黃祖至峴山,林中似有伏兵……',choices:[
{label:'小心行軍,繞道而行',effect:()=>{h.sjDeath='safe';player.food=Math.max(0,(player.food||0)-60);return '你識破了埋伏,全軍而退。繞道消耗糧食 -60。';}},
{label:'強行追擊',effect:()=>{h.sjDeath='rush';if(Math.random()<0.5){player.gold+=1200;return '你擊潰伏兵,生擒黃祖!獲得 💰1200。';}player.hp=Math.max(1,Math.round(player.maxHp*0.1));for(const k in mercs)mercs[k]=Math.floor(mercs[k]*0.8);return '中伏!亂箭齊發,你身受重傷、兵力折損兩成,僥倖突圍。';}}]};
const sj=npcs.find(n=>n.id==='sunjian');
if(!h.sjDeath&&sj&&!sj.dead&&t>=191*12+10)return histInfo('🏹','孫堅戰死','孫堅奉袁術之命討伐劉表,追擊黃祖至峴山,遭伏兵亂箭射殺,江東之虎就此隕落。',()=>{h.sjDeath=true;sj.dead=true;sj.captured=[];sj.capturedCapitals=[];sj.capturedCheckpoints=[];return '孫堅勢力瓦解,他佔領的據點全部失守。';});
if(!h.dzDeath&&t>=192*12+4)return histInfo('🗡️','董卓之死','司徒王允設下連環計,呂布於未央宮刺殺董卓。董卓舊部群龍無首,洛陽守軍陷入混亂!',()=>{h.dzDeath=true;return '洛陽守軍大減!呂布脫離董卓,重新成為流動勢力。距離時限只剩一個月,這是攻下帝都的最後機會!';});
return null;
}

function maybeTriggerEvent(){
if(gameOver||inBattle)return;
const hev=isDong()?(dongHistoryEvent()||nextHistoryEvent()):nextHistoryEvent();
if(hev){showEvent(hev);return;}
if(Math.random()>0.18)return;
const ev=RANDOM_EVENTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*RANDOM_EVENTS.length)];
showEvent(ev);
}
function showEvent(ev){
inEvent=true;
document.getElementById('eventIcon').textContent=ev.icon;
document.getElementById('eventTitle').textContent=ev.title;
document.getElementById('eventText').textContent=ev.text;
const container=document.getElementById('eventChoices');
container.innerHTML='';
ev.choices.forEach(c=>{
const btn=document.createElement('button');
btn.className='close';
btn.textContent=c.label;
btn.onclick=()=>{
const resultText=c.effect();
document.getElementById('eventText').textContent=resultText;
container.innerHTML='';
const okBtn=document.createElement('button');
okBtn.className='close';
okBtn.textContent='確定';
okBtn.onclick=()=>{
document.getElementById('eventModal').classList.add('hidden');
inEvent=false;
updateHud();save();
};
container.appendChild(okBtn);
};
container.appendChild(btn);
});
document.getElementById('eventModal').classList.remove('hidden');
}
function endTurn(){
if(inBattle||inTown||inStatus||inBoot||inInn||inPatrolPhase||gameOver||inEntity||inNpcPhase||inEvent)return;
trails=[];// 上一輪敵方軌跡在新回合開始時清除
recenterView();
advanceWeek();
processFoodAndMorale();
processLoyalty();
coalitionSiege();
unifyTick();
movesLeft=moveBudget();
document.getElementById('moveBarFill').style.width='100%';
const PATROL_DETECT=500,PATROL_ATTACK=60;
for(const p of patrols){
if(!p.alive)continue;
const friendly=patrolFriendly(p);
const tx0=p.x,ty0=p.y;
try{
if(friendly&&!gameOver&&activeNpcs().length){
npc=activeNpcs().reduce((a,b)=>Math.hypot(a.x-p.x,a.y-p.y)<=Math.hypot(b.x-p.x,b.y-p.y)?a:b);
const distToNpc=Math.hypot(npc.x-p.x,npc.y-p.y);
if(distToNpc<PATROL_ATTACK){
patrolVsNpc(p);
continue;
}else if(distToNpc<PATROL_DETECT){
const dx=npc.x-p.x,dy=npc.y-p.y;
const step=Math.min(150,distToNpc);
const nx=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,p.x+dx/distToNpc*step));
const ny=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,p.y+dy/distToNpc*step));
if(canMoveTo(nx,ny)){p.x=nx;p.y=ny;}
continue;
}
}
const ang=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
const dist=80+Math.random()*120;
let nx=p.x+Math.cos(ang)*dist,ny=p.y+Math.sin(ang)*dist;
if(Math.hypot(nx-p.homeX,ny-p.homeY)>PATROL_RANGE){nx=p.x;ny=p.y;}
nx=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,nx));ny=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,ny));
if(canMoveTo(nx,ny)){p.x=nx;p.y=ny;}
}finally{if(Math.hypot(p.x-tx0,p.y-ty0)>4)trails.push({x1:tx0,y1:ty0,x2:p.x,y2:p.y,color:friendly?'#22c55e':'#dc2626',kind:'patrol'});}
}
turnCount++;
npcTurnAll();
setTimeout(maybeTriggerEvent,2600);
}
function respawnPatrol(p){
const ownerType=p.ownerType,kid=p.kingdomId,oid=p.patrolOutpostId;
setTimeout(()=>{
const i=patrols.indexOf(p);
if(i>=0){
if(ownerType==='capital'){
const c=CAPITALS.find(x=>x.id===kid);
if(c)patrols[i]=makeCapitalPatrol(c);
}else{
const o=OUTPOSTS.find(x=>x.id===oid);
if(o)patrols[i]=makeTownPatrol(o);
}
}
},15000);
}
function patrolVsNpc(p){
if(!npc)return;
const patrolPower=p.atk*3+p.hp;
const npcPow=npcCombatPower()*(0.8+Math.random()*0.4);
if(patrolPower>npcPow){
npc.hp=Math.max(1,Math.round(npc.hp*0.5));
npc.target=null;
showToast('🛡️ '+p.name+' 擊退了'+npcName()+'的部隊!');
}else{
p.alive=false;
npc.gold+=Math.round(20+npc.level*8);
npcGainExp(Math.round(10+npc.level*4));
showToast('⚔️ '+npcName()+'擊敗了'+p.name+'!');
respawnPatrol(p);
}
npcShopUpgrade();
updateHud();save();
}
document.getElementById('endTurnBtn').onclick=endTurn;

function showToast(msg){
const toast=document.getElementById('incomeToast');
toast.textContent=msg;
toast.classList.remove('hidden');
setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.add('hidden'),3000);
}
function collectPassiveIncome(){
if(inBoot||inBattle)return;
const townCount=(player.captured||[]).length;
const capCount=(player.capturedCapitals||[]).length;
if(townCount===0&&capCount===0)return;
const income=townCount*(10+player.level*3)+capCount*(50+player.level*10);
player.gold+=income;
updateHud();save();
showToast('💰 各領地稅賦入帳 +'+income);
}
const RECRUIT_POOL_CAP=8;
function regenRecruitPool(){
if(inBoot)return;
MERCS.forEach((m,i)=>{recruitPool[i]=Math.min(RECRUIT_POOL_CAP,(recruitPool[i]||0)+1);});
save();
}

function settlementKey(type,obj){return type==='checkpoint'?type+'_'+obj.key:type+'_'+obj.id;}
function garrisonCap(type,obj){
if(type==='village')return 100;
if(type==='checkpoint')return 200;
return obj.isCenter?1000:400;
}
const NPC_COLOR='#7f1d1d';
let npc=null,gameOver=false;
let npcs=[];
// 流動勢力:四位沒有固定地盤的群雄,在地圖上練級、招兵、攻城。k=起始地區
const ROAMING=[
{id:'liubei',name:'劉備',icon:'🐉',k:1,color:'#15803d',troopCost:0.6,desc:'仁德:招兵花費 -40%'},
{id:'caocao',name:'曹操',icon:'🦅',k:3,color:'#374151',expMult:1.3,desc:'雄略:經驗值 +30%'},
{id:'sunjian',name:'孫堅',icon:'🐯',k:2,color:'#b91c1c',atkMult:1.2,desc:'江東之虎:攻擊力 +20%'},
{id:'lvbu',name:'呂布',icon:'🔱',k:0,color:'#6d28d9',atkMult:1.5,desc:'人中呂布:攻擊力 +50%'}
];
function makeRoamingNpc(def){
const vs=OUTPOSTS.filter(o=>o.kingdom===def.k);
const v=vs.find(o=>o.id!==player.homeVillageId&&!(player.captured||[]).includes(o.id))||vs[0];
return{id:def.id,name:def.name,icon:def.icon,color:def.color,atkMult:def.atkMult||1,expMult:def.expMult||1,troopCost:def.troopCost||1,
level:1,exp:0,expNext:30,gold:50,hp:50,maxHp:50,weaponTier:0,armorTier:0,captured:[v.id],capturedCapitals:[],capturedCheckpoints:[],
x:v.x,y:v.y,target:null,avoidKey:null,homeVillageId:v.id,inventory:{},defeats:0};
}
function initNpc(){
npcs=ROAMING.filter(d=>!(player&&player.identity==='roam'&&player.lordId===d.id)&&!(d.id==='lvbu'&&isDong())).map(makeRoamingNpc);
npc=npcs[0]||null;
}
function npcName(){return npc&&npc.name||'NPC領主';}
function npcToast(msg){if(npc&&Math.hypot(npc.x-player.x,npc.y-player.y)<1500)showToast(msg);}// 遠方勢力的瑣事不打擾玩家
function npcActive(n){
if(!n||n.dead)return false;
const h=(player&&player.hist)||{};
if(n.id==='lvbu'&&h.dong&&!h.dzDeath)return false;// 董卓進京後呂布入董卓麾下,董卓死後才重出江湖
return true;
}
function activeNpcs(){return npcs.filter(npcActive);}
function npcGainExp(v){
npc.exp+=Math.round(v*(npc.expMult||1));
while(npc.exp>=npc.expNext){
npc.exp-=npc.expNext;npc.level++;
npc.expNext=Math.floor(npc.expNext*1.25)+10;
npc.maxHp+=8;npc.hp=npc.maxHp;
npcToast('🤴 '+npcName()+'升級了!目前 Lv.'+npc.level);
}
}
function npcBaseAtk(){return Math.round((8+npc.level*2+WEAPONS[npc.weaponTier].v)*(npc.atkMult||1));}
function npcArmorBonus(){return ARMORS[npc.armorTier].v;}
function npcCombatPower(){return npc.hp+npcBaseAtk()*3+(npc.troops||0)*8;}
function npcNearbySettlementMaxRarity(){
const SHOP_RANGE=260;
let maxR=-1;
for(const c of CAPITALS){
if(Math.hypot(npc.x-c.x,npc.y-c.y)<SHOP_RANGE){
const r=c.isCenter?3:2;
if(r>maxR)maxR=r;
}
}
for(const o of OUTPOSTS){
if(Math.hypot(npc.x-o.x,npc.y-o.y)<SHOP_RANGE){
if(0>maxR)maxR=0;
}
}
return maxR;
}
function npcRecruitTroops(){
const cost=Math.round((50+(npc.troops||0)*15)*(npc.troopCost||1));
if(npc.gold>=cost){
npc.gold-=cost;
npc.troops=(npc.troops||0)+1;
npcToast('🤴 '+npcName()+'招募了新兵!');
}
}
function npcShopUpgrade(){
if(!npc)return;
const maxR=npcNearbySettlementMaxRarity();
if(maxR<0)return;
if(npc.weaponTier<WEAPONS.length-1){
const next=WEAPONS[npc.weaponTier+1];
if(next.r<=maxR&&npc.level>=next.lvl&&npc.gold>=next.cost){
npc.gold-=next.cost;npc.weaponTier++;
npcToast('🤴 '+npcName()+'購入了更好的武器!');
return;
}
}
if(npc.armorTier<ARMORS.length-1){
const next=ARMORS[npc.armorTier+1];
if(next.r<=maxR&&npc.level>=next.lvl&&npc.gold>=next.cost){
npc.gold-=next.cost;npc.armorTier++;
npcToast('🤴 '+npcName()+'購入了更好的防具!');
return;
}
}
npcRecruitTroops();
}
function npcAsEnemy(){
return{icon:npc.icon,name:''+npcName()+'',level:npc.level,hp:npc.hp,maxHp:npc.maxHp,atk:npcBaseAtk(),exp:Math.round(20+npc.level*8),gold:Math.round(30+npc.level*15),alive:true,isNpcBoss:true,npcIdx:npcs.indexOf(npc)};
}
function playerPower(){
const tt=teamTotals();
return tt.hpPool+tt.atk*3;
}
function npcOwnsVillage(id){return npcs.some(n=>!n.dead&&n.captured.includes(id));}
function npcOwnsCapital(id){return npcs.some(n=>!n.dead&&n.capturedCapitals.includes(id));}
function npcOwnerOf(type,id){return npcs.find(n=>!n.dead&&(type==='village'?n.captured:type==='capital'?n.capturedCapitals:(n.capturedCheckpoints||[])).includes(id))||null;}
function totalSettlements(){return OUTPOSTS.length+CAPITALS.length;}
function npcTotalOwned(){return npc?npc.captured.length+npc.capturedCapitals.length:0;}
function npcDefenseOf(type,obj){
const key=settlementKey(type,obj);
if(type==='checkpoint'){
if(checkpointUnderPlayerControl(obj))return(player.stationed&&player.stationed[key])||20;
const g=checkpointGuards.find(x=>x.checkpointKey===obj.key&&x.alive);
return g?(g.atk+g.hp)/2:60;
}
if(type==='village'){
if(isCaptured(obj.id))return(player.stationed&&player.stationed[key])||15;
const g=garrisons.find(x=>x.outpostId===obj.id&&x.alive);
return g?(g.atk+g.hp)/2:40;
}
if(isCapitalCaptured(obj.id))return(player.stationed&&player.stationed[key])||30;
const g=capitalGuards.find(x=>x.capitalId===obj.id&&x.alive);
return g?(g.atk+g.hp)/2:150;
}
function npcOwnsCheckpoint(key){return npcs.some(n=>!n.dead&&(n.capturedCheckpoints||[]).includes(key));}
function npcPickTarget(){
const candidates=[];
OUTPOSTS.forEach(o=>{if(!npc.captured.includes(o.id))candidates.push({type:'village',obj:o});});
CAPITALS.forEach(c=>{if(!npc.capturedCapitals.includes(c.id))candidates.push({type:'capital',obj:c});});
CHECKPOINTS.forEach(cp=>{if(!(npc.capturedCheckpoints||[]).includes(cp.key))candidates.push({type:'checkpoint',obj:cp});});
const beatable=candidates.filter(c=>npcCombatPower()>npcDefenseOf(c.type,c.obj)*1.15);
const filtered=npc.avoidKey?beatable.filter(c=>settlementKey(c.type,c.obj)!==npc.avoidKey):beatable;
let pool=filtered.length?filtered:beatable;
if(unifyActive()&&player.unify.announced){pool=pool.filter(c=>{const o=npcOwnerOf(c.type,c.type==='checkpoint'?c.obj.key:c.obj.id);return !o||o===npc;});}// 聯盟期間NPC不互打
if((isDong()&&(player.hist||{}).coal)||(unifyActive()&&player.unify.announced)){const mine=pool.filter(c=>c.type==='capital'?isCapitalCaptured(c.obj.id):c.type==='checkpoint'?(player.capturedCheckpoints||[]).includes(c.obj.key):isCaptured(c.obj.id));if(mine.length)pool=mine;}
if(pool.length===0)return null;
pool.sort((a,b)=>Math.hypot(npc.x-a.obj.x,npc.y-a.obj.y)-Math.hypot(npc.x-b.obj.x,npc.y-b.obj.y));
return pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*Math.min(3,pool.length))];
}
function npcGarrison(type,obj){// NPC佔領據點後派駐守部隊,玩家才能攻打奪回
const nm=npc.name+'軍 駐守部隊';
if(type==='village'){const g=garrisons.find(x=>x.outpostId===obj.id&&x.alive);if(g){g.name=nm;return;}garrisons=garrisons.filter(x=>x.outpostId!==obj.id);garrisons.push(Object.assign(makeGarrison(obj),{name:nm}));}
else if(type==='capital'){const g=capitalGuards.find(x=>x.capitalId===obj.id&&x.alive);if(g){g.name=nm;return;}capitalGuards=capitalGuards.filter(x=>x.capitalId!==obj.id);capitalGuards.push(Object.assign(makeCapitalGuard(obj),{name:nm}));}
else{const g=checkpointGuards.find(x=>x.checkpointKey===obj.key&&x.alive);if(g){g.name=nm;return;}checkpointGuards=checkpointGuards.filter(x=>x.checkpointKey!==obj.key);checkpointGuards.push(Object.assign(makeCheckpointGuard(obj),{name:nm}));}
}
function npcResolveConquest(pick){
const defense=npcDefenseOf(pick.type,pick.obj);
if(npcCombatPower()*(0.8+Math.random()*0.4)>defense){
const key=settlementKey(pick.type,pick.obj);
if(pick.type==='checkpoint'){
const wasPlayers=(player.capturedCheckpoints||[]).includes(pick.obj.key);
if(wasPlayers)player.capturedCheckpoints=(player.capturedCheckpoints||[]).filter(k=>k!==pick.obj.key);
if(wasPlayers&&player.stationed)delete player.stationed[key];
npcs.forEach(n=>{if(n!==npc)n.capturedCheckpoints=(n.capturedCheckpoints||[]).filter(k=>k!==pick.obj.key);});
npc.capturedCheckpoints=npc.capturedCheckpoints||[];
if(!npc.capturedCheckpoints.includes(pick.obj.key))npc.capturedCheckpoints.push(pick.obj.key);
npc.avoidKey=null;npcGarrison('checkpoint',pick.obj);
npc.gold+=Math.round(20+npc.level*6);
npcGainExp(Math.round(10+npc.level*3));
showToast('⚔️ '+npcName()+'攻下了 '+pick.obj.name+(wasPlayers?'(奪自你)!':'!'));
return;
}
const wasPlayers=pick.type==='village'?isCaptured(pick.obj.id):isCapitalCaptured(pick.obj.id);
npcs.forEach(n=>{if(n!==npc){if(pick.type==='village')n.captured=n.captured.filter(id=>id!==pick.obj.id);else n.capturedCapitals=n.capturedCapitals.filter(id=>id!==pick.obj.id);}});
if(pick.type==='village'){
if(wasPlayers)player.captured=(player.captured||[]).filter(id=>id!==pick.obj.id);
npc.captured.push(pick.obj.id);
}else{
if(wasPlayers)player.capturedCapitals=(player.capturedCapitals||[]).filter(id=>id!==pick.obj.id);
npc.capturedCapitals.push(pick.obj.id);
}
if(wasPlayers&&player.stationed)delete player.stationed[key];
if(wasPlayers&&isDong()&&pick.type==='capital'&&pick.obj.id===4)dongLoseLuoyang(npc.name+'攻入洛陽。');
npc.avoidKey=null;npcGarrison(pick.type,pick.obj);
npc.gold+=Math.round(30+npc.level*10);
npcGainExp(Math.round(15+npc.level*5));
showToast('⚔️ '+npcName()+'攻陷了 '+pick.obj.name+(wasPlayers?'(奪自你)!':'!'));
checkGameOver();
}else{
npc.avoidKey=settlementKey(pick.type,pick.obj);
npc.hp=Math.max(1,Math.round(npc.hp*0.6));
const angle=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
npc.x=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,npc.x+Math.cos(angle)*200));
npc.y=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,npc.y+Math.sin(angle)*200));
showToast('🛡️ '+pick.obj.name+' 擊退了'+npcName()+'的進攻,'+npcName()+'負傷撤退整軍!');
}
npcShopUpgrade();
}
function npcFindStep(fromX,fromY,targetX,targetY,maxStep){
const dist=Math.hypot(targetX-fromX,targetY-fromY);
if(dist<1)return{x:fromX,y:fromY};
const step=Math.min(maxStep,dist);
const baseAngle=Math.atan2(targetY-fromY,targetX-fromX);
const angleOffsets=[0,0.3,-0.3,0.6,-0.6,0.9,-0.9,1.2,-1.2,1.6,-1.6,2.0,-2.0];
for(const off of angleOffsets){
const ang=baseAngle+off;
const nx=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,fromX+Math.cos(ang)*step));
const ny=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,fromY+Math.sin(ang)*step));
if(canMoveTo(nx,ny))return{x:nx,y:ny};
}
for(let s=step*0.5;s>10;s*=0.5){
const nx=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,fromX+Math.cos(baseAngle)*s));
const ny=Math.min(WORLD,Math.max(0,fromY+Math.sin(baseAngle)*s));
if(canMoveTo(nx,ny))return{x:nx,y:ny};
}
return{x:fromX,y:fromY};
}
function npcMove(){
if(!npc||inBoot||gameOver)return;
if(npc.hp<npc.maxHp*0.2){
const home=OUTPOSTS.find(o=>o.id===npc.homeVillageId);
if(home){
const hdist=Math.hypot(npc.x-home.x,npc.y-home.y);
if(hdist<70){
npc.hp=npc.maxHp;
npc.target=null;
npcToast('🤴 '+npcName()+'返回大本營療傷,生命值已全滿!');
updateHud();save();
return;
}
const hdx=home.x-npc.x,hdy=home.y-npc.y;
const hstep=Math.min(440+(npc.level-1)*10,hdist);
const{x:hnx,y:hny}=npcFindStep(npc.x,npc.y,home.x,home.y,hstep);
npcToast('🤴 '+npcName()+'身受重傷,返回大本營療養!');
animateNpcMove(hnx,hny);
return;
}
}
const distToPlayer=Math.hypot(npc.x-player.x,npc.y-player.y);
const shouldAttackPlayer=distToPlayer<650&&npcCombatPower()>playerPower()*1.15;
if(shouldAttackPlayer){
if(distToPlayer<70){
const enemy=npcAsEnemy();
if(npc.inventory&&npc.inventory.atk_pill>0){
npc.inventory.atk_pill--;
enemy.atk=Math.round(enemy.atk*1.3);
npcToast('🤴 '+npcName()+'服下龍力丹,率軍向你發動突襲!');
}else{
showToast('⚔️ '+npcName()+'判斷己方兵力雄厚,率軍向你發動突襲!');
}
try{triggerBattle(enemy);}catch(err){inBattle=false;}
return;
}
const dx=player.x-npc.x,dy=player.y-npc.y;
const step=Math.min(440+(npc.level-1)*10,distToPlayer);
const{x:nx,y:ny}=npcFindStep(npc.x,npc.y,player.x,player.y,step);
showToast('⚔️ '+npcName()+'判斷己方兵力雄厚,率軍朝你逼近!');
animateNpcMove(nx,ny);
return;
}
if(!npc.target){
npc.target=npcPickTarget();
if(npc.target)npcToast('🤴 '+npcName()+'動身前往 '+npc.target.obj.name);
}
if(!npc.target)return;
const{type,obj}=npc.target;
const dx=obj.x-npc.x,dy=obj.y-npc.y,dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
if(dist<70){
npcToast('🤴 '+npcName()+'抵達 '+obj.name+',發動攻城!');
npcResolveConquest(npc.target);
npc.target=null;
updateHud();save();
return;
}
const step=Math.min(440+(npc.level-1)*10,dist);
const{x:nx,y:ny}=npcFindStep(npc.x,npc.y,obj.x,obj.y,step);
if(Math.random()<0.5){
const monLevel=Math.max(1,npc.level+Math.floor(Math.random()*7)-3);
const monAtk=Math.round(3+monLevel*2),monHp=Math.round(20+monLevel*9);
const npcRoll=(npc.hp+npcBaseAtk()*3)*(0.85+Math.random()*0.3);
const monRoll=(monHp+monAtk*3)*(0.85+Math.random()*0.3);
if(npcRoll>monRoll){
const expGain=Math.round(10+monLevel*5),goldGain=Math.round(5+monLevel*3);
npcGainExp(expGain);npc.gold+=goldGain;
const dmgTaken=Math.max(0,Math.round(monAtk*1.5)-Math.floor(npcArmorBonus()/2));
npc.hp=Math.max(1,npc.hp-dmgTaken);
npc.inventory=npc.inventory||{};
if(Math.random()<0.25){
const key=Math.random()<0.5?'atk_pill':'def_pill';
npc.inventory[key]=(npc.inventory[key]||0)+1;
npcToast('🤴 '+npcName()+'擊敗野怪,獲得經驗與金錢,還撿到了'+ITEMS[key].name+'!');
}else{
npcToast('🤴 '+npcName()+'擊敗了野怪,獲得經驗與金錢!');
}
npcShopUpgrade();
}else{
const dmgTaken=Math.max(1,Math.round(monAtk*2)-Math.floor(npcArmorBonus()/2));
npc.hp=Math.max(1,npc.hp-dmgTaken);
npcToast('🤴 '+npcName()+'遭遇野怪,吃了敗仗負傷!');
}
}
animateNpcMove(nx,ny);
}
// ---- 移動軌跡(仿英雄無敵):敵方行動期間的路線畫成腳印+箭頭,保留到下次結束回合 ----
let trails=[];
function drawArrowHead(c,x,y,ang,sz,color){c.save();c.fillStyle=color;c.translate(x,y);c.rotate(ang);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(sz,0);c.lineTo(-sz*0.7,sz*0.65);c.lineTo(-sz*0.7,-sz*0.65);c.closePath();c.fill();c.restore();}
function drawTrails(ox,oy,w,h){
for(const t of trails){
const x1=t.x1-ox,y1=t.y1-oy,x2=t.x2-ox,y2=t.y2-oy;
if(Math.max(x1,x2)<-40||Math.min(x1,x2)>w+40||Math.max(y1,y2)<-40||Math.min(y1,y2)>h+40)continue;
const big=t.kind==='npc',len=Math.hypot(x2-x1,y2-y1),ang=Math.atan2(y2-y1,x2-x1),step=big?22:20,r=big?4.2:3;
ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=big?0.9:0.6;
for(let d=step*0.6;d<len-step*0.8;d+=step){
const px=x1+Math.cos(ang)*d,py=y1+Math.sin(ang)*d;
ctx.fillStyle=t.color;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(px,py,r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
if(big){ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';ctx.lineWidth=1.2;ctx.stroke();}
}
drawArrowHead(ctx,x2-Math.cos(ang)*(big?16:12),y2-Math.sin(ang)*(big?16:12),ang,big?9:6,t.color);
ctx.restore();
}
}
function drawTrailsMini(scale){
for(const t of trails){
const big=t.kind==='npc',ang=Math.atan2(t.y2-t.y1,t.x2-t.x1);
miniCtx.save();miniCtx.globalAlpha=big?0.95:0.55;miniCtx.strokeStyle=t.color;miniCtx.lineWidth=big?1.6:0.8;
miniCtx.beginPath();miniCtx.moveTo(t.x1*scale,t.y1*scale);miniCtx.lineTo(t.x2*scale,t.y2*scale);miniCtx.stroke();
if(big)drawArrowHead(miniCtx,t.x2*scale,t.y2*scale,ang,3,t.color);
miniCtx.restore();
}
}
let npcQueue=[];
function npcTurnAll(){npcQueue=activeNpcs();runNextNpc();}
function runNextNpc(){
if(inBattle||gameOver){npcQueue=[];return;}
while(npcQueue.length){
npc=npcQueue.shift();
npcMove();
if(inNpcPhase||inBattle)return;// 等動畫/戰鬥結束
}
}
function animateNpcMove(nx,ny){
if(Math.hypot(nx-npc.x,ny-npc.y)>4)trails.push({x1:npc.x,y1:npc.y,x2:nx,y2:ny,color:npc.color||NPC_COLOR,kind:'npc'});
const far=Math.hypot(npc.x-player.x,npc.y-player.y)>1100&&Math.hypot(nx-player.x,ny-player.y)>1100;
if(far){const n=npc,sx0=n.x,sy0=n.y;let k=0;const tm=setInterval(()=>{k++;n.x=sx0+(nx-sx0)*k/10;n.y=sy0+(ny-sy0)*k/10;if(k>=10)clearInterval(tm);},100);return;}// 遠方勢力:1秒平順移動,不搶鏡頭、不鎖操作
inNpcPhase=true;
const btn=document.getElementById('endTurnBtn');
btn.disabled=true;
const startX=npc.x,startY=npc.y,STEPS=4;
let step=0;
const timer=setInterval(()=>{
step++;
npc.x=startX+(nx-startX)*(step/STEPS);
npc.y=startY+(ny-startY)*(step/STEPS);
cameraFocus={x:npc.x,y:npc.y};
if(step>=STEPS){
clearInterval(timer);
setTimeout(()=>{
cameraFocus=null;
inNpcPhase=false;
btn.disabled=false;
runNextNpc();
},300);
updateHud();save();
}
},500);
}
function checkGameOver(){
if(npc&&npcTotalOwned()>=totalSettlements()){
gameOver=true;
document.getElementById('gameOverModal').classList.remove('hidden');
}
}

function loop(){
try{update();}catch(err){}
try{draw();}catch(err){}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

}
const body=document.getElementById('charBody');body.innerHTML=html;
body.querySelectorAll('[data-fixed]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>beginWithIdentity({identity:'fixed',lordId:+b.dataset.fixed}));
body.querySelectorAll('[data-roam]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>beginWithIdentity({identity:'roam',lordId:b.dataset.roam}));
const rnd=document.getElementById('cnRandom');
if(rnd){
const fill=()=>{document.getElementById('cnSur').value=pick(SURNAMES);document.getElementById('cnGiven').value=pick(GIVEN);document.getElementById('cnZi').value=Math.random()<0.6?pick(ZI):'';};
fill();rnd.onclick=fill;
document.getElementById('cnStart').onclick=()=>{
const sur=document.getElementById('cnSur').value.trim(),gv=document.getElementById('cnGiven').value.trim(),zi=document.getElementById('cnZi').value.trim();
if(!sur||!gv){document.getElementById('cnErr').textContent='請填寫姓和名';return;}
beginWithIdentity({identity:'custom',surname:sur,givenName:gv,courtesy:zi||'',region:+document.getElementById('cnRegion').value});
};
}
}
document.querySelectorAll('#charTabs .tab').forEach(t=>t.onclick=()=>{charTab=t.dataset.ctab;renderCharSelect();});
document.getElementById('charCancel').onclick=()=>{document.getElementById('charModal').classList.add('hidden');document.getElementById('bootScreen').classList.remove('hidden');};
function beginWithIdentity(ident){
pendingIdentity=ident;
document.getElementById('charModal').classList.add('hidden');
startGameInSlot(charSlot,false);
}

async function loadSlotData(){
const results=await Promise.all([1,2,3,4,5].map(n=>peekSlot(n)));
results.forEach((r,idx)=>{if(r.has)pendingSlotData[idx+1]=r.data;});
return results;
}

function renderBootMain(){
bootButtons.innerHTML=`
<button data-menu="new">🆕 開始新遊戲</button>
<button data-menu="load">📂 讀取存檔</button>
<button data-menu="settings">⚙️ 設定</button>
`;
document.querySelectorAll('#bootButtons button').forEach(b=>{
b.onclick=()=>{
const m=b.dataset.menu;
if(m==='new')renderNewGameList();
else if(m==='load')renderLoadList();
else if(m==='settings')openSettingsModal();
};
});
}

async function renderNewGameList(){
bootButtons.innerHTML='<div style="opacity:.8;font-size:13px;">讀取存檔中…</div>';
const results=await loadSlotData();
let html='';
results.forEach((r,idx)=>{
const n=idx+1;
if(r.has){
html+=`<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;">
<button data-slot="${n}" data-action="new" style="flex:1;font-size:12px;opacity:.75;">${slotLabel(n,r)}</button>
<button data-slot="${n}" data-action="new" class="secondary" style="flex:0 0 76px;font-size:11px;padding:8px 4px;">覆蓋</button>
</div>`;
}else{
html+=`<button data-slot="${n}" data-action="new">🆕 ${slotLabel(n,r)}</button>`;
}
});
html+='<button data-menu="back" class="secondary" style="margin-top:4px;">‹ 返回</button>';
bootButtons.innerHTML=html;
document.querySelectorAll('#bootButtons button[data-slot]').forEach(b=>{
b.onclick=()=>{
const n=+b.dataset.slot;
if(pendingSlotData[n]){
if(b.dataset.confirm==='1'){openCharSelect(n);}
else{
b.dataset.confirm='1';b.textContent='確定覆蓋?';
setTimeout(()=>{if(b.dataset.confirm==='1'){b.dataset.confirm='0';b.textContent=slotLabel(n,{has:true,...pendingSlotData[n]});}},3000);
}
}else{
openCharSelect(n);
}
};
});
const back=document.querySelector('#bootButtons button[data-menu="back"]');
if(back)back.onclick=renderBootMain;
}

async function renderLoadList(){
bootButtons.innerHTML='<div style="opacity:.8;font-size:13px;">讀取存檔中…</div>';
const results=await loadSlotData();
let html='';
results.forEach((r,idx)=>{
const n=idx+1;
if(r.has)html+=`<button data-slot="${n}" data-action="continue">▶️ ${slotLabel(n,r)}</button>`;
});
if(!html)html='<div style="opacity:.8;font-size:13px;margin:6px 0;">尚無存檔</div>';
html+='<button data-menu="back" class="secondary" style="margin-top:4px;">‹ 返回</button>';
bootButtons.innerHTML=html;
document.querySelectorAll('#bootButtons button[data-slot]').forEach(b=>{
b.onclick=()=>{startGameInSlot(+b.dataset.slot,true);};
});
const back=document.querySelector('#bootButtons button[data-menu="back"]');
if(back)back.onclick=renderBootMain;
}

async function openSettingsModal(){
await loadAutoSaveSetting();
renderAutoSaveOptions();
document.getElementById('settingsModal').classList.remove('hidden');
}

(async function boot(){
bootButtons.innerHTML='<div style="opacity:.8;font-size:13px;">讀取存檔中…</div>';
await initDb();
await loadAutoSaveSetting();
await migrateLegacySave();
renderBootMain();
})();

document.getElementById('saveIcon').onclick=()=>{save();};
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden&&!inBoot)save();});
window.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>{if(!inBoot)save();});
</script>
</body>
</html>
